# Lumi

Lumi uses native json-render Spec, Catalog, Registry, StateStore and handlers. Lumi is React-only: each package root is the React entry, and the framework-free /catalog subpaths hold definitions and Spec validation for Node tools without React.

- @duxweb/create-lumi: Scaffolding CLI for Lumi applications.. Entrypoints: @duxweb/create-lumi
- @duxweb/lumi: Native json-render integration and data services.. Entrypoints: @duxweb/lumi, @duxweb/lumi/catalog, @duxweb/lumi/validation-json-schema
- @duxweb/lumi-admin: Native json-render Admin configuration and React application shell.. Entrypoints: @duxweb/lumi-admin, @duxweb/lumi-admin/catalog
- @duxweb/lumi-check: Native json-render Catalog validation CLI.. Entrypoints: @duxweb/lumi-check
- @duxweb/lumi-ui: Native json-render integration and shadcn-style React components.. Entrypoints: @duxweb/lumi-ui, @duxweb/lumi-ui/catalog, @duxweb/lumi-ui/charts

Use original JSONUIProvider/Renderer with uiRegistry for plain UI. LumiProvider optionally adds data/auth/upload services. Admin composes Lumi and Lumi UI. UI never executes remote queries. Business validators and structured field errors are separate from Spec validation. The lumi-check CLI uses the same application Catalog as runtime. JSON only contains serializable values and registered actions. Editable values have one owner, the native StateStore. QueryClient owns remote cache. Await validation and saving inside one handler; action arrays are not transactions.

Components: CanAccess, Query, AgentSession, Skeleton, Spinner, Loading, Empty, Kbd, ScrollArea, Tag, TagGroup, Calendar, Listbox, Slider, RadioCards, CheckboxCards, TagSelect, Rating, ColorPicker, ColorSwatches, InputOTP, SignaturePad, IconPicker, PromptInput, ChatMessage, MessageActions, Thinking, ToolCall, Approval, AgentQuestion, AgentPlan, ChangeDiff, ContextChips, AgentMentionPicker, AgentSessionList, ChatThread, Fragment, Button, Input, Textarea, RichText, NumberInput, Select, MultiSelect, Checkbox, CheckboxGroup, RadioGroup, Switch, DatePicker, Cascader, TimePicker, DateTimePicker, DateRangePicker, Form, FormField, Table, DescriptionList, Pagination, Dialog, Drawer, Card, Tabs, Upload, Badge, Tooltip, Menu, Accordion, Popover, Popconfirm, Image, Iframe, Lightbox, Carousel, Breadcrumb, Alert, Icon, Progress, Stack, Grid, Separator, Heading, Text, Avatar, AvatarGroup, CodeBlock, CodeEditor, Prose, Markdown, Html, Frame, Filters, Stepper, TagsInput, AutoComplete, Mention, Transfer, ImageGrid, Repeater, RepeaterRow, Timeline, ActivityFeed, Tree, TreeSelect, CascaderPanel, DashboardPage, DetailPage, SettingsPage, SettingsForm, DataGrid, FilterBar, EmptyState, Page, PageHeader, PageFrame, Example, AgentWorkspace, ListPage, FormPage, DashboardCard, MetricCard, StatStrip, MatrixChart, BarChart, ProportionList, FunnelChart, RecordList, Article, Pipeline, Segmented, SkuEditor, Kanban, ScheduleCalendar, TreeFilter, AssistantContext, Include, AuditLog, RecordPicker, Chart
Actions: login, logout, request, create, update, delete, invalidate, toast, notify, closeNotice, exportList, importList, submitForm, agentSend, agentStop, agentRetry, agentEvent, navigate, openDrawer, closeDrawer

---
title: "lumi-check"
description: "lumi-check 在命令行里查组件目录、查组件参数，并校验页面、manifest、主题和 config.json，规则与运行时相同。"
---

lumi-check 是给 AI 和 CI 用的命令行工具，有三个命令。它只读目录、返回结果，不发业务请求，也不渲染页面。只需要 Node，不需要 React。

| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `lumi-check catalog` | 列出目录里的组件和动作 |
| `lumi-check describe <组件名>` | 一个组件的参数、插槽和事件 |
| `lumi-check <文件>` | 校验一份 JSON |

三个命令都接受 `--catalog`，指向项目自己的组件目录。不写时使用默认目录，也就是 CDN 版包含的全部组件和动作。

## 查目录

```sh
# 全部组件和动作，每个带一句说明
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check catalog --catalog src/catalog.mjs
# 只看组件，或只看动作
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check catalog --kind components
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check catalog --kind actions
# 一个动作和它的参数（JSON Schema）
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check catalog --kind actions --name submitForm
```

输出是 JSON：`components`（名字、说明、插槽、事件）、`actions`（名字、说明）和 `builtInActions`。用 `--name` 指定一个动作时，结果里多一个 `params`。指定的名字不存在时退出码是 1。

## 查一个组件

```sh
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check describe Table --catalog src/catalog.mjs
```

输出这个组件的 `description`、`props`（JSON Schema）、`slots` 和 `events`。组件不存在时退出码是 2。

## 校验

```sh
# 校验一个页面，用项目自己的目录，输出 JSON
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check src/pages/orders.json --catalog src/catalog.mjs --json
# 校验菜单和路由
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check manifest.json --kind manifest
# 校验主题
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check theme.json --kind theme
# 校验 config.json
npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check config.json --kind config
# 从标准输入读取
cat page.json | npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check -
```

| 退出码 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | 通过 |
| 1 | 有校验错误 |
| 2 | 文件读不到、JSON 无法解析，或目录加载失败 |

`--json` 输出 `{ valid, issues }`，每个问题有 `path`（如 `/elements/orders/props/columns/0/field`）、`message` 和可选的 `hint`，适合交给 AI 修改。

要校验的文件正好叫 `catalog` 或 `describe` 时，写成 `./catalog`。

## 自定义目录

`--catalog` 指向的模块导出 `catalog`（或默认导出）。用了自定义 directives 时，同一个模块再导出 `directives`，和应用用的是同一份。

## 在 CI 里

```sh
# 逐个校验页面，有一个不通过就让 CI 失败
for page in public/pages/*.json; do npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check "$page" || exit 1; done
```

页面格式由 lumi-check 负责；表单的业务规则（如"邮箱不能重复"）由后端和 Validator 负责。


---
title: "用 AI 写页面"
description: "让 AI 写 Lumi 页面的流程：查目录、写 JSON、校验、改错，以及需要的 Skill 和命令行工具。"
---

AI 写的是 JSON，不是代码，所以每一步都能检查：只能用目录里有的组件，写完马上校验，错误指到具体字段。

## 流程

1. **查目录**：有哪些组件、每个组件有哪些参数和事件。
2. **写页面**：输出 json-render Spec。
3. **校验**：用和运行时同一份目录检查，拿到带路径的错误列表。
4. **改错**：照着错误路径修改，直到校验通过。
5. **看效果**：刷新浏览器，不用编译。

## 需要的工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [Lumi Skill](/ai/skill/) | 告诉 AI 上面的流程和 Lumi 的写法。`create-lumi` 新建的项目自带。 |
| [lumi-check](/ai/checker/) | 命令行工具：查组件目录、查某个组件的参数、校验页面。AI 和 CI 都用它。 |
| [llms.txt](/llms.txt) | 给 AI 读的文档摘要；[llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) 是全部文档。 |

## 用 CDN、没有 npm 项目时

把 [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) 交给 AI，再让它用 `npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check page.json` 校验写出的页面。默认目录就是 CDN 版包含的全部组件和动作。


---
title: "Lumi Skill"
description: "Lumi Skill 教 AI 编写、修改和修复 Lumi 页面：查目录、写 Spec、校验、扩展组件、在浏览器里检查。"
---

Skill 是一份给 AI 看的说明。装好后，AI 在新建或修改 `src/pages` 下的页面、查询有哪些组件、页面校验失败时会自动按它做。

## 安装

`create-lumi` 新建的项目已经带好，写在两个位置，Claude Code 和其他读 `.agents` 的工具都能找到：

```text
.claude/skills/lumi/SKILL.md
.agents/skills/lumi/SKILL.md
```

已有项目可以用 `npm create @duxweb/lumi@latest` 新建一个空项目，把里面的 `.claude/skills/lumi/SKILL.md` 复制到同样的位置；它的源文件是 Lumi 仓库里的 `packages/create/ai/SKILL.md`。

## 它让 AI 做什么

1. **先查再写**。不凭记忆猜组件和参数：用 `lumi-check catalog` 列出组件和动作，用 `lumi-check describe <组件名>` 看某个组件的参数、插槽和事件。目录里没有的组件，先加到目录里，不拿别的组件凑。
2. **按 Spec 写页面**。每个元素有 `type`、`props`、`children`；读状态用 `$state`，双向绑定用 `$bindState`；读数据用 `Query` 加 `resultPath`；表单用 `submitForm` 保存；JSON 里不写函数和表达式。
3. **每个改过的页面都校验**。命令是：

   ```sh
   npx -y @duxweb/lumi-check src/pages/<page>.json --catalog src/catalog.mjs --json
   ```

   退出码 0 是通过，1 是有错误，2 是文件或目录有问题。照着错误路径（如 `/elements/orders/props/columns/0/kind`）修改，直到通过。不能删掉功能来"修好"错误。
4. **加组件时两处一起改**：定义写进 `src/catalog.mjs`（不引入 React），实现写进 `src/App.tsx` 的 registry。
5. **在浏览器里看**：首次加载、空数据、请求失败、表单保存被拒，这几种情况都要看。校验只能证明格式对，不能证明功能对。

### AdminInclude

Another JSON page in place of this element. It loads when it first renders
and is cached by `src`; its state is its own, with `params` at
`/include/params`, and it starts afresh when `params` change. A page that
includes itself, directly or further down, and nesting past
`MAX_INCLUDE_DEPTH` render an error instead.

```typescript
AdminInclude({ src, params }: { src: string; params?: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined; }): ReactElement
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `__0` | `{ src: string; params?: Record<string, unknown> \| null \| undefined; }` | 是 |  |

`__0` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `params` | `Record<string, unknown> \| null \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `src` | `string` | 是 |  |

返回 `ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>`。

### buildSkuVariants

Regenerates the variant rows for `attributes`, carrying the entered price,
stock and fields over from `previous` where a combination survives. A row
whose attribute set changed inherits from the closest old row that agrees on
every shared attribute; the `sku` code is only inherited once, so codes stay unique.
`defaults` fills the fields a row did not inherit.

```typescript
buildSkuVariants(attributes: readonly SkuAttribute[], previous?: readonly SkuVariant[], defaults?: Record<string, unknown>): SkuVariant[]
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attributes` | `readonly SkuAttribute[]` | 是 |  |
| `previous` | `readonly SkuVariant[]` | 否 |  |
| `defaults` | `Record<string, unknown>` | 否 |  |

返回 `SkuVariant[]`。

### composeAdminExtensions

Merges extensions in order: components join the Admin catalog and registry,
maps (handlers, data, auth and access providers, drawers, badges, upload and agent options)
merge key by key, lists (routes, assistant commands and @ tabs) concatenate — a command or tab with
the same value replacing the earlier one — every `onEvent` and
`onWorkspaceChange` listener is kept, and any other option is taken from
the last extension that sets it. A component, action or data provider name
registered twice is reported, and the later one wins; a handler named like
a built-in Admin action (`navigate`, `openDrawer`, `closeDrawer`) is refused
when the Admin is created.

```typescript
composeAdminExtensions(list: readonly AdminExtension[]): MountAdminExtensions
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | `readonly AdminExtension[]` | 是 |  |

返回 `MountAdminExtensions`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProviders` | `Record<string, AccessProvider> \| undefined` | 否 | Access providers by `access` name, replacing the permission-string rule. |
| `agent` | `AgentConfig \| undefined` | 否 | Agent chat requests: the default endpoint, the data source and extra headers. |
| `assistant` | `ReactNode` | 否 | A panel beside the page, such as an AI assistant. The shell renders its frame and a header toggle; the content is entirely the host's. |
| `assistantCommands` | `{ value: string; label: string; description?: string \| undefined; icon?: string \| undefined; prompt?: string \| undefined; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | / commands added to the manifest's `app.assistant`. |
| `assistantDefaultOpen` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Whether the assistant panel starts open for a reader who has not toggled it yet; defaults to open. The reader's own choice is remembered. |
| `assistantMentions` | `AdminPromptMentions \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Records each accepted write and lists the record history; optional. |

### LumiFunnelChart

A centred funnel drawn in SVG: each stage is a band whose width tapers down
the funnel, and trapezoid connectors join consecutive bands into one
silhouette. The bands step from the full palette colour to a lighter tint;
the connectors carry the stage-to-stage conversion. Names and counts sit in
aligned side columns (above each band in a narrow card), and an ordered list
gives screen readers every stage with its share, conversion and drop-off.

```typescript
LumiFunnelChart({ stages, ariaLabel, color, scale, className }: LumiFunnelChartProps): ReactElement
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `__0` | `LumiFunnelChartProps` | 是 |  |

`__0` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | 是 |  |
| `className` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `color` | `2 \| 1 \| 4 \| 3 \| 5 \| undefined` | 否 | Chart palette colour (`--chart-1` … `--chart-5`) the bands step down from. |
| `scale` | `"linear" \| "sqrt" \| undefined` | 否 | How a stage's share of the first sets its band width. `sqrt` keeps small stages readable after a steep first drop; `linear` is strictly proportional. Either way a band never drops below a minimum width or widens down the funnel. |
| `stages` | `readonly LumiFunnelStage[]` | 是 | Ordered stages, widest first; each band is measured against the first stage. |

返回 `ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>`。

### mountAdmin

Boots a complete Admin from JSON: the panel the address (or `options.panel`)
picks, with its backend, sign-in and permission rule, translations and formats
from `i18n`, menus and pages from its manifest. The same call backs the
prebuilt base script and a compiled host that adds its own extensions.

```typescript
mountAdmin(source: string | AdminBaseConfig, extensions?: MountAdminExtensions | ((context: AdminExtensionContext) => MountAdminExtensions | Promise<MountAdminExtensions>), options?: MountAdminOptions): Promise<MountedAdmin>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

### resolveAdminBaseConfig

Reads the config: an object, or the URL of one, checked against the schema.
A config read from a URL resolves its own relative URLs against that file,
so a deployment below a subpath keeps working on every route. `overrides`
apply before validation, for what a compiled host supplies in code (for
example a manifest built from TypeScript).

```typescript
resolveAdminBaseConfig(source: string | unknown, overrides?: Partial<AdminBaseConfig> | ((loaded: Record<string, any>) => unknown)): Promise<AdminBaseConfig>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `unknown` | 是 |  |
| `overrides` | `Partial<{ data: { url: string; name?: string \| undefined; live?: string \| undefined; auth?: boolean \| undefined; } \| { name: string; url: string; live?: string \| undefined; auth?: boolean \| undefined; }[]; ... 11 more ...; cacheKey?: string \| undefined; }> \| ((loaded: Record<string, any>) => unknown)` | 否 |  |

返回 `Promise<{ data: { url: string; name?: string | undefined; live?: string | undefined; auth?: boolean | undefined; } | { name: string; url: string; live?: string | undefined; auth?: boolean | undefined; }[]; ... 11 more ...; cacheKey?: string | undefined; }>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access` | `{ name?: string \| undefined; separator?: ":" \| "." \| undefined; format?: string \| undefined; } \| { name: string; separator?: ":" \| "." \| undefined; format?: string \| undefined; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | The permission rules; `resource:action` when left out. |
| `auth` | `{ name?: string \| undefined; mode?: "bearer" \| "cookie" \| undefined; tokenKey?: string \| undefined; csrf?: { cookie: string; header: string; } \| undefined; data?: string \| undefined; endpoints?: { ...; } \| undefined; } \| { ...; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-ins; one with the default endpoints when left out. |
| `basename` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where the site is served when not at the root, e.g. `/console`; every panel path is below it. |
| `cacheKey` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Storage namespace for the manifest cache and workspace; each panel keeps its own below it. |
| `data` | `{ url: string; name?: string \| undefined; live?: string \| undefined; auth?: boolean \| undefined; } \| { name: string; url: string; live?: string \| undefined; auth?: boolean \| undefined; }[]` | 是 | The backends. |
| `defaultPanel` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The panel `/` opens; defaults to the first. |
| `el` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | CSS selector of the mount node; defaults to `#app`. |
| `frameOrigins` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Sites an `Iframe` element or a `page.iframe` route may show, e.g. `["https://report.example.com"]`; this site always may. Without it any https site may. |
| `i18n` | `{ locale: string; fallbackLocale?: string \| undefined; translations?: Record<string, string \| Record<string, string>> \| undefined; format?: { currency: string; currencyUnit: "major" \| "minor"; timeZone: string; dateTimeInput: "iso-utc"; } \| undefined; } \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `modules` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Extension modules the base imports before it mounts: plain ES modules whose default export receives the runtime (React, Lumi, UI, Admin, zod) and returns the components, actions and callbacks they add. |
| `packKey` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Key of packed manifests, pages and themes. The backend may answer `{ "packed": "…" }` instead of readable JSON so the text does not show in the network panel; that works without any setting here, and this is the key when the backend masks the packed bytes with one. It hides documents from a casual look only: this file is itself readable. |
| `panels` | `{ manifest: string \| { app: { id: string; title?: string \| undefined; titleKey?: string \| undefined; subtitle?: string \| undefined; subtitleKey?: string \| undefined; documentTitle?: string \| false \| undefined; ... 8 more ...; header?: { ...; } \| undefined; }; routes: AdminRoute[]; }; ... 11 more ...; shellStorageKey...` | 是 | The back offices this deployment serves, chosen by path. |
| `theme` | `string \| { mode?: "light" \| "dark" \| "system" \| undefined; primary?: string \| undefined; brand?: string \| undefined; radius?: "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| undefined; fontSize?: "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| undefined; ... 5 more ...; info?: string \| undefined; } \| undefined` | 否 | Theme every panel uses unless it names its own. |

### useAgentConversation

One conversation with an agent and the list it belongs to, ready to spread
onto Lumi UI's ChatThread, PromptInput and AgentSessionList. The Admin
AgentWorkspace and AgentPanel are drawn from it; hosts with their own
layout use it the same way.

```typescript
useAgentConversation(options?: UseAgentConversationOptions): AgentConversation
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

| `body` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Extra fields sent with every request, e.g. the model. |
| `commands` | `{ value: string; label: string; description?: string \| undefined; icon?: string \| undefined; prompt?: string \| undefined; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | Slash commands in the composer. One with a `prompt` fills the box; others reach `onCommand`. |
| `context` | `{ id: string; label: string; kind?: "record" \| "file" \| "page" \| "selection" \| "data" \| undefined; icon?: string \| undefined; description?: string \| undefined; data?: Record<string, unknown> \| undefined; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | Context sent with every message, e.g. the page being viewed. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `endpoint` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The chat endpoint; defaults to the configured `agent.endpoint`, then `/agent/chat`. |
| `mentions` | `AdminPromptMentions \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `onCommand` | `((command: AgentCommand) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | A command without a `prompt` was picked; without this handler its label is sent as a message. |
| `onSessionChange` | `((id: string \| null) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called with the conversation to open: one picked from the list, a new one (`null`), or a started one's id. |
| `resource` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The DataProvider resource of the conversations: its list feeds `sessions`, `getOne` loads one. |
| `searchDelay` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Milliseconds the conversation search waits for typing to pause. |

| `reset` | `() => void` | 是 | Starts a new conversation. |
| `send` | `(text?: string) => void` | 是 | Sends `text`, or the draft, with the context; the draft clears once the message is accepted. |

| `prompt` | `{ value: string; streaming: boolean; onChange: (value: string) => void; onSubmit: (value: string) => void; onStop: () => void; onSuggestion: (suggestion: AgentSuggestion) => void; ... 7 more ...; onApprovalModeChange: (mode: "ask" \| "auto") => void; }` | 是 | The composer, as PromptInput takes it. |
| `reset` | `() => void` | 是 | Starts a new conversation. |
| `send` | `(text?: string) => void` | 是 | Sends `text`, or the draft, with the context; the draft clears once the message is accepted. |
| `sessionId` | `string \| null` | 是 | The open conversation's id, `null` for a new one not yet sent. |
| `sessions` | `{ sessions: AgentSession[]; value: string \| null; query: string; loading: boolean; remote: true; onQueryChange: (query: string) => void; onChange: (id: string) => void; onCreate: () => void; }` | 是 | The conversations, as AgentSessionList takes them. |
| `setDraft` | `(draft: string) => void` | 是 |  |
| `thread` | `Required<Pick<AgentMessageCallbacks, "onApprove" \| "onReject" \| "onAnswer" \| "onSkip" \| "onRegenerate" \| "onEditMessage" \| "onSuggestion">> & { ...; }` | 是 | The messages and every reader action, as ChatThread takes them. |
| `title` | `string \| undefined` | 是 | The open conversation's title, from the list. |

### AssistantContextRegistry

What pages and modules tell the assistant about: the selected rows, the

```typescript
interface SkuColumn
```

### AdminExtension

What an extension module contributes. A module written as plain JavaScript
— no bundler — default-exports `(runtime, { config, http }) => AdminExtension`,
so it reaches React, the Lumi hooks and the UI components through `runtime`
and shares the base's single React instance; `http` is the app's signed
request client for the data providers it adds.

```typescript
type AdminExtension = AdminExtension
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProviders` | `Record<string, AccessProvider> \| undefined` | 否 | Access providers by `access` name, replacing the permission-string rule. |
| `actions` | `Record<string, AdminExtensionAction> \| undefined` | 否 | Definitions of the actions in `handlers`, so pages that use them are validated like built-in ones. A handler without one is still accepted in JSON, with its params unchecked. |
| `agent` | `AgentConfig \| undefined` | 否 | Agent chat requests: the default endpoint, the data source and extra headers. |
| `assistant` | `ReactNode` | 否 | A panel beside the page, such as an AI assistant. The shell renders its frame and a header toggle; the content is entirely the host's. |
| `assistantCommands` | `{ value: string; label: string; description?: string \| undefined; icon?: string \| undefined; prompt?: string \| undefined; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | / commands added to the manifest's `app.assistant`. |
| `assistantDefaultOpen` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Whether the assistant panel starts open for a reader who has not toggled it yet; defaults to open. The reader's own choice is remembered. |
| `assistantMentions` | `AdminPromptMentions \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Records each accepted write and lists the record history; optional. |
| `authProviders` | `Record<string, AuthProvider> \| undefined` | 否 | Auth providers by `auth` name, replacing the simple convention for the panels that use it. |
| `components` | `Record<string, AdminExtensionComponent> \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `dataProviders` | `Record<string, DataProvider \| AdminRequestHooks> \| undefined` | 否 | Data providers by `data` name, reached with `dataProviderName`; `default` stands for the mounted panel's own backend. Build them on the `http` the extension context hands over, so they carry the reader's credentials, locale and tenant. An entry may instead give only `{ onRequest, onResponse }`: the provider the config already builds for that name keeps its address and gains the hooks. On the panel's backend they reach every request to it, sign-in, uploads, the agent, the event stream and served pages included. |
| `drawers` | `AdminRoutedDrawerRegistry \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `env` | `Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null> \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `handlers` | `Record<string, ActionHandler> \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `headerEnd` | `ReactNode` | 否 | Rendered on the header's trailing edge — the design's notifications bell and anything else app-wide the shell cannot supply the feature for. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | 翻译、切换语言和格式化。 |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Pushes backend changes; with it, queries refetch what an event touches. |
| `loadPageModule` | `AdminPageModuleLoader \| undefined` | 否 | Loads a `page.module` route's component; defaults to `import()` and the module's default export. Each URL loads once. |
| `manifestLoader` | `LumiJsonLoader<{ app: { id: string; title?: string \| undefined; titleKey?: string \| undefined; subtitle?: string \| undefined; subtitleKey?: string \| undefined; documentTitle?: string \| false \| undefined; ... 8 more ...; header?: { ...; } \| undefined; }; routes: AdminRoute[]; }> \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `menuBadges` | `Readonly<Record<string, ShellMenuBadge>> \| undefined` | 否 | Live counts beside menu items, keyed by route name. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws `notify` notices; without one the action is a no-op. |
| `onEvent` | `AdminEventHandler \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `onWorkspaceChange` | `((value: string) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called when the user picks another workspace in the sidebar switcher (`app.workspaces`). |

### MountAdminExtensions

Everything JSON cannot carry, supplied by a compiled host or by a page script
(`window.LumiAdminSetup`): callbacks, components and providers. A provider
set here replaces the one built from the config: an auth provider signs in
against a backend that does not speak the simple convention, and every
request (data, uploads, agent, live) carries its credentials. `upload` and
`agent` options merge over the defaults.

### applyAgentChunk

Folds one stream chunk into the message being built and returns the next
merge state. Unchanged chunks return the same message object, so a renderer
can skip work; changed ones copy only the message and the part that moved.

```typescript
applyAgentChunk(state: AgentMergeState, chunk: AgentChunk, now?: number): AgentMergeState
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `AgentMergeState` | 是 |  |
| `chunk` | `AgentChunk` | 是 |  |
| `now` | `number` | 否 |  |

`state` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clientTool` | `((toolName: string) => boolean) \| undefined` | 否 | Tools the front end runs: their calls stay running when the stream ends. |
| `finishReason` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `ids` | `Record<string, string>` | 是 | Text and reasoning ids of this stream mapped to part ids. Servers number blocks per request, so a reply that goes on after a decision may reuse an id the message already has; such a block gets a fresh part id. |
| `message` | `AgentChatMessage` | 是 |  |
| `started` | `Record<string, number>` | 是 | When each reasoning block and tool call started, for its duration. |

返回 `AgentMergeState`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clientTool` | `((toolName: string) => boolean) \| undefined` | 否 | Tools the front end runs: their calls stay running when the stream ends. |
| `finishReason` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `ids` | `Record<string, string>` | 是 | Text and reasoning ids of this stream mapped to part ids. Servers number blocks per request, so a reply that goes on after a decision may reuse an id the message already has; such a block gets a fresh part id. |
| `message` | `AgentChatMessage` | 是 |  |
| `started` | `Record<string, number>` | 是 | When each reasoning block and tool call started, for its duration. |

### applyOptimisticChange

Applies the change to every cached query of the resource except its
aggregates and audit log. Returns the undo, which puts the saved data back
and refetches the resource, so changes that landed meanwhile — another
write, a refetch — are not lost under the old copy.

```typescript
applyOptimisticChange(client: QueryClient, context: LumiContext, target: { resource: string; dataProviderName?: string; }, change: OptimisticChange): () => void
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client` | `QueryClient` | 是 |  |
| `context` | `LumiContext` | 是 | `createLumi` 创建的共享上下文。 |
| `target` | `{ resource: string; dataProviderName?: string; }` | 是 |  |
| `change` | `OptimisticChange` | 是 |  |

`context` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProvider` | `AccessProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Permission checks. |
| `agentBridge` | `AgentBridge \| undefined` | 否 | What the agent sees of the running pages and the client tools it acts through. |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |
| `getDataProvider` | `(name?: string) => DataProvider` | 是 | The data provider registered under `name`, `default` when left out; throws for a name that is not registered. |
| `http` | `HttpClient` | 是 | The request client, signed by `authProvider`. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Translation, the locale and formats. |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Changes pushed by the backend. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws notification cards. |
| `routerProvider` | `RouterProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Navigation and the current address. |
| `tenantProvider` | `TenantProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The current tenant. |
| `toastProvider` | `ToastProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws toasts. |
| `validator` | `Validator` | 是 | Checks form values against `rules`. |

`target` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

### createDataAuditLogProvider

A log kept as one more resource of the DataProvider: events are created in

### createHttpClient

The one request path of Lumi. Data providers, uploads, the agent, the live
stream and the auth provider's own sign-in requests all go through a client:
it asks the auth for the request's credentials (`authorizeRequest`), adds
the locale and tenant, encodes JSON, refreshes once on a 401 and turns a
non-2xx answer into a `DataProviderError`. The data layer passes a signed
client's failures to the auth's `onError`; an unsigned one's to the caller.

All of that is for the client's own backend: `baseUrl`, the page's site and
`trustedOrigins`. A full URL to anywhere else is sent plain, so a page that
names a foreign address never carries the reader's credentials there.

```typescript
createHttpClient(options?: HttpClientOptions): HttpClient
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `HttpClientOptions` | 否 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | `false` sends no app credentials and leaves failures to the caller: a 401 from such a backend does not sign the reader out. Its own key, if any, goes in `headers`. Defaults to `true`. |
| `authProvider` | `RequestSigner \| (() => RequestSigner \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | The app's auth provider (or just its signing part); a function is read on every request. |
| `baseUrl` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Root that relative paths join onto; absolute URLs pass through. |
| `fetcher` | `((input: RequestInfo \| URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>) \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the global fetch, read when a request starts. |
| `getLocale` | `(() => string \| null \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | Current UI locale, sent as `Accept-Language`. |
| `getTenant` | `(() => string \| null \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | Current tenant, sent as `tenantHeader`. |
| `headers` | `HttpHeaders \| undefined` | 否 | Headers on every request, below the per-request and auth ones; a function is read on every request. |
| `onRequest` | `((request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => HttpOutgoingRequest \| void \| Promise<HttpOutgoingRequest \| void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Last look at a request before it leaves, after the credentials, locale, tenant and JSON encoding: add or rewrite headers, sign the method, URL and body. Runs again for the resend after a 401 refresh. Change the request in place or return a new one. |
| `onResponse` | `((response: Response, request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Response \| void \| Promise<Response \| void>) \| undefined` | 否 | First look at the final answer, whatever its status: check its signature, decrypt it, or reshape it. Return another Response to replace it; throw to fail the request. |
| `parseError` | `((body: unknown, response: Response) => HttpErrorDetails) \| undefined` | 否 | Reads this backend's error body (parsed JSON, or `{}` when it is not JSON) into the one `DataProviderError` every caller handles. Defaults to `parseLumiError`. |
| `tenantHeader` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to `X-Tenant`. |
| `trustedOrigins` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Other sites that get the same treatment as `baseUrl` and the page, e.g. `["https://files.example.com"]`. A request to any other site goes out plain: without the reader's credentials, the tenant, the default headers or the hooks, and its 401 does not sign the reader out. |

返回 `HttpClient`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `string` | 是 |  |
| `download` | `(path: string, options?: HttpRequestOptions) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | The same request, for an answer that is a file: the response itself on 2xx, its body unread so the caller can follow the stream, else a `DataProviderError`. |
| `extend` | `(options: HttpClientExtendOptions) => HttpClient` | 是 |  |
| `fetch` | `(path: string, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | A signed fetch: on a 401 the auth's `refresh` runs once (shared by every request waiting on it) and the request is sent again. The response is returned as it is, whatever its status. |
| `getAuthProvider` | `() => RequestSigner \| undefined` | 是 | The provider signing these requests, if any. |
| `own` | `<E>(error: E) => E` | 是 | Marks a failure as this client's, so only a signed client's reaches the auth's `onError`. |
| `prepare` | `(request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Promise<HttpPreparedRequest>` | 是 | The request as this client sends it: credentials, locale, tenant, then `onRequest`. For transports `fetch` does not cover, such as an XHR upload, which hands the answer to `receive`. |
| `receive` | `(response: Response, request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | Runs `onResponse` on an answer to a prepared request. |
| `request` | `<T = any>(path: string, options?: HttpRequestOptions) => Promise<T>` | 是 | A signed JSON request; the parsed body on 2xx, else a `DataProviderError`. |
| `signed` | `boolean` | 是 | Whether the app's auth signs these requests and handles their failures. |
| `url` | `(path: string) => string` | 是 | The path joined onto `baseUrl`. |

### createSimpleAuthProvider

The session conventions a JSON backend most often speaks. Bearer mode:
login returns a token plus the user and permission list, `me` restores
them. Cookie mode: the server keeps the session in a cookie and `me` says
who is signed in. Permissions read as `resource:action` (`orders:*`, `*:*`).
One session feeds both the auth and access providers, so a JSON-configured
base needs no code for it; its own requests go through an HttpClient it
signs itself. Session requests (login, logout, refresh) carry whatever
session there is and never trigger a refresh.

```typescript
createSimpleAuthProvider(options: SimpleAuthProviderOptions): SimpleAuth
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `SimpleAuthProviderOptions` | 是 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiUrl` | `string` | 是 | API root the endpoints are relative to. |
| `csrf` | `SimpleAuthCsrf \| undefined` | 否 | Cookie mode: the anti-forgery cookie echoed in a header on writes. |
| `endpoints` | `SimpleAuthEndpoints \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `http` | `HttpClient \| undefined` | 否 | The client its own requests go through (for the locale, tenant or a test fetcher); one is created otherwise. |
| `loginPath` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where a signed-out reader is sent. |
| `mode` | `"bearer" \| "cookie" \| undefined` | 否 | `bearer` (default) keeps the token login returns and sends it as `Authorization: Bearer …`. `cookie` keeps nothing: the server's session cookie travels with `credentials: 'include'` and `me` tells who is in. |
| `permission` | `SimplePermissionFormat \| undefined` | 否 | How a `{ resource, action }` check reads the permission strings login returns. |
| `readCookie` | `((name: string) => string \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | Cookie mode: where `csrf.cookie` is read; defaults to `document.cookie`. |
| `storage` | `TokenStorage \| undefined` | 否 | Bearer mode: defaults to `globalThis.localStorage`; pass one for SSR or tests. |
| `tokenKey` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Bearer mode: storage key for the token. |

返回 `SimpleAuth`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProvider` | `AccessProvider` | 是 | 权限判断。 |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider` | 是 | 登录、退出、会话检查和读取身份。 |
| `getSession` | `() => SimpleAuthSession` | 是 |  |

### createSimpleDataProvider

Default REST DataProvider — follows the Lumi REST conventions (framework-agnostic, fetch-based):
- List    GET    \{apiUrl\}/\{resource\}?page&pageSize&status=paid&total[gte]=100&sort=-createdAt,name
- Detail  GET    \{apiUrl\}/\{resource\}/\{id\}
- Create  POST   \{apiUrl\}/\{resource\} (there is no bulk create: hooks and imports send one request per record)
- Update  PUT    \{apiUrl\}/\{resource\}/\{id\}
- Delete  DELETE \{apiUrl\}/\{resource\}/\{id\}
- Credentials, locale and tenant come from `http`
- Response  \{ message?, data, meta:\{ total \} \}, data is auto-unwrapped
- Errors    non-2xx \{ message, code?, errors?: [\{ path, message, code? \}] \}

```typescript
createSimpleDataProvider(options: SimpleDataProviderOptions): DataProvider
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `SimpleDataProviderOptions` | 是 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiUrl` | `string` | 是 | API root URL, e.g. https://api.example.com |
| `http` | `HttpClient \| undefined` | 否 | The client requests go through, carrying the auth provider's credentials, the locale and the tenant. Without one requests carry none of them. |
| `onRequest` | `((request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => HttpOutgoingRequest \| void \| Promise<HttpOutgoingRequest \| void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Changes every request to this backend just before it leaves: extra or rewritten headers, a signature over the method, URL and body. See `HttpClientOptions.onRequest`. |
| `onResponse` | `((response: Response, request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Response \| void \| Promise<Response \| void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Checks or rewrites every answer from this backend, e.g. verifies its signature. |
| `parseError` | `((body: unknown, response: Response) => HttpErrorDetails) \| undefined` | 否 | Reads a failed answer's body into `{ message, code?, errors?: [{ path, message }] }`; defaults to the Lumi convention. Field errors appear under the form's fields. |
| `unwrap` | `((body: any) => { data: any; total?: number; raw?: unknown; }) \| undefined` | 否 | Custom response unwrapping; defaults to the Lumi convention: data = body.data ?? body, total = body.meta.total |

返回 `DataProvider`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `create` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: CreateParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Creates a record from `variables` and answers the saved one. |
| `createMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: CreateManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Creates several records in one request; without it they are created one by one. |
| `custom` | `(<T = any>(params: CustomParams) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | A request outside the resource conventions; the `request` action, `useCustom` and `useCustomMutation` need it. |
| `deleteMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: DeleteManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Deletes several records; without it they are deleted one by one. |
| `deleteOne` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: DeleteParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Deletes the record `id`. |
| `getApiUrl` | `(() => string) \| undefined` | 否 | The API root, for callers that build full addresses such as uploads. |
| `getList` | `<T = any>(params: GetListParams) => Promise<GetListResult<T>>` | 是 | One page of a resource, filtered and sorted, or all of it with `pagination: false`; `total` counts every match. |
| `getMany` | `(<T = any>(params: GetManyParams) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Several records by id in one request; without it each id is read with `getOne`. |
| `getOne` | `<T = any>(params: GetOneParams) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | One record by id. |
| `http` | `HttpClient \| undefined` | 否 | The client it sends through; uploads and the agent reuse its credentials. |
| `update` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: UpdateParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Updates the record `id` with `variables` and answers the saved one. |
| `updateMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: UpdateManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Applies the same `variables` to several records; without it they are updated one by one. |

### createSseLiveProvider

Realtime over one server-sent event stream read with fetch, so it carries
the same headers as data requests (EventSource cannot). The stream opens
with the first subscription, closes with the last, and reconnects with
backoff after a drop.

```typescript
createSseLiveProvider(options: SseLiveProviderOptions): SseLiveProvider
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `SseLiveProviderOptions` | 是 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `credentials` | `RequestCredentials \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `fetcher` | `((input: RequestInfo \| URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `headers` | `(() => Record<string, string>) \| undefined` | 否 | Extra headers for each connection, e.g. the token and the tenant; read again on every reconnect. |
| `http` | `HttpClient \| undefined` | 否 | Opens and posts through this client, so the auth provider signs each connection (read again on every reconnect) with the locale and tenant. |
| `publishUrl` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where `publish` posts an event; without it the provider only listens. |
| `retryDelay` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | First wait before reconnecting, doubled up to 30 seconds. |
| `url` | `string` | 是 | The event stream endpoint; it sends `data: { channel, type, payload }` frames. |

返回 `SseLiveProvider`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `() => void` | 是 |  |
| `publish` | `((event: LiveEvent) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Sends an event to the backend, for providers that can. |
| `reconnect` | `() => void` | 是 | Closes and opens the stream again, e.g. once the tenant or the token changed. |
| `subscribe` | `(params: LiveSubscribeParams) => () => void` | 是 | Returns the function that ends the subscription. |

### dataProviderHttp

The client that reaches a data provider's backend: the provider's own, else
the app's with that backend's API root trusted, so a hand-written provider
on another origin still gets the reader's credentials for its uploads,
exports and agent requests.

```typescript
dataProviderHttp(context: LumiContext, dataProviderName?: string): HttpClient
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `LumiContext` | 是 | `createLumi` 创建的共享上下文。 |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |

`context` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProvider` | `AccessProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Permission checks. |
| `agentBridge` | `AgentBridge \| undefined` | 否 | What the agent sees of the running pages and the client tools it acts through. |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |
| `getDataProvider` | `(name?: string) => DataProvider` | 是 | The data provider registered under `name`, `default` when left out; throws for a name that is not registered. |
| `http` | `HttpClient` | 是 | The request client, signed by `authProvider`. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Translation, the locale and formats. |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Changes pushed by the backend. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws notification cards. |
| `routerProvider` | `RouterProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Navigation and the current address. |
| `tenantProvider` | `TenantProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The current tenant. |
| `toastProvider` | `ToastProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws toasts. |
| `validator` | `Validator` | 是 | Checks form values against `rules`. |

返回 `HttpClient`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `string` | 是 |  |
| `download` | `(path: string, options?: HttpRequestOptions) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | The same request, for an answer that is a file: the response itself on 2xx, its body unread so the caller can follow the stream, else a `DataProviderError`. |
| `extend` | `(options: HttpClientExtendOptions) => HttpClient` | 是 |  |
| `fetch` | `(path: string, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | A signed fetch: on a 401 the auth's `refresh` runs once (shared by every request waiting on it) and the request is sent again. The response is returned as it is, whatever its status. |
| `getAuthProvider` | `() => RequestSigner \| undefined` | 是 | The provider signing these requests, if any. |
| `own` | `<E>(error: E) => E` | 是 | Marks a failure as this client's, so only a signed client's reaches the auth's `onError`. |
| `prepare` | `(request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Promise<HttpPreparedRequest>` | 是 | The request as this client sends it: credentials, locale, tenant, then `onRequest`. For transports `fetch` does not cover, such as an XHR upload, which hands the answer to `receive`. |
| `receive` | `(response: Response, request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | Runs `onResponse` on an answer to a prepared request. |
| `request` | `<T = any>(path: string, options?: HttpRequestOptions) => Promise<T>` | 是 | A signed JSON request; the parsed body on 2xx, else a `DataProviderError`. |
| `signed` | `boolean` | 是 | Whether the app's auth signs these requests and handles their failures. |
| `url` | `(path: string) => string` | 是 | The path joined onto `baseUrl`. |

### downloadExport

Asks the backend for the export file and follows its stream. `total` is the
`Content-Length` when the server sends one; `loaded` counts bytes.

```typescript
downloadExport(context: LumiContext, client: QueryClient | undefined, input: RunExportOptions & { url: string; }, save: TransferHost["save"]): Promise<TransferDownload>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `LumiContext` | 是 | `createLumi` 创建的共享上下文。 |
| `client` | `QueryClient \| undefined` | 是 |  |
| `input` | `RunExportOptions & { url: string; }` | 是 |  |
| `save` | `(file: TransferFile \| TransferDownload) => void` | 是 |  |

`context` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProvider` | `AccessProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Permission checks. |
| `agentBridge` | `AgentBridge \| undefined` | 否 | What the agent sees of the running pages and the client tools it acts through. |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |
| `getDataProvider` | `(name?: string) => DataProvider` | 是 | The data provider registered under `name`, `default` when left out; throws for a name that is not registered. |
| `http` | `HttpClient` | 是 | The request client, signed by `authProvider`. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Translation, the locale and formats. |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Changes pushed by the backend. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws notification cards. |
| `routerProvider` | `RouterProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Navigation and the current address. |
| `tenantProvider` | `TenantProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The current tenant. |
| `toastProvider` | `ToastProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws toasts. |
| `validator` | `Validator` | 是 | Checks form values against `rules`. |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `readonly TransferColumn[] \| undefined` | 否 | The columns of the file, in order; every field of the records when left out. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filename` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Name of the saved file without its extension; the resource name by default. |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 筛选条件数组。 |
| `format` | `(string & {}) \| TransferFormat \| undefined` | 否 | `csv` or `json` for a file written here; with `url`, any name the backend knows (`xlsx`…). |
| `maxItems` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Stops after this many records, so an export cannot run away. |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `method` | `"GET" \| "POST" \| undefined` | 否 | `POST` (default) sends the values as JSON; `GET` as the query, `filters`, `sorters` and `columns` as JSON text. |
| `onProgress` | `((progress: { loaded: number; total?: number; }) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records asked for per request. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | 用于取消请求的 AbortSignal。 |
| `sorters` | `Sorter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 排序条件数组。 |
| `url` | `string` | 是 | The backend builds the file: this endpoint (relative to the API root) is sent `{ filters, sorters, columns, format, ...meta }` and answers the file as a stream, in any format. Without it the records are loaded page by page and the file is written in the browser. |

返回 `Promise<TransferDownload>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

### extendI18nProvider

Adds translations beneath an existing i18n provider: its own text wins and these fill what it lacks. Without a provider, one is created from them.

```typescript
extendI18nProvider(provider: I18nProvider | undefined, translations: I18nTranslations, options?: ExtendI18nProviderOptions): I18nProvider
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 是 |  |
| `translations` | `I18nTranslations` | 是 |  |
| `options` | `ExtendI18nProviderOptions` | 否 |  |

`provider` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changeLocale` | `(locale: string, params?: unknown) => Promise<void> \| void` | 是 | Switches the locale. |
| `formatCurrency` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An amount in the configured currency and unit. |
| `formatDate` | `((value: I18nDateValue, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A date in the locale's form. |
| `formatDateTime` | `((value: string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An ISO 8601 UTC string shown in the configured time zone. |
| `formatNumber` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A number in the locale's form; components use `Intl` without it. |
| `formatRelativeTime` | `((value: number, unit: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, options?: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A relative time such as "3 days ago". |
| `getDirection` | `(() => LumiDirection) \| undefined` | 否 | The current locale's text direction. |
| `getFallbackLocale` | `(() => string \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | The locale a missing translation falls back to, when there is one. |
| `getFormatConfig` | `(() => I18nFormatConfig) \| undefined` | 否 | The currency and time zone settings. |
| `getLocale` | `() => string` | 是 | The current locale, e.g. `zh-CN`. |
| `subscribe` | `((listener: () => void) => () => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Notifies when the locale changes; with it `$t` and component text follow the switch. |
| `translate` | `(key: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>, defaultMessage?: string) => string` | 是 | The text for `key` in the current locale, with `{name}` placeholders filled from `params`; `defaultMessage`, else the key, when there is none. |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | `LumiDirection \| ((locale: string) => LumiDirection) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `fallbackLocale` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `format` | `I18nFormatConfig \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |

返回 `I18nProvider`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changeLocale` | `(locale: string, params?: unknown) => Promise<void> \| void` | 是 | Switches the locale. |
| `formatCurrency` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An amount in the configured currency and unit. |
| `formatDate` | `((value: I18nDateValue, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A date in the locale's form. |
| `formatDateTime` | `((value: string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An ISO 8601 UTC string shown in the configured time zone. |
| `formatNumber` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A number in the locale's form; components use `Intl` without it. |
| `formatRelativeTime` | `((value: number, unit: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, options?: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A relative time such as "3 days ago". |
| `getDirection` | `(() => LumiDirection) \| undefined` | 否 | The current locale's text direction. |
| `getFallbackLocale` | `(() => string \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | The locale a missing translation falls back to, when there is one. |
| `getFormatConfig` | `(() => I18nFormatConfig) \| undefined` | 否 | The currency and time zone settings. |
| `getLocale` | `() => string` | 是 | The current locale, e.g. `zh-CN`. |
| `subscribe` | `((listener: () => void) => () => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Notifies when the locale changes; with it `$t` and component text follow the switch. |
| `translate` | `(key: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>, defaultMessage?: string) => string` | 是 | The text for `key` in the current locale, with `{name}` placeholders filled from `params`; `defaultMessage`, else the key, when there is none. |

Every record matching the filters, page after page through `getList`.

```typescript
fetchAllRecords<T = Record<string, unknown>>(context: LumiContext, client: QueryClient | undefined, options: FetchAllOptions): Promise<T[]>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `LumiContext` | 是 | `createLumi` 创建的共享上下文。 |
| `client` | `QueryClient \| undefined` | 是 |  |
| `options` | `FetchAllOptions` | 是 |  |

`context` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProvider` | `AccessProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Permission checks. |
| `agentBridge` | `AgentBridge \| undefined` | 否 | What the agent sees of the running pages and the client tools it acts through. |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |
| `getDataProvider` | `(name?: string) => DataProvider` | 是 | The data provider registered under `name`, `default` when left out; throws for a name that is not registered. |
| `http` | `HttpClient` | 是 | The request client, signed by `authProvider`. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Translation, the locale and formats. |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Changes pushed by the backend. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws notification cards. |
| `routerProvider` | `RouterProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Navigation and the current address. |
| `tenantProvider` | `TenantProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The current tenant. |
| `toastProvider` | `ToastProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws toasts. |
| `validator` | `Validator` | 是 | Checks form values against `rules`. |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 筛选条件数组。 |
| `maxItems` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Stops after this many records, so an export cannot run away. |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onProgress` | `((progress: { loaded: number; total?: number; }) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records asked for per request. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | 用于取消请求的 AbortSignal。 |
| `sorters` | `Sorter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 排序条件数组。 |

返回 `Promise<T[]>`。

### formatCurrencyValue

```typescript

```

### importRecords

Creates the records one by one, or in `createMany` batches when
`batchSize` is set, going on past refused ones, and refreshes the resource
once at the end. A refused batch counts all its rows as failed.

```typescript
importRecords(context: LumiContext, client: QueryClient | undefined, records: readonly Record<string, unknown>[], options: ImportRecordsOptions): Promise<ImportResult>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `LumiContext` | 是 | `createLumi` 创建的共享上下文。 |
| `client` | `QueryClient \| undefined` | 是 |  |
| `records` | `readonly Record<string, unknown>[]` | 是 |  |
| `options` | `ImportRecordsOptions` | 是 |  |

`context` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProvider` | `AccessProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Permission checks. |
| `agentBridge` | `AgentBridge \| undefined` | 否 | What the agent sees of the running pages and the client tools it acts through. |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |
| `getDataProvider` | `(name?: string) => DataProvider` | 是 | The data provider registered under `name`, `default` when left out; throws for a name that is not registered. |
| `http` | `HttpClient` | 是 | The request client, signed by `authProvider`. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Translation, the locale and formats. |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Changes pushed by the backend. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws notification cards. |
| `routerProvider` | `RouterProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Navigation and the current address. |
| `tenantProvider` | `TenantProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The current tenant. |
| `toastProvider` | `ToastProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws toasts. |
| `validator` | `Validator` | 是 | Checks form values against `rules`. |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `batchSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records sent per `createMany` call, for backends whose bulk create takes or refuses a batch as a whole. Without it each record goes through `create`, so every refused row is reported on its own. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onProgress` | `((progress: ImportProgress) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | 用于取消请求的 AbortSignal。 |

返回 `Promise<ImportResult>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `errors` | `{ row: number; message: string; }[]` | 是 | Rows the server refused, with its reason. `row` counts the file's records from 1: the header is not a record and blank lines are skipped, so it is the spreadsheet's line number minus the header only in a file without gaps. |
| `failed` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `processed` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `succeeded` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `total` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `uploaded` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | A backend import (`url`): percent of the file sent so far; the counts arrive with the answer. |

| `sign` | `UploadSignOptions \| undefined` | 否 | Uploads straight to object storage with a ticket from the backend, instead of through `url`. |

| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where the file is sent, relative to the API root; `/upload` by default. |
| `withCredentials` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Sends cookies; follows the auth provider's credentials when left out. |

### parseAgentStream

Reads Server-Sent Events from a byte stream and yields each `data:` payload
parsed as a chunk. Comments, `event:` and `id:` lines are ignored; a payload
spread over several `data:` lines is joined with line breaks, as in the SSE
specification. Stops at `[DONE]` or the end of the stream.

```typescript
parseAgentStream(body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, signal?: AbortSignal): AsyncGenerator<AgentChunk>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | `ReadableStream<Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>>` | 是 |  |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | 用于取消请求的 AbortSignal。 |

返回 `AsyncGenerator<AgentChunk, any, any>`。

### readMany

Reads several records: through `getMany` when the provider has it, else one
`getOne` per id. Hooks and the JSON `Query` share it.

```typescript
readMany<T = any>(provider: DataProvider, params: GetManyParams): Promise<ManyResult<T>>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | `DataProvider` | 是 |  |
| `params` | `GetManyParams` | 是 |  |

`provider` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `create` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: CreateParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Creates a record from `variables` and answers the saved one. |
| `createMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: CreateManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Creates several records in one request; without it they are created one by one. |
| `custom` | `(<T = any>(params: CustomParams) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | A request outside the resource conventions; the `request` action, `useCustom` and `useCustomMutation` need it. |
| `deleteMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: DeleteManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Deletes several records; without it they are deleted one by one. |
| `deleteOne` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: DeleteParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Deletes the record `id`. |
| `getApiUrl` | `(() => string) \| undefined` | 否 | The API root, for callers that build full addresses such as uploads. |
| `getList` | `<T = any>(params: GetListParams) => Promise<GetListResult<T>>` | 是 | One page of a resource, filtered and sorted, or all of it with `pagination: false`; `total` counts every match. |
| `getMany` | `(<T = any>(params: GetManyParams) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Several records by id in one request; without it each id is read with `getOne`. |
| `getOne` | `<T = any>(params: GetOneParams) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | One record by id. |
| `http` | `HttpClient \| undefined` | 否 | The client it sends through; uploads and the agent reuse its credentials. |
| `update` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: UpdateParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Updates the record `id` with `variables` and answers the saved one. |
| `updateMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: UpdateManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Applies the same `variables` to several records; without it they are updated one by one. |

`params` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | `ID[]` | 是 | 记录主键数组。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | 用于取消请求的 AbortSignal。 |

返回 `Promise<ManyResult<T>>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `T[]` | 是 | The records. |
| `raw` | `unknown` | 否 | The backend's whole answer. |

`context` 的字段：

| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |

### runExport

Hands the export file to `save` and returns it: the backend's when `url` is
set, else one written here from every matching record.

```typescript
runExport(context: LumiContext, client: QueryClient | undefined, input: RunExportOptions, save: TransferHost["save"]): Promise<TransferFile | TransferDownload>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

`context` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

| `agentBridge` | `AgentBridge \| undefined` | 否 | What the agent sees of the running pages and the client tools it acts through. |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |
| `getDataProvider` | `(name?: string) => DataProvider` | 是 | The data provider registered under `name`, `default` when left out; throws for a name that is not registered. |
| `http` | `HttpClient` | 是 | The request client, signed by `authProvider`. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Translation, the locale and formats. |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Changes pushed by the backend. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws notification cards. |
| `routerProvider` | `RouterProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Navigation and the current address. |
| `tenantProvider` | `TenantProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The current tenant. |
| `toastProvider` | `ToastProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws toasts. |
| `validator` | `Validator` | 是 | Checks form values against `rules`. |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filename` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Name of the saved file without its extension; the resource name by default. |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 筛选条件数组。 |
| `format` | `(string & {}) \| TransferFormat \| undefined` | 否 | `csv` or `json` for a file written here; with `url`, any name the backend knows (`xlsx`…). |
| `maxItems` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Stops after this many records, so an export cannot run away. |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `method` | `"GET" \| "POST" \| undefined` | 否 | `POST` (default) sends the values as JSON; `GET` as the query, `filters`, `sorters` and `columns` as JSON text. |
| `onProgress` | `((progress: { loaded: number; total?: number; }) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records asked for per request. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | 用于取消请求的 AbortSignal。 |
| `sorters` | `Sorter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 排序条件数组。 |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The backend builds the file: this endpoint (relative to the API root) is sent `{ filters, sorters, columns, format, ...meta }` and answers the file as a stream, in any format. Without it the records are loaded page by page and the file is written in the browser. |

返回 `Promise<TransferFile | TransferDownload>`。

| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |
| `getDataProvider` | `(name?: string) => DataProvider` | 是 | The data provider registered under `name`, `default` when left out; throws for a name that is not registered. |
| `http` | `HttpClient` | 是 | The request client, signed by `authProvider`. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Translation, the locale and formats. |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Changes pushed by the backend. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws notification cards. |
| `routerProvider` | `RouterProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Navigation and the current address. |
| `tenantProvider` | `TenantProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The current tenant. |
| `toastProvider` | `ToastProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws toasts. |

`file` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `string` | 是 |  |
| `name` | `string` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `batchSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records sent per `createMany` call, for backends whose bulk create takes or refuses a batch as a whole. Without it each record goes through `create`, so every refused row is reported on its own. |
| `columns` | `readonly TransferColumn[] \| undefined` | 否 | Maps the file's headings to record fields; headings are taken as field names when left out. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onProgress` | `((progress: ImportProgress) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | 用于取消请求的 AbortSignal。 |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The backend performs the import: the chosen file is uploaded to this endpoint (relative to the API root) as the form field `file`, with `meta` beside it, and the answer `{ data: { total, succeeded, failed, errors } }` is the result. Without it the file is read here and each record created. |

返回 `Promise<ImportResult>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `errors` | `{ row: number; message: string; }[]` | 是 | Rows the server refused, with its reason. `row` counts the file's records from 1: the header is not a record and blank lines are skipped, so it is the spreadsheet's line number minus the header only in a file without gaps. |
| `failed` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `processed` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `succeeded` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `total` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `uploaded` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | A backend import (`url`): percent of the file sent so far; the counts arrive with the answer. |

### runMutationMode

to offer Undo; without one it behaves as optimistic. The same function
serves the data hooks and the JSON `update` and `delete` actions.


| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

| `context` | `LumiContext` | 是 | `createLumi` 创建的共享上下文。 |
| `client` | `QueryClient` | 是 |  |
| `options` | `RunMutationOptions<T>` | 是 |  |

`context` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProvider` | `AccessProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Permission checks. |

### uploadImport

Uploads the file for the backend to import, reporting how much of it has
been sent, then reads the outcome from the answer and refreshes the
resource. A backend that answers no counts is taken to have accepted the file.

```typescript
uploadImport(context: LumiContext, client: QueryClient | undefined, file: File, input: RunImportOptions & { url: string; }): Promise<ImportResult>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `LumiContext` | 是 | `createLumi` 创建的共享上下文。 |
| `client` | `QueryClient \| undefined` | 是 |  |
| `file` | `File` | 是 |  |
| `input` | `RunImportOptions & { url: string; }` | 是 |  |

`context` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessProvider` | `AccessProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Permission checks. |
| `agentBridge` | `AgentBridge \| undefined` | 否 | What the agent sees of the running pages and the client tools it acts through. |
| `auditLogProvider` | `AuditLogProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The log of writes. |
| `authProvider` | `AuthProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The sign-in session. |
| `config` | `Readonly<LumiConfig>` | 是 | The config `createLumi` was given. |
| `getDataProvider` | `(name?: string) => DataProvider` | 是 | The data provider registered under `name`, `default` when left out; throws for a name that is not registered. |
| `http` | `HttpClient` | 是 | The request client, signed by `authProvider`. |
| `i18nProvider` | `I18nProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Translation, the locale and formats. |
| `liveProvider` | `LiveProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Changes pushed by the backend. |
| `notificationProvider` | `NotificationProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws notification cards. |
| `routerProvider` | `RouterProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Navigation and the current address. |
| `tenantProvider` | `TenantProvider \| undefined` | 否 | The current tenant. |
| `toastProvider` | `ToastProvider \| undefined` | 否 | Draws toasts. |
| `validator` | `Validator` | 是 | Checks form values against `rules`. |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `batchSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records sent per `createMany` call, for backends whose bulk create takes or refuses a batch as a whole. Without it each record goes through `create`, so every refused row is reported on its own. |
| `columns` | `readonly TransferColumn[] \| undefined` | 否 | Maps the file's headings to record fields; headings are taken as field names when left out. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onProgress` | `((progress: ImportProgress) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | 用于取消请求的 AbortSignal。 |
| `url` | `string` | 是 | The backend performs the import: the chosen file is uploaded to this endpoint (relative to the API root) as the form field `file`, with `meta` beside it, and the answer `{ data: { total, succeeded, failed, errors } }` is the result. Without it the file is read here and each record created. |

返回 `Promise<ImportResult>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `errors` | `{ row: number; message: string; }[]` | 是 | Rows the server refused, with its reason. `row` counts the file's records from 1: the header is not a record and blank lines are skipped, so it is the spreadsheet's line number minus the header only in a file without gaps. |
| `failed` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `processed` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `succeeded` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `total` | `number` | 是 |  |
| `uploaded` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | A backend import (`url`): percent of the file sent so far; the counts arrive with the answer. |

### useAgentApprovalMode

The approval mode every agent conversation shares: `ask` waits for the
reader before changes, `auto` acts at once. It is sent with each request so
the server applies the same rule to its own approvals, and kept between visits.

```typescript
useAgentApprovalMode(): [AgentApprovalMode, (mode: AgentApprovalMode) => void]
```

返回 `[AgentApprovalMode, (mode: AgentApprovalMode) => void]`。

### useAgentChat

A conversation with an agent endpoint. The reply streams in as an AI SDK UI
message stream; requests are signed by the auth provider through the data
provider's HttpClient, carry the configured agent headers and go through
the auth provider's error handling like any other Lumi request. One session
serves the hook and the JSON AgentSession component.

```typescript
useAgentChat(options?: UseAgentChatOptions): AgentChat
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `UseAgentChatOptions` | 否 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Extra fields sent with every request, e.g. the model. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The data provider whose API root and request client the chat uses. |
| `endpoint` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the configured `agent.endpoint`, then `/agent/chat`. |
| `headers` | `AgentHeaders \| undefined` | 否 | Extra request headers; the reader's credentials are added by the request client. |
| `onData` | `((chunk: AgentChunk) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called for each `data-*` chunk of the stream. |
| `onError` | `((error: Error) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called when a reply fails. |
| `onFinish` | `((event: AgentFinishEvent) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called when a reply ends, however it ended. |
| `prepareBody` | `((request: AgentRequest, body: Record<string, unknown>) => Record<string, unknown>) \| undefined` | 否 | Last change to the request body before it is sent. |
| `resource` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A DataProvider resource whose `getOne` returns a conversation's messages; refreshed after each reply. |
| `sessionId` | `string \| null \| undefined` | 否 | The conversation to open; a change switches to it, empty starts a new one. |
| `transport` | `AgentTransport \| undefined` | 否 | Replaces the HTTP transport, e.g. for a WebSocket or an in-page agent. |
| `ui` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Lets the agent see and act on the front end through the Lumi agent bridge: each request carries the UI snapshot (`ui`), the client tools (`clientTools`) and the approval mode (`approvalMode`), and calls to those tools run here. Defaults to true. |

返回 `AgentChat`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `answer` | `(questionId: string, answer: string \| string[]) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Answers a question the agent asked. |
| `approve` | `(approvalId: string, approved: boolean, reason?: string) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Answers an approval request, accepting or refusing it. |
| `edit` | `(messageId: string, text: string) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Rewrites a user message and answers from there. |
| `error` | `string \| null` | 是 | Why the last reply failed. |
| `id` | `string` | 是 | The conversation's id. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | 是 | True while the conversation's earlier messages load. |
| `messages` | `AgentChatMessage[]` | 是 | The conversation so far. |
| `reset` | `(next?: { id?: string \| null; messages?: AgentChatMessage[]; }) => void` | 是 | Starts a new, empty conversation. |
| `retry` | `() => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Asks again for an answer to the last user message. |
| `send` | `(input: AgentSendInput) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Sends a message; ignored while a reply is under way or when it is empty. |
| `session` | `AgentChatSession` | 是 | The session behind the chat, for calls the hook does not surface. |
| `skip` | `(questionId: string) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Skips a question the agent asked. |
| `status` | `AgentChatStatus` | 是 | `ready`, `submitted` while a reply is requested, `streaming` while it arrives, or `error`. |
| `stop` | `() => void` | 是 | Stops the reply under way, keeping what arrived. |
| `streaming` | `boolean` | 是 | True while a reply is requested or streaming. |

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `string` | 是 | The action, e.g. `list`, `show`, `create`, `edit`, `delete`, or a name of the app's own. |
| `params` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Extra conditions for a check on one record, e.g. `{ id: 12 }`. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource asked about, e.g. `orders` or `system/users`. |

### useChangeLocale

Returns `changeLocale(locale)`, which switches the i18n provider's locale.

