### useCreate

Creates a record through `create`, then refetches the resource's queries. Returns a mutation: `mutate(values)`.

```typescript
useCreate<T = any, V = any>(options: MutationOptions<SingleResult<T>, V>): UseMutationResult<SingleResult<T>, Error, V>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `MutationOptions<SingleResult<T>, V>` | 是 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `mutationMode` | `MutationMode \| undefined` | 否 | Updates and deletes only: `optimistic` shows the change at once and rolls it back on failure; `undoable` also waits `undoableTimeout` with an Undo notice before sending (Undo rejects with MutationUndoneError, unreported). Defaults to the context's `mutationMode`, else `pessimistic`. |
| `onError` | `((error: Error, variables: V) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Replaces the default report: without it a failure is shown as a danger toast. |
| `onSuccess` | `((data: SingleResult<T>, variables: V) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Called with the saved data once the write succeeded. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource written to; its lists, records and aggregates refetch after a success. |
| `undoableTimeout` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Milliseconds an `undoable` write waits for Undo before it is sent; 5000 by default. |

返回 `UseMutationResult<SingleResult<T>, Error, V>`。

### useExport

Exports a resource's matching records as CSV or JSON, or saves the file the backend builds at `url`, the same way as the `exportList` action.

```typescript
useExport(input: UseExportOptions): UseExportReturn
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseExportOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `readonly TransferColumn[] \| undefined` | 否 | The columns of the file, in order; every field of the records when left out. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filename` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Name of the saved file without its extension; the resource name by default. |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 筛选条件数组。 |
| `format` | `(string & {}) \| TransferFormat \| undefined` | 否 | `csv` or `json` for a file written here; with `url`, any name the backend knows (`xlsx`…). |
| `maxItems` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Stops after this many records, so an export cannot run away. |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `method` | `"GET" \| "POST" \| undefined` | 否 | `POST` (default) sends the values as JSON; `GET` as the query, `filters`, `sorters` and `columns` as JSON text. |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records asked for per request. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `save` | `((file: TransferFile \| TransferDownload) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Where the file goes; the browser download by default. |
| `sorters` | `Sorter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 排序条件数组。 |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The backend builds the file: this endpoint (relative to the API root) is sent `{ filters, sorters, columns, format, ...meta }` and answers the file as a stream, in any format. Without it the records are loaded page by page and the file is written in the browser. |

返回 `UseExportReturn`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | `Error \| undefined` | 否 | Why the last export failed. |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` | 是 | True while the export runs. |
| `progress` | `{ loaded: number; total?: number; } \| undefined` | 否 | Records loaded so far and their total; with `url`, bytes received and the file's size when the backend sends `Content-Length`. |
| `trigger` | `() => Promise<TransferFile \| TransferDownload \| undefined>` | 是 | Loads the records and saves the file; the newest call wins over an earlier one still loading. |

### useForm

A form over one record: loads it when `id` is given, keeps the edited values in page state, validates, and saves once through the same path as the `submitForm` action.

```typescript
useForm<T extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>>(input: UseFormOptions<T>): UseFormReturn<T>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseFormOptions<T>` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `draft` | `FormDraftOptions<T> \| undefined` | 否 | Keeps unsaved values in the browser so they can be restored later. |
| `groups` | `Record<string, FormGroupDefinition> \| undefined` | 否 | Named groups of fields, such as the steps of a wizard; `groupErrors` reports each group's errors. |
| `id` | `ID \| undefined` | 否 | With an id the record is loaded and the form updates it; without one it creates. |
| `initialValues` | `Partial<T> \| undefined` | 否 | Values of a new record. An edited record initializes once it has loaded, and later refetches leave the edits alone. |
| `meta` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource the form saves to. |
| `rules` | `unknown` | 否 | Business rules for the context's Validator, e.g. a JSON Schema. Leave it out when no validator is configured. |
| `valuesPath` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where the values live in page state; generated when left out. JSON elements bound to the same path edit the same form. |

返回 `UseFormReturn<T>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `draft` | `FormDraftControl \| undefined` | 否 | Draft controls, present when the `draft` option is set. |
| `errors` | `FormValidationIssue[]` | 是 | Every current error, the server's field errors included. |
| `firstError` | `(fields?: readonly string[]) => string \| undefined` | 是 | The path of the first field in error, among `fields` when given. |
| `groupErrors` | `Record<string, FormErrorGroup>` | 是 | The errors of each group in `groups`, with their count and first field. |
| `isDirty` | `boolean` | 是 | Whether the values differ from those loaded or last saved. |
| `isSubmitting` | `boolean` | 是 | True while a save is under way; another `submit` then sends nothing. |
| `reset` | `(next?: Partial<T> \| undefined) => void` | 是 | Returns to the initial values, or to `next`. |
| `setValue` | `(name: string \| keyof T, value: unknown) => void` | 是 | Sets one field; `name` may be a dotted path such as `items.0.sku`. |
| `setValues` | `(next: T \| ((current: T) => T)) => void` | 是 | Replaces every value, or derives them from the current ones. |
| `submit` | `() => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Validates, then saves; rejects when validation fails or the server refuses, with the errors already in `errors`. |
| `validate` | `(options?: FormValidateOptions) => Promise<FormValidationIssue[]>` | 是 | Validates all fields, or only `fields`, without saving; a wizard calls it on "Next". |
| `values` | `T` | 是 | The current values. |
| `valuesPath` | `string` | 是 | The page state path the values live at. |

### useImport

Creates the records of a CSV or JSON file with progress, or uploads the file for the backend to import at `url`, the same way as the `importList` action.

```typescript
useImport(input: UseImportOptions): UseImportReturn
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseImportOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accept` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | File types the picker offers, e.g. `.csv,.json`. |
| `batchSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records sent per `createMany` call, for backends whose bulk create takes or refuses a batch as a whole. Without it each record goes through `create`, so every refused row is reported on its own. |
| `columns` | `readonly TransferColumn[] \| undefined` | 否 | Maps the file's headings to record fields; headings are taken as field names when left out. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onFinish` | `((result: ImportResult) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called with the result once the import ended. |
| `pick` | `((accept?: string) => Promise<Pick<TransferFile, "name" \| "content"> \| undefined>) \| undefined` | 否 | Chooses and reads the file of a browser import; the browser's picker by default. |
| `pickFile` | `((accept?: string) => Promise<File \| undefined>) \| undefined` | 否 | Chooses the file of a backend import (`url`); the browser's picker by default. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The backend performs the import: the chosen file is uploaded to this endpoint (relative to the API root) as the form field `file`, with `meta` beside it, and the answer `{ data: { total, succeeded, failed, errors } }` is the result. Without it the file is read here and each record created. |

返回 `UseImportReturn`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cancel` | `() => void` | 是 | Stops after the batch under way. |
| `error` | `Error \| undefined` | 否 | Why the last import failed as a whole. |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` | 是 | True while the import runs. |
| `progress` | `ImportProgress \| undefined` | 否 | Records processed, accepted and refused so far; with `url`, the percent of the file uploaded. |
| `result` | `ImportResult \| undefined` | 否 | How the last import went: totals and the refused rows. |
| `trigger` | `(file?: Pick<TransferFile, "name" \| "content"> \| File) => Promise<ImportResult \| undefined>` | 是 | Opens the file picker, or imports the given file; resolves undefined when the reader cancels. |

### useInfiniteList

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `ids` | `readonly ID[] \| undefined` | 否 | 记录主键数组。 |
| `liveMode` | `LiveMode \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the context's `liveMode`, which is `auto` with a liveProvider. |

### useSelect

Options of a remote select: loaded page by page from a resource, searched on the server, narrowed by other fields, with the selected rows fetched by id when they are not on a loaded page.

```typescript
useSelect(input: UseSelectOptions): UseSelectResult
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseSelectOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `avatarField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A field holding the option's avatar image. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `debounce` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Milliseconds a typed keyword waits before it is searched; 300 by default. |
| `dependsOn` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Fields of `deps` whose values filter the options with `eq`, e.g. the city list by `province`. |
| `deps` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Current values of the fields in `dependsOn`. |
| `descriptionField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A field shown as the option's second line. |
| `enabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | `false` loads nothing, e.g. until the select opens. |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | Conditions every request carries. |
| `imageField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A field holding the option's picture. |
| `labelField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field shown; the first of `label`, `name`, `title`, `id` with a value when left out. |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Options loaded per request. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource the options come from. |
| `search` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A keyword kept by the caller; the options follow it when it changes. |
| `searchField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field a search filters with `like`; without it there is no server search. |
| `selected` | `ID \| ID[] \| null \| undefined` | 否 | The chosen value or values; rows not on a loaded page are fetched by id so their labels show. |
| `valueField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field used as the value; `id` by default. |

返回 `UseSelectResult`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hasMore` | `boolean` | 是 | Whether more options remain on the server. |
| `keyword` | `string` | 是 | The keyword being searched. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | 是 | The first page of the current search is pending or loading. |
| `loadingMore` | `boolean` | 是 | A further page is loading. |
| `loadMore` | `() => void` | 是 | Loads the next page. |
| `options` | `Option[]` | 是 | Rows of every loaded page, in server order. |
| `search` | `(keyword: string) => void` | 是 | Searches for a keyword, from the first page. |
| `selectedOptions` | `Option[]` | 是 | The rows behind `selected`, fetched by id when they are not among the loaded pages. |
| `setDeps` | `(values: Record<string, unknown>) => void` | 是 | Replaces the dependency values, reloading the options. |
| `total` | `number \| undefined` | 是 | How many options match the search, when the server says. |

### useTable

The state of a list page: page, page size, sorters, the rows of the current page and an optional aggregate. The JSON `ListPage` is built on it.

```typescript
useTable<T = any>(input: UseTableOptions): UseTableReturn<T>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseTableOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aggregate` | `UseTableAggregateOptions \| undefined` | 否 | An endpoint answering totals for the same filters: `{ url, method?, totalKey? }`. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | Conditions of the list; a change returns to the first page. |
| `liveMode` | `LiveMode \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the context's `liveMode`, which is `auto` with a liveProvider. |
| `meta` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onLiveEvent` | `((event: LiveEvent) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called for each event of the resource, in `auto` and `manual` mode. |
| `pagination` | `{ pageSize?: number; } \| undefined` | 否 | The first page size, 10 by default; the table keeps page and size in its state from there. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource listed. |
| `statePath` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where page, page size and sorters live in page state, so JSON elements can read them; a private path when left out. |
| `syncWithLocation` | `string \| boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Keeps page, page size and sort in the address's query (`page`, `pageSize`, `sort=field:asc,field2:desc`), so a reload, a shared link and back/forward restore them. A string prefixes the parameter names, for several synced tables on one page. Needs the context's routerProvider. |

返回 `UseTableReturn<T>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aggregate` | `TableAggregate \| undefined` | 否 | The aggregate's values, once they have loaded for the rows on screen. |
| `aggregateQuery` | `UseQueryResult<{ data: TableAggregate; }, Error> \| undefined` | 否 | The aggregate request, when `aggregate` is set. |
| `page` | `number` | 是 | The current page, counted from 1. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | 是 | Records per page. |
| `query` | `UseQueryResult<GetListResult<T>, Error>` | 是 | The `useList` result behind the rows, for loading and error states. |
| `rows` | `T[]` | 是 | The records of the current page. |
| `setPage` | `Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>` | 是 | Moves to another page. |
| `setPageSize` | `Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>` | 是 | Changes the page size. |
| `setSorters` | `Dispatch<SetStateAction<Sorter[]>>` | 是 | Changes the sort. |
| `sorters` | `Sorter[]` | 是 | The current sort, one entry per column. |
| `total` | `number` | 是 | How many records match, across all pages. |

### useTreeSource

Remote nodes for a hierarchical control. A full source reads the whole
resource once; a lazy one reads the root level, then each level as its
parent opens. Chosen values are echoed: their rows are read by ID and the
branches leading to them are loaded, so labels and paths resolve.

```typescript
useTreeSource(input: TreeSource, options?: { value?: unknown; }): TreeSourceState
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `{ resource: string; dataProviderName?: string \| undefined; meta?: Record<string, unknown> \| undefined; filters?: { field: string; operator: "null" \| "in" \| "eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| ... 6 more ... \| "nnull"; value: unknown; }[] \| undefined; ... 8 more ...; pageSize?: number \| undefined; }` | 是 |  |
| `options` | `{ value?: unknown; }` | 否 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `childrenField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field holding a row's nested children, for a backend that answers a tree. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filters` | `{ field: string; operator: "null" \| "in" \| "eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte" \| "like" \| "nlike" \| "nin" \| "between" \| "nnull"; value: unknown; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | Conditions every request carries. |
| `labelField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field shown; the first of `label`, `name`, `title` with a value, else the id, when left out. |
| `lazy` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Requests each level when its parent opens, instead of the whole resource once. |
| `leafField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A field telling whether a row has no children, so a lazy node shows no expander. |
| `meta` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Rows per request; 1000 by default. |
| `parentField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field linking a flat row to its parent; `parentId` by default. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource the nodes come from. |
| `rootValue` | `string \| number \| undefined` | 否 | The parent value of root rows; rows with an empty parent when left out. |
| `searchField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field a search filters with `like` on the server; a lazy source needs it to search. |
| `valueField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field used as a node's value; `id` by default. |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `unknown` | 否 |  |

返回 `TreeSourceState`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `TreeSourceNode[]` | 是 | The nodes loaded so far, as a tree. |
| `loadChildren` | `((node: { value: unknown; }) => Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Loads one node's children; only present for a `lazy` source. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | 是 | The first level (or the whole resource) is loading. |
| `search` | `((query: string) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Server search; only present for a `lazy` source with a `searchField`. |
| `searching` | `boolean` | 是 | A server search is under way. |
| `selectedNodes` | `TreeSourceNode[]` | 是 | The chosen nodes, also when their branch has not been loaded yet. |

### useUpdate

Updates a record through `update`, then refetches the resource's queries: `mutate({ id, variables })`.

```typescript
useUpdate<T = any, V = any>(options: MutationOptions<SingleResult<T>, UpdateVariables<V>>): UseMutationResult<SingleResult<T>, Error, UpdateVariables<V>>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `MutationOptions<SingleResult<T>, UpdateVariables<V>>` | 是 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `mutationMode` | `MutationMode \| undefined` | 否 | Updates and deletes only: `optimistic` shows the change at once and rolls it back on failure; `undoable` also waits `undoableTimeout` with an Undo notice before sending (Undo rejects with MutationUndoneError, unreported). Defaults to the context's `mutationMode`, else `pessimistic`. |
| `onError` | `((error: Error, variables: UpdateVariables<V>) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Replaces the default report: without it a failure is shown as a danger toast. |
| `onSuccess` | `((data: SingleResult<T>, variables: UpdateVariables<V>) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Called with the saved data once the write succeeded. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource written to; its lists, records and aggregates refetch after a success. |
| `undoableTimeout` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Milliseconds an `undoable` write waits for Undo before it is sent; 5000 by default. |

返回 `UseMutationResult<SingleResult<T>, Error, UpdateVariables<V>>`。

| `mutationMode` | `MutationMode \| undefined` | 否 | Updates and deletes only: `optimistic` shows the change at once and rolls it back on failure; `undoable` also waits `undoableTimeout` with an Undo notice before sending (Undo rejects with MutationUndoneError, unreported). Defaults to the context's `mutationMode`, else `pessimistic`. |
| `onError` | `((error: Error, variables: UpdateManyVariables<V>) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Replaces the default report: without it a failure is shown as a danger toast. |

### useUpload

Uploads files with progress and cancellation, through the data provider's client or straight to object storage with `sign`; defaults come from the context's `upload` option.

```typescript
useUpload(input?: UseUploadOptions): UseUploadReturn
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseUploadOptions` | 否 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `LumiContext \| undefined` | 否 | The Lumi context to use outside a Lumi provider. |
| `data` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Other form fields sent beside the file. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The data provider whose API root and request client are used. |
| `fieldName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Form field of the file; `file` by default. |
| `headers` | `UploadHeaders \| undefined` | 否 | Extra headers, or a function answering them; the reader's credentials are added by the request client. |
| `method` | `"POST" \| "PUT" \| "PATCH" \| undefined` | 否 | `POST` by default. |
| `sign` | `UploadSignOptions \| undefined` | 否 | Uploads straight to object storage with a ticket from the backend, instead of through `url`. |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | Aborts the upload. |
| `trustedOrigins` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Other sites an upload `url` may point at and be signed for; the API root and this site always are. |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where the file is sent, relative to the API root; `/upload` by default. |
| `withCredentials` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Sends cookies; follows the auth provider's credentials when left out. |

返回 `UseUploadReturn`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cancel` | `() => void` | 是 | Aborts the upload under way. |
| `error` | `Error \| null` | 是 | Why the last `upload` failed. |
| `progress` | `number` | 是 | Percent of the files `upload` is sending, 0 to 100. |
| `reset` | `() => void` | 是 | Clears the progress and the error. |
| `upload` | `(input: File \| File[] \| FileList, options?: UploadOptions) => Promise<UploadResult[]>` | 是 | Sends the files one after another and answers their results in order. |
| `uploadFile` | `(file: File, options?: UploadOptions & { onProgress?: (percent: number) => void; }) => Promise<UploadResult>` | 是 | Sends one file on its own: several may run at once, each with its own progress and `signal`. It leaves the shared progress/uploading/error alone. |
| `uploading` | `boolean` | 是 | True while `upload` runs; another call is refused until it ends. |

### validateForm

返回 `Promise<FormValidationIssue[]>`。

### withPageTranslations

The provider a page with its own `translations` renders under. A key is
looked up in the page's table for the active locale, then in `provider`
(the shared translations and Lumi's own, active then fallback locale),
then in the page's table for the fallback locale, then the default.
Everything else — locale, switching, formats — is `provider`'s.

```typescript
withPageTranslations(provider: I18nProvider, translations: I18nTranslations): I18nProvider
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | `I18nProvider` | 是 |  |
| `translations` | `I18nTranslations` | 是 |  |

`provider` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changeLocale` | `(locale: string, params?: unknown) => Promise<void> \| void` | 是 | Switches the locale. |
| `formatCurrency` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An amount in the configured currency and unit. |
| `formatDate` | `((value: I18nDateValue, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A date in the locale's form. |
| `formatDateTime` | `((value: string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An ISO 8601 UTC string shown in the configured time zone. |
| `formatNumber` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A number in the locale's form; components use `Intl` without it. |
| `formatRelativeTime` | `((value: number, unit: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, options?: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A relative time such as "3 days ago". |
| `getDirection` | `(() => LumiDirection) \| undefined` | 否 | The current locale's text direction. |
| `getFallbackLocale` | `(() => string \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | The locale a missing translation falls back to, when there is one. |
| `getFormatConfig` | `(() => I18nFormatConfig) \| undefined` | 否 | The currency and time zone settings. |
| `getLocale` | `() => string` | 是 | The current locale, e.g. `zh-CN`. |
| `subscribe` | `((listener: () => void) => () => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Notifies when the locale changes; with it `$t` and component text follow the switch. |
| `translate` | `(key: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>, defaultMessage?: string) => string` | 是 | The text for `key` in the current locale, with `{name}` placeholders filled from `params`; `defaultMessage`, else the key, when there is none. |

返回 `I18nProvider`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changeLocale` | `(locale: string, params?: unknown) => Promise<void> \| void` | 是 | Switches the locale. |
| `formatCurrency` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An amount in the configured currency and unit. |
| `formatDate` | `((value: I18nDateValue, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A date in the locale's form. |
| `formatDateTime` | `((value: string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An ISO 8601 UTC string shown in the configured time zone. |
| `formatNumber` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A number in the locale's form; components use `Intl` without it. |
| `formatRelativeTime` | `((value: number, unit: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, options?: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A relative time such as "3 days ago". |
| `getDirection` | `(() => LumiDirection) \| undefined` | 否 | The current locale's text direction. |
| `getFallbackLocale` | `(() => string \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | The locale a missing translation falls back to, when there is one. |
| `getFormatConfig` | `(() => I18nFormatConfig) \| undefined` | 否 | The currency and time zone settings. |

### DataProviderError

### translateDirectiveSchema

### AgentChat

```typescript
interface AgentChat
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

| `session` | `AgentChatSession` | 是 | The session behind the chat, for calls the hook does not surface. |
| `skip` | `(questionId: string) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Skips a question the agent asked. |
| `status` | `AgentChatStatus` | 是 | `ready`, `submitted` while a reply is requested, `streaming` while it arrives, or `error`. |
| `stop` | `() => void` | 是 | Stops the reply under way, keeping what arrived. |
| `streaming` | `boolean` | 是 | True while a reply is requested or streaming. |

### AuthProvider

Authentication provider: the one sign-in session of the app. It runs the
session requests itself (sign in and out, register, password reset, the
current user), decides how every other request carries the credentials
(`authorizeRequest`) and what a failure means (`onError`). Data providers
never handle credentials: they send through the HttpClient that asks it.

```typescript
interface AuthProvider
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authorizeRequest` | `((request: { url: string; method: string; }) => RequestAuthorization \| undefined \| Promise<RequestAuthorization \| undefined>) \| undefined` | 否 | Headers and fetch credentials for one request; called before each one an HttpClient sends. |
| `check` | `() => Promise<CheckResponse>` | 是 | Whether a session exists; asked before a protected route or manifest loads. |
| `forgotPassword` | `((params: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>) \| undefined` | 否 | Starts a password reset, e.g. by mailing a link to the account's address. |
| `getIdentity` | `(<T = any>() => Promise<T \| null>) \| undefined` | 否 | The current user, for the account menu and `useIdentity`; `null` when signed out. |
| `getPermissions` | `((params?: any) => Promise<unknown>) \| undefined` | 否 | The raw permission data, for `usePermissions`. Lumi's own checks ask the AccessProvider. |
| `login` | `(params: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>` | 是 | Signs in with the sign-in form's values, e.g. `{ username, password, remember }`. |
| `logout` | `(params?: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>` | 是 | Signs out and forgets the session. |
| `onError` | `((error: any) => Promise<AuthErrorResponse>) \| undefined` | 否 | What a failed data request means for the session, once `refresh` could not save it; `{ logout: true }` signs the reader out. |
| `refresh` | `(() => Promise<boolean>) \| undefined` | 否 | Renews expired credentials after a 401; `true` sends the request again. Concurrent 401s share one call. |
| `register` | `((params: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>) \| undefined` | 否 | Creates an account; a provider that also signs the new account in answers like `login`. Leave it out where accounts are assigned. |
| `updatePassword` | `((params: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>) \| undefined` | 否 | Sets a new password, with the reset link's token or the signed-in session. |

### DataProvider

Data + request provider (Lumi REST conventions, framework-agnostic).
All data access goes through this interface; it can be swapped for any REST / GraphQL / Mock implementation.

```typescript
interface DataProvider
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `create` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: CreateParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Creates a record from `variables` and answers the saved one. |
| `createMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: CreateManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Creates several records in one request; without it they are created one by one. |
| `custom` | `(<T = any>(params: CustomParams) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | A request outside the resource conventions; the `request` action, `useCustom` and `useCustomMutation` need it. |
| `deleteMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: DeleteManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Deletes several records; without it they are deleted one by one. |
| `deleteOne` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: DeleteParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Deletes the record `id`. |
| `getApiUrl` | `(() => string) \| undefined` | 否 | The API root, for callers that build full addresses such as uploads. |
| `getList` | `<T = any>(params: GetListParams) => Promise<GetListResult<T>>` | 是 | One page of a resource, filtered and sorted, or all of it with `pagination: false`; `total` counts every match. |
| `getMany` | `(<T = any>(params: GetManyParams) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Several records by id in one request; without it each id is read with `getOne`. |
| `getOne` | `<T = any>(params: GetOneParams) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | One record by id. |
| `http` | `HttpClient \| undefined` | 否 | The client it sends through; uploads and the agent reuse its credentials. |
| `update` | `<T = any, V = any>(params: UpdateParams<V>) => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Updates the record `id` with `variables` and answers the saved one. |
| `updateMany` | `(<T = any, V = any>(params: UpdateManyParams<V>) => Promise<ManyResult<T>>) \| undefined` | 否 | Applies the same `variables` to several records; without it they are updated one by one. |

### HttpClient

```typescript
interface HttpClient
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `string` | 是 |  |
| `download` | `(path: string, options?: HttpRequestOptions) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | The same request, for an answer that is a file: the response itself on 2xx, its body unread so the caller can follow the stream, else a `DataProviderError`. |
| `extend` | `(options: HttpClientExtendOptions) => HttpClient` | 是 |  |
| `fetch` | `(path: string, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | A signed fetch: on a 401 the auth's `refresh` runs once (shared by every request waiting on it) and the request is sent again. The response is returned as it is, whatever its status. |
| `getAuthProvider` | `() => RequestSigner \| undefined` | 是 | The provider signing these requests, if any. |
| `own` | `<E>(error: E) => E` | 是 | Marks a failure as this client's, so only a signed client's reaches the auth's `onError`. |
| `prepare` | `(request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Promise<HttpPreparedRequest>` | 是 | The request as this client sends it: credentials, locale, tenant, then `onRequest`. For transports `fetch` does not cover, such as an XHR upload, which hands the answer to `receive`. |
| `receive` | `(response: Response, request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Promise<Response>` | 是 | Runs `onResponse` on an answer to a prepared request. |
| `request` | `<T = any>(path: string, options?: HttpRequestOptions) => Promise<T>` | 是 | A signed JSON request; the parsed body on 2xx, else a `DataProviderError`. |
| `signed` | `boolean` | 是 | Whether the app's auth signs these requests and handles their failures. |
| `url` | `(path: string) => string` | 是 | The path joined onto `baseUrl`. |

### HttpClientOptions

```typescript
interface HttpClientOptions
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | `false` sends no app credentials and leaves failures to the caller: a 401 from such a backend does not sign the reader out. Its own key, if any, goes in `headers`. Defaults to `true`. |
| `authProvider` | `RequestSigner \| (() => RequestSigner \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | The app's auth provider (or just its signing part); a function is read on every request. |
| `baseUrl` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Root that relative paths join onto; absolute URLs pass through. |
| `fetcher` | `((input: RequestInfo \| URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>) \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the global fetch, read when a request starts. |
| `getLocale` | `(() => string \| null \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | Current UI locale, sent as `Accept-Language`. |
| `getTenant` | `(() => string \| null \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | Current tenant, sent as `tenantHeader`. |
| `headers` | `HttpHeaders \| undefined` | 否 | Headers on every request, below the per-request and auth ones; a function is read on every request. |
| `onRequest` | `((request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => HttpOutgoingRequest \| void \| Promise<HttpOutgoingRequest \| void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Last look at a request before it leaves, after the credentials, locale, tenant and JSON encoding: add or rewrite headers, sign the method, URL and body. Runs again for the resend after a 401 refresh. Change the request in place or return a new one. |
| `onResponse` | `((response: Response, request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Response \| void \| Promise<Response \| void>) \| undefined` | 否 | First look at the final answer, whatever its status: check its signature, decrypt it, or reshape it. Return another Response to replace it; throw to fail the request. |
| `parseError` | `((body: unknown, response: Response) => HttpErrorDetails) \| undefined` | 否 | Reads this backend's error body (parsed JSON, or `{}` when it is not JSON) into the one `DataProviderError` every caller handles. Defaults to `parseLumiError`. |
| `tenantHeader` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to `X-Tenant`. |
| `trustedOrigins` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Other sites that get the same treatment as `baseUrl` and the page, e.g. `["https://files.example.com"]`. A request to any other site goes out plain: without the reader's credentials, the tenant, the default headers or the hooks, and its 401 does not sign the reader out. |

### I18nProvider

Translation, the current locale and locale-aware formats. `$t` in page JSON
and every text a component ships go through it; `translate`, `changeLocale`

```typescript
interface I18nProvider
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

| `formatCurrency` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An amount in the configured currency and unit. |
| `formatDate` | `((value: I18nDateValue, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A date in the locale's form. |
| `formatDateTime` | `((value: string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | An ISO 8601 UTC string shown in the configured time zone. |
| `formatNumber` | `((value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A number in the locale's form; components use `Intl` without it. |
| `formatRelativeTime` | `((value: number, unit: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, options?: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string) \| undefined` | 否 | A relative time such as "3 days ago". |
| `getDirection` | `(() => LumiDirection) \| undefined` | 否 | The current locale's text direction. |
| `getFallbackLocale` | `(() => string \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | The locale a missing translation falls back to, when there is one. |
| `getFormatConfig` | `(() => I18nFormatConfig) \| undefined` | 否 | The currency and time zone settings. |
| `getLocale` | `() => string` | 是 | The current locale, e.g. `zh-CN`. |
| `subscribe` | `((listener: () => void) => () => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Notifies when the locale changes; with it `$t` and component text follow the switch. |
| `translate` | `(key: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>, defaultMessage?: string) => string` | 是 | The text for `key` in the current locale, with `{name}` placeholders filled from `params`; `defaultMessage`, else the key, when there is none. |

### LiveEvent

reader (or a job, or an agent's backend tool) changes them.

| `type` | `string` | 是 | `created`, `updated`, `deleted`, or a type of the backend's own. |

### PackedDocument

Packed documents: a page, manifest or theme sent as `{ "packed": "…" }`
instead of readable JSON, so its text does not show in a browser's network
panel. The value is the JSON text, raw-deflated, masked with a key when one
is set, and written as base64.

This hides a document from a casual look, nothing more: the browser unpacks
it, so a reader who steps through the page still reaches it. What a reader
must not learn has to stay on the server.

```typescript
interface PackedDocument
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `packed` | `string` | 是 |  |

### PackedDocument

| `sorters` | `Sorter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 排序条件数组。 |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The backend builds the file: this endpoint (relative to the API root) is sent `{ filters, sorters, columns, format, ...meta }` and answers the file as a stream, in any format. Without it the records are loaded page by page and the file is written in the browser. |

### SimpleAuthEndpoints

```typescript
interface SimpleAuthEndpoints
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `forgotPassword` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | POST with `{ email }` to start a password reset. Leave it out to offer none. |
| `login` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | POST with the login form; answers `{ data: { token?, user, permissions } }` (no token in cookie mode). |
| `logout` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | POST signed with the session; failures are ignored. |
| `me` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | GET signed with the session; answers `{ data: { user, permissions } }`. |
| `refresh` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | POST after a 401 to renew the session; answers `{ data: { token } }` in bearer mode, sets the cookie in cookie mode. Leave it out to sign the reader out on the first 401. |
| `register` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | POST with the sign-up form. Answering like `login` signs the new account in; answering without a session sends the reader to sign in. Leave it out where accounts are assigned, and no sign-up is offered. |
| `updatePassword` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | POST with `{ token, password }` from the reset link. |

| `csrf` | `SimpleAuthCsrf \| undefined` | 否 | Cookie mode: the anti-forgery cookie echoed in a header on writes. |
| `endpoints` | `SimpleAuthEndpoints \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `http` | `HttpClient \| undefined` | 否 | The client its own requests go through (for the locale, tenant or a test fetcher); one is created otherwise. |
| `loginPath` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where a signed-out reader is sent. |
| `mode` | `"bearer" \| "cookie" \| undefined` | 否 | `bearer` (default) keeps the token login returns and sends it as `Authorization: Bearer …`. `cookie` keeps nothing: the server's session cookie travels with `credentials: 'include'` and `me` tells who is in. |
| `permission` | `SimplePermissionFormat \| undefined` | 否 | How a `{ resource, action }` check reads the permission strings login returns. |
| `readCookie` | `((name: string) => string \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | Cookie mode: where `csrf.cookie` is read; defaults to `document.cookie`. |
| `storage` | `TokenStorage \| undefined` | 否 | Bearer mode: defaults to `globalThis.localStorage`; pass one for SSR or tests. |
| `tokenKey` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Bearer mode: storage key for the token. |

See `HttpClientOptions.onRequest`. |

| `unwrap` | `((body: any) => { data: any; total?: number; raw?: unknown; }) \| undefined` | 否 | Custom response unwrapping; defaults to the Lumi convention: data = body.data ?? body, total = body.meta.total |

### SimplePermissionFormat

Permission strings in the backend's own shape. A check builds
`format` (`{resource}{separator}{action}` by default), with each `/` of the
resource replaced by the separator: `system/users` + `delete` is
`system:users:delete`, or `system.users.delete` with `.`. A granted segment
`*` matches any one segment, and a trailing `*` everything below it, so
`system:*` covers `system:users:delete` and `*` grants all.

```typescript
interface SimplePermissionFormat
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | With `{resource}`, `{action}` and `{separator}`; `{action}{separator}{resource}` reads `delete:system:users`. |
| `separator` | `":" \| "." \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to `:`. |

### TenantOption

The tenant (workspace, team, store) the reader works in. Data requests

| `logo` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Image address shown beside the name. |
| `value` | `string` | 是 | What requests carry, e.g. in `X-Tenant`. |

### UploadSignOptions

Direct-to-storage upload (S3, OSS, COS, R2, MinIO…): the file never passes
through the backend. The backend is asked for a ticket, the file goes to
the address the ticket names, and the backend may be told when it is there.

```typescript
interface UploadSignOptions
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `complete` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Called once the storage accepted the file, relative to the API root: sent `{ name, size, type, ...ticket.complete }`, and what it answers (`{ data: { url, name?, size?, type? } }`) is the upload's result. |
| `data` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Extra values of the ticket request, e.g. `{ "folder": "avatars" }`. |
| `url` | `string` | 是 | Where the ticket is asked for, relative to the API root. Sent `{ name, size, type, ...data }` as JSON; answers an `UploadTicket` (in `data`). |

### UploadTicket

What the backend answers a ticket request with.

```typescript
interface UploadTicket
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `complete` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Values handed back to the `complete` request, e.g. the object key. |
| `fieldName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Form field of the file in a `POST` upload; defaults to `file`. |
| `fields` | `Record<string, string> \| undefined` | 否 | Form fields of a `POST` upload (key, policy, signature…), sent before the file. |
| `fileUrl` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The address the file will be read from; needed unless `complete` answers it. |
| `headers` | `Record<string, string> \| undefined` | 否 | Headers the storage expects, e.g. `Content-Type` or `x-amz-acl`; they must match what was signed. |
| `method` | `"POST" \| "PUT" \| undefined` | 否 | `PUT` sends the file as the body (presigned URL); `POST` sends a form (policy upload). Defaults to `POST` with `fields`, else `PUT`. |
| `url` | `string` | 是 | Where the file goes: a presigned URL, or the bucket's form endpoint. |

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |

| `firstError` | `(fields?: readonly string[]) => string \| undefined` | 是 | The path of the first field in error, among `fields` when given. |
| `groupErrors` | `Record<string, FormErrorGroup>` | 是 | The errors of each group in `groups`, with their count and first field. |
| `isDirty` | `boolean` | 是 | Whether the values differ from those loaded or last saved. |
| `isSubmitting` | `boolean` | 是 | True while a save is under way; another `submit` then sends nothing. |
| `reset` | `(next?: Partial<T>) => void` | 是 | Returns to the initial values, or to `next`. |
| `setValue` | `(name: keyof T \| string, value: unknown) => void` | 是 | Sets one field; `name` may be a dotted path such as `items.0.sku`. |
| `setValues` | `(next: T \| ((current: T) => T)) => void` | 是 | Replaces every value, or derives them from the current ones. |
| `submit` | `() => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Validates, then saves; rejects when validation fails or the server refuses, with the errors already in `errors`. |
| `validate` | `(options?: FormValidateOptions) => Promise<FormValidationIssue[]>` | 是 | Validates all fields, or only `fields`, without saving; a wizard calls it on "Next". |
| `values` | `T` | 是 | The current values. |
| `valuesPath` | `string` | 是 | The page state path the values live at. |

### HttpClientExtendOptions

What `extend` may change: the root, whether and by whom requests are signed, the default headers, the fetch, the error format.

```typescript
type HttpClientExtendOptions = HttpClientExtendOptions
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | `false` sends no app credentials and leaves failures to the caller: a 401 from such a backend does not sign the reader out. Its own key, if any, goes in `headers`. Defaults to `true`. |
| `authProvider` | `RequestSigner \| (() => RequestSigner \| undefined) \| undefined` | 否 | The app's auth provider (or just its signing part); a function is read on every request. |
| `baseUrl` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Root that relative paths join onto; absolute URLs pass through. |
| `fetcher` | `((input: RequestInfo \| URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>) \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the global fetch, read when a request starts. |
| `headers` | `HttpHeaders \| undefined` | 否 | Headers on every request, below the per-request and auth ones; a function is read on every request. |
| `onRequest` | `((request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => HttpOutgoingRequest \| void \| Promise<HttpOutgoingRequest \| void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Last look at a request before it leaves, after the credentials, locale, tenant and JSON encoding: add or rewrite headers, sign the method, URL and body. Runs again for the resend after a 401 refresh. Change the request in place or return a new one. |
| `onResponse` | `((response: Response, request: HttpOutgoingRequest) => Response \| void \| Promise<Response \| void>) \| undefined` | 否 | First look at the final answer, whatever its status: check its signature, decrypt it, or reshape it. Return another Response to replace it; throw to fail the request. |
| `parseError` | `((body: unknown, response: Response) => HttpErrorDetails) \| undefined` | 否 | Reads this backend's error body (parsed JSON, or `{}` when it is not JSON) into the one `DataProviderError` every caller handles. Defaults to `parseLumiError`. |
| `trustedOrigins` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Other sites that get the same treatment as `baseUrl` and the page, e.g. `["https://files.example.com"]`. A request to any other site goes out plain: without the reader's credentials, the tenant, the default headers or the hooks, and its 401 does not sign the reader out. |

### LiveMode

`auto` refetches what an event touches, `manual` only calls `onLiveEvent`,
`off` does not subscribe. An `auto` reader's refetch leaves the queries of
`manual` and `off` readers on the same resource alone.

### MutationMode

When a write shows on screen. `pessimistic` waits for the server;
`optimistic` changes the cached lists and records at once and puts them
back if the server refuses; `undoable` does the same and waits
`undoableTimeout` before sending, offering Undo on a notice meanwhile.

```typescript
type MutationMode = MutationMode
```

### LumiActivityFeed

### LumiAgentMentionPicker

The @ reference picker. A search field, a tab per kind of thing, and the
results with the match highlighted. Up/Down move through the results and
wrap, Left/Right (at the edge of the search) switch the kind, as do Tab and
Shift+Tab with `cycleTabs`, and Enter picks. A pick becomes a context item
in `value`. Static options are filtered here; when the host searches
remotely it passes `onQueryChange`, `loading` and `hasMore`, and the list
shows what it is given.

```typescript
LumiAgentMentionPicker(props: LumiAgentMentionPickerProps): ReactElement
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `props` | `LumiAgentMentionPickerProps` | 是 |  |

`props` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | 否 |  |
| `className` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `cycleTabs` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Tab and Shift+Tab switch the kind (wrapping) instead of moving focus. Only for a picker inside a popover that Escape closes; standalone, Tab must leave the field. Defaults to true inside PromptInput's @ menu. |
| `data-testid` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `emptyText` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `hasMore` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | More results exist past the end; scrolling to the end asks for them. |
| `loading` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `loadingMore` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `maxHeight` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Pixels; the result list scrolls beyond it. |
| `multiple` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Allow several picks; otherwise a pick replaces the previous one. |
| `onChange` | `((value: AgentContextItem[]) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `onLoadMore` | `(() => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Asked when the list is scrolled to its end while `hasMore`. |
| `onQueryChange` | `((query: string) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `onSelect` | `((item: AgentContextItem, picked: boolean) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | A pick, with the item it added or removed. |
| `onTypeChange` | `((type: string) => void) \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `options` | `{ value: string \| number; label: string; description?: string \| undefined; avatar?: string \| undefined; image?: string \| undefined; type?: string \| undefined; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | Results for the active tab. Without a remote source they are filtered by `type` and `query` here. |
| `placeholder` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `query` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The search text. Bind it to keep it in state. |
| `remote` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | The host searches; `options` are shown as given. |
| `type` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The active tab. Bind it to keep it in state. |
| `types` | `{ value: string; label: string; icon?: string \| undefined; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | The kinds of things to reference, shown as tabs, e.g. orders, articles, customers. |
| `value` | `{ id: string; label: string; kind?: "record" \| "file" \| "page" \| "selection" \| "data" \| undefined; icon?: string \| undefined; description?: string \| undefined; data?: Record<string, unknown> \| undefined; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | The picked references as context items; bind it to the PromptInput `context` so each pick becomes a chip. |

返回 `ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>`。

### LumiAgentPlan

The steps an agent intends to take, on the same timeline as its activity:
a summary line with the title and progress, then one row per step. The
running step shimmers, steps not started yet stay quiet, and a skipped or
failed step carries a status tag before its reason; the list folds from
the summary line.

### LumiAgentQuestion

A question the agent asks before it goes on. A single choice answers as
soon as an option is pressed (digit keys pick by number); several choices
are ticked and confirmed; a written answer is sent with Enter. Answered or
skipped, it folds to one line with the answer, which opens to change it.

### LumiApproval

A confirmation before a registered action runs. While pending it is a card:
what will happen in the reader's words, then what it covers (items to
narrow, product lines, label and value rows and a total) and the decision.
`running` locks the buttons while the action is in flight, `failed` keeps
the card open with the reason. Once decided it folds to one line with the
outcome, which opens to show what was decided.

### LumiChart

导入路径：`@duxweb/lumi-ui/charts`

Area, line and donut draw on the lazily loaded canvas engine; bars are
layout, solid rounded bars on a track measured against the largest reading,
so they need no engine. A bar is an amount, not progress: it never uses the
segmented progress meter. The readings
are always in the DOM: as text beside each bar, as the donut legend, and as
a screen-reader table for the canvas charts.

### LumiEmpty

Says why an area is empty and what to do next: a glyph on a soft tint, a
title, a quieter description and an optional way forward. `sm` stands in
for rows inside a table, card or panel; `md` for a whole page; `xs` is one
quiet line for option panels and narrow columns, so a dropdown stays short.

```typescript
LumiEmpty(props: LumiEmptyProps): ReactElement
```

| `className` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `data-testid` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | 否 | Plain text in JSON; a React host may pass several lines. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 4 \| 3 \| undefined` | 否 | Speaks the title as a heading of this level, for a state that stands in for a whole page or region. |
| `icon` | `string \| ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>> \| null \| undefined` | 否 | A HugeIcons name, or an icon element the host already holds. |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 记录主键。 |
| `role` | `"status" \| "alert" \| undefined` | 否 | `status` makes the message a polite live region, `alert` an assertive one; omitted, it is plain content. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "xs" \| null \| undefined` | 否 | `sm` inside a table, card or panel; `md` for a whole page or region; `xs` one quiet line for dropdowns and narrow columns. |
| `title` | `string \| null \| undefined` | 否 | Why the area is empty, e.g. `No orders yet`. |
| `tone` | `"success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "neutral" \| null \| undefined` | 否 | Tints the glyph: `danger` for a failure, `warning` for a blocked or offline state, `success` for a finished one. |

### LumiFragment

Grouping with no surface of its own. A bare React Fragment cannot carry the
protocol's `layout` props — the renderer refuses one that tries — so this
renders them: `stack` is a column, `split` puts the last child in an aside of

### LumiGrid

The React component of the JSON `Grid` element. Grid layout (1-6 columns), compatible with the json-render shadcn Grid; drops columns as its own width shrinks (each column stays at least 12rem), so it also works inside drawers, cards and embedded previews. `minColumnWidth` (px) instead fits as many columns as the width allows. `align: "stretch"` gives the items of a row one height, as for a row of cards.

### LumiImage

The React component of the JSON `Image` element. An image in a fixed `aspectRatio` frame (default 4/3; `auto` keeps its own) with a loading shimmer and an image-off fallback when it fails. `radius` follows the theme (md by default). `preview` makes it a button that opens the full-screen Lightbox. `width` caps it in px; `caption` prints below and labels the preview.

### LumiImageGrid

go through the same queue as `LumiUpload`, so each shows its own progress,
cancel and retry. Tiles reorder by pointer drag (a long press on touch) or
from the keyboard, the way Kanban cards do.

### LumiTable

The React component of the JSON `Table` element. Rows and columns with sorting, selection and cell kinds such as badge, tags and currency. `rowActions` elements render in each row of the `kind: "actions"` column with their own `on`; props read the row via `$item`, params via the bound `activeRow`. Otherwise the column's `actions` menu emits `rowAction`. `highlightField` tints rows whose field is truthy. While rows are selected, `bulkActions` show a selection bar; `bulkAction` binds the pressed value to `activeAction`.

### rowActionsRenderer

Draws a table's `rowActions` slot once per row inside a native repeat scope.

- Props read the row through `$item` and `$index`, e.g. a label, `visible` or
  `disabled` per row.
- Before a control's own `on` runs, `activate` receives the row, so the
  table's bound `activeRow` already holds it: action params read it with
  `{ "$state": "/table/row/id" }`. Native `$item` in action params is a state
  path, not a value, and only exists when the rows were bound with
  `$bindState` (`rowsPath`).

```typescript
rowActionsRenderer(nodes: ReactNode, activate: (row: Record<string, unknown>) => void, rowsPath?: string): ((row: Record<string, unknown>, index: number) => ReactNode) | undefined
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | `ReactNode` | 是 |  |
| `activate` | `(row: Record<string, unknown>) => void` | 是 |  |
| `rowsPath` | `string \| undefined` | 否 |  |

返回 `((row: Record<string, unknown>, index: number) => ReactNode) | undefined`。

### useBoundOrLocal

A bound prop writes through to the StateStore. An unbound one follows the
Spec until the reader changes it, then keeps that change locally. Exported
for registries that wrap these components (Admin's remote @ picker).

```typescript
useBoundOrLocal<T>(value: T | undefined, binding: string | undefined): [T | undefined, (next: T) => void]
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T \| undefined` | 是 |  |
| `binding` | `string \| undefined` | 是 |  |

返回 `[T | undefined, (next: T) => void]`。

```typescript
type ActivityFeedItem = { key: string; actor: string; action: string; avatar?: string | undefined; target?: string | undefined; context?: string | undefined; status?: { label: string; tone?: "success" | "brand" | "warning" | ... 4 more ... | undefined; } | undefined; timestamp?: string | undefined; dateTime?: string | undefined; }
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `string` | 是 | What they did, e.g. `approved`. Read as `actor action target`; a language with another word order places `{actor}` and `{target}` in the phrase. |
| `actor` | `string` | 是 | Who did it: the avatar's initials and the sentence's first strong word. |
| `avatar` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Avatar image; without it the initials show. |
| `context` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Second line, e.g. the project or record it belongs to. |
| `dateTime` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Machine-readable time for the `<time>` element, e.g. an ISO date. |
| `key` | `string` | 是 |  |
| `status` | `{ label: string; tone?: "success" \| "brand" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "neutral" \| "primary" \| undefined; } \| undefined` | 否 | A small badge on the second line, e.g. the outcome. |
| `target` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | What it was done to, in strong text. |
| `timestamp` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | When, as shown, e.g. `10 min ago` or `07:30`. |

---
title: "AgentSession"
description: "把一段对话连接到返回 AI SDK UI message stream（SSE）的智能体接口。"
---

把一段对话连接到返回 AI SDK UI message stream（SSE）的智能体接口。会话 `{ id, messages, status, error, streaming }` 写入 `statePath`：把 ChatThread 的 `messages` 和 PromptInput 的 `streaming` 绑定到它，用 `agentSend` 发送、`agentStop` 停止，并把 ChatThread 的事件（approve、reject、answer、skip、regenerate、edit、suggestion）交给 `agentEvent`。设置 `resource` 时，`sessionId` 指定的会话通过 DataProvider 加载，每次回复后刷新该资源。

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `statePath`（必填） | 会话写入页面状态的路径，如 `/chat`，内容为 `{ id, messages, status, error, streaming, loading }`；动作用 `session` 指向它。 | `string` |  |
| `endpoint` | 对话接口地址，返回 AI SDK UI message stream（SSE）；相对路径按 DataProvider 的 API 地址解析。 | `string` | `"/agent/chat"` |
| `sessionId` | 要打开的会话 ID；变化时切换并加载该会话，为空则开始新会话。 | `string \| null` |  |
| `resource` | 数据资源名，如 `orders`。DataProvider 据此拼出接口地址。 | `string` |  |
| `dataProviderName` | 使用哪个 DataProvider。只有一个时不用填。 | `string` |  |
| `body` | 每次请求附带的额外字段，如所选模型。 | `object` |  |

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：无
- 插槽：`default`


---
title: "AgentWorkspace"
description: "与返回 AI SDK UI message stream 的智能体接口对话的整页界面：会话列表、对话内容和输入框，共用一个 Lumi 智能体会话。"
---

与返回 AI SDK UI message stream 的智能体接口对话的整页界面：会话列表、对话内容和输入框，共用一个 Lumi 智能体会话。会话来自 DataProvider 的 `resource`（默认 `agent-sessions`）：它的列表填充会话列表，`getOne` 加载一个会话，每次回复后刷新。当前打开的会话记录在 `param` 查询参数中（默认 `session`），刷新后仍然保留。双栏布局下会话列表占用外壳的第二列，替代模块菜单；其他布局下页面单独用一列显示。把它作为页面根元素使用。

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | 对话接口地址，返回 AI SDK UI message stream（SSE）；相对路径按 DataProvider 的 API 地址解析。 | `string` | `"/agent/chat"` |
| `resource` | 数据资源名，如 `orders`。DataProvider 据此拼出接口地址。 | `string` |  |
| `dataProviderName` | 使用哪个 DataProvider。只有一个时不用填。 | `string` |  |
| `body` | 每次请求附带的额外字段，如所选模型。 | `object` |  |
| `param` | 记录当前会话的网址查询参数，刷新或分享链接时打开同一会话。 | `string` | `"session"` |
| `placeholder` | 没有值时显示的提示文字。 | `string` |  |
| `emptyTitle` | 还没有消息时的标题。 | `string` |  |
| `emptyDescription` | 还没有消息时标题下的说明。 | `string` |  |
| `suggestions` | 会话为空时输入框上方的推荐问题，点选即发送。 字段：`id?`、`label`、`prompt?`、`icon?` | `object[]` |  |
| `mentions` | 输入框的 @ 引用：`{ types?, options?, placeholder?, sources? }`。`sources` 按页签的 `value` 各对应一个 DataProvider 资源（`{ resource, labelField, descriptionField?, searchField? }`），选中的记录随下一条消息作为上下文发送。 字段：`types?`、`options?`、`placeholder?`、`sources?` | `object` |  |
| `commands` | 斜杠命令，每项 `{ value, label, description?, icon?, prompt? }`。有 `prompt` 的填入输入框，没有的把 `label` 作为消息发送。 字段：`value`、`label`、`description?`、`icon?`、`prompt?` | `object[]` |  |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：无
- 插槽：无


---
title: "Article"
description: "一篇可阅读的文章：标签、标题、导语、作者及日期和阅读时长、可选的封面图，然后是来自 Markdown 或已清理 HTML 的正文，使用 Prose 样式。"
---

一篇可阅读的文章：标签、标题、导语、作者及日期和阅读时长、可选的封面图，然后是来自 Markdown 或已清理 HTML 的正文，使用 Prose 样式。宽屏下，正文旁有一个列出 h2 和 h3 标题的目录，跟随阅读位置。`actions` 放在署名旁（编辑、分享）；`default` 放在正文之后，用于相关记录或评论。

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title`（必填） | 文章标题。 | `string` |  |
| `summary` | 标题下的导语。 | `string` |  |
| `author` | 作者 `{ name, avatar?, role? }`，`role` 显示在名字后，如“产品团队”。 字段：`name`、`avatar?`、`role?` | `object` |  |
| `publishedAt` | 发布日期的显示文字，如 `2026 年 11 月 8 日`。 | `string` |  |
| `readingTime` | 阅读时长的显示文字，如 `阅读约 6 分钟`。 | `string` |  |
| `tags` | 标题上方的标签。 | `string[]` |  |
| `cover` | 封面图 `{ src, alt?, caption? }`，`caption` 为图下说明。 字段：`src`、`alt?`、`caption?` | `object` |  |
| `content`（必填） | 正文。`format` 为 `markdown` 时按 Markdown 渲染，为 `html` 时先过滤再渲染，规则同 Markdown 与 Html 组件。 | `string` |  |
| `format` | 正文格式：`markdown` 或 `html`。 | `"markdown" \| "html"` | `"markdown"` |
| `toc` | 宽屏下在正文右侧显示目录，列出正文的二、三级标题，并随阅读位置高亮当前小节；少于两个标题时不显示。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `tocTitle` | 目录标题。 | `string` | `"本页目录"` |

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：无
- 插槽：`actions`、`default`

---
title: "CanAccess"
description: "只有权限提供者允许对 resource 执行 action 时才渲染子元素，否则渲染 fallback 插槽（判断期间什么也不显示）。"
---

只有权限提供者允许对 `resource` 执行 `action` 时才渲染子元素，否则渲染 `fallback` 插槽（判断期间什么也不显示）。设置 `resultPath` 时还会把 `{ can, reason, loading }` 写入状态：把按钮的 `disabled` 或任意元素的 `visible` 绑定到它，即可禁用或隐藏。

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resource`（必填） | 数据资源名，如 `orders`。DataProvider 据此拼出接口地址。 | `string` |  |
| `action`（必填） | 要判断的操作，如 `edit`、`delete`，交给 accessProvider 的 `can`。 | `string` |  |
| `params` | 一并传给 accessProvider 的附加参数，如 `{ "id": 7 }`。 | `object` |  |
| `resultPath` | 把 `{ can, loading, reason }` 写入页面状态的路径，让按钮等其他元素据此禁用或提示。 | `string` |  |

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：无
- 插槽：`default`、`fallback`

title: "DataGrid"

title: "FunnelChart"
description: "居中的转化漏斗：有序的阶段画成逐级变窄的色带，阶段间用梯形连接，颜色按调色板逐级变化。"
---

居中的转化漏斗：有序的阶段画成逐级变窄的色带，阶段间用梯形连接，颜色按调色板逐级变化。每个阶段显示数量和相对第一阶段的占比；每个连接显示相对上一阶段的转化率，悬停读数中显示流失。

## 参数

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stages`（必填） | 按顺序排列的阶段，每项 `{ key, label, value, display? }`，第一项最宽。每个阶段显示数量和占第一阶段的百分比；连接段上显示相对上一阶段的转化率，悬停可看流失数。 字段：`key`、`label`、`value`、`display?` | `object[]` |  |
| `ariaLabel`（必填） | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |
| `color` | 使用图表调色板里的第几种颜色（1–5），各阶段从全色逐级变浅。 | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5` | `1` |
| `scale` | 阶段宽度的换算：`sqrt` 按占比的平方根，首段大幅流失后小阶段仍清晰可读；`linear` 严格按比例。两种方式都有最小宽度（轨道的 24%），且宽度自上而下不会变宽。 | `"sqrt" \| "linear"` | `"sqrt"` |

- 事件：无
- 插槽：无

---
title: "Kanban"

卡片分列显示，可拖放或用键盘（Space、方向键、Space）移动。每张卡片在 `columnField`（默认 `status`）中指明所在列。`move` 时绑定的 `move` 为 `{ id, from, to, index, rank }`；用 `update` 保存 `to` 和 `rank`。`value` 来自 Query 数据，或用 $bindState 绑定；`add` 把列写入 `activeColumn`，`cardClick` 把卡片 id 写入 `activeCard`。

| `value`（必填） | 全部卡片，按看板顺序排列。每张卡片 `{ id, title, description?, tags?, assignee?, dueDate?, priority? }`，并用 `columnField` 字段说明所在列。可直接读 Query 的数据，也可以 写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 字段：`id`、`title`、`description?`、`tags?`、`assignee?`、`dueDate?`、`priority?` | `object[]` |  |
| `columnField` | 卡片里表示所在列的字段名。 | `string` | `"status"` |
| `rankField` | 卡片里的排序值字段名。移动时按新位置前后两张卡片算出中间值。 | `string` | `"rank"` |
| `move` | 最近一次移动 `{ id, from, to, index, rank }`。绑定到状态后，在 `move` 事件里用 `update` 保存 `to` 和 `rank`。 字段：`id`、`from`、`to`、`index`、`rank` | `object \| null` |  |
| `activeColumn` | 点击“添加卡片”按钮的列 value，`add` 事件触发前写入。 | `string \| null` |  |
| `activeCard` | 最近点击的卡片 id，`cardClick` 事件触发前写入。 | `string \| number \| null` |  |
| `today` | 判断逾期所用的“今天”，格式 `YYYY-MM-DD`。不填时使用当前日期。 | `string` |  |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |
| `readonly` | 只读：隐藏添加按钮，不能拖动或移动卡片。 | `boolean` | `false` |

---
title: "Query"
description: "挂载时、参数变化时读取数据；实时提供者推送了该资源的变更时也会重新读取（liveMode）。"
---

挂载时、参数变化时读取数据；实时提供者推送了该资源的变更时也会重新读取（`liveMode`）。结果 `{ data, total, loading, error }` 写入 `resultPath`，把显示用的属性绑定到这个状态路径即可。

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resource`（必填） | 数据资源名，如 `orders`。DataProvider 据此拼出接口地址。 | `string` |  |
| `dataProviderName` | 使用哪个 DataProvider。只有一个时不用填。 | `string` |  |
| `meta` | 原样传给 DataProvider 的附加参数，如自定义请求头或查询字段。 | `object` |  |
| `operation`（必填） | 读取方式：`list` 列表，`one` 单条，`many` 按多个 ID，`custom` 自定义地址。 | `"list" \| "one" \| "many" \| "custom"` | `"list"` |
| `id` | 记录 ID。填写时先按 ID 读取记录，保存时更新它；不填时是新建。 | `string \| number` |  |
| `ids` | `many` 时要读取的 ID 列表。 | `(string \| number)[]` |  |
| `pagination` | 分页参数 `{ page, pageSize }`；`false` 表示一次读全部。 字段：`page`、`pageSize` | `object \| false` |  |
| `filters` | 筛选条件，每项 `{ field, operator, value }`，会传给 DataProvider。 字段：`field`、`operator`、`value` | `object[]` |  |
| `sorters` | 当前排序，每项 `{ field, order: "asc" \| "desc" }`。 字段：`field`、`order` | `object[]` |  |
| `url` | `custom` 时请求的地址。 | `string` |  |
| `query` | `custom` 时附加的查询参数。 | `object` |  |
| `enabled` | 为 false 时暂不请求，常用于等待前一个条件就绪。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `liveMode` | 收到实时推送时的处理：`auto` 自动重新读取，`manual` 只触发事件不动缓存，`off` 不订阅。有 liveProvider 时默认 `auto`，自定义请求默认 `off`。 | `"auto" \| "manual" \| "off"` |  |
| `resultPath`（必填） | 把结果写入页面状态的路径，如 `/orders`，其他元素从这里读。 | `string` |  |

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：无
- 插槽：`default`

---
title: "ScheduleCalendar"

---

月视图和周视图的日程日历，事件显示为语义色块；月视图中一天放不下的事件收进“+N more”菜单。用 $bindState 绑定 `view` 和 `date`，驱动 Query 读取可见范围。`dayClick` 把 `YYYY-MM-DD` 写入 `activeDate`；`eventClick` 把事件 id 写入 `activeEvent`。星期名称和每周第一天跟随语言区域。

| `view` | 视图：`month` 月，`week` 周。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `"month" \| "week"` | `"month"` |
| `date` | 当前显示的月或周里的任意一天，`YYYY-MM-DD`。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `string` |  |
| `weekStartsOn` | 每周第一天：0 是周日，1 是周一……不填时按语言区域决定。 | `integer` |  |
| `locale` | 星期和月份名称使用的语言区域，如 `zh-CN`。不填时跟随界面语言。 | `string` |  |
| `today` | 高亮为“今天”的日期，`YYYY-MM-DD`。不填时使用当前日期。 | `string` |  |
| `startHour` | 周视图从几点开始显示（0–23）。 | `integer` | `7` |
| `endHour` | 周视图显示到几点（1–24）。 | `integer` | `20` |
| `maxEvents` | 月视图每格最多显示几条，其余收进“还有 N 项”菜单。 | `integer` | `3` |
| `activeDate` | 最近点击的日期 `YYYY-MM-DD`，`dayClick` 事件触发前写入。 | `string \| null` |  |
| `activeEvent` | 最近点击的日程 id，`eventClick` 事件触发前写入。 | `string \| number \| null` |  |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |
| `loading` | 为 true 时显示加载状态，并暂停交互。 | `boolean` | `false` |

---
title: "SettingsForm"
description: "绑定到一条记录的设置卡片。"
---

绑定到一条记录的设置卡片。`auto`（默认）通过 submitForm 保存每次改动：选择类控件在改变时保存，输入类字段在失焦或按 Enter 时保存，无效的值不提交。`manual` 加上放弃和保存按钮，用于需要确认的改动。把字段绑定到 valuesPath 下的路径。

## 参数

| `dataProviderName` | 使用哪个 DataProvider。只有一个时不用填。 | `string` |  |
| `meta` | 原样传给 DataProvider 的附加参数，如自定义请求头或查询字段。 | `object` |  |
| `title`（必填） | 设置卡片标题，也是卡片区域的读屏名称。 | `string` |  |
| `description` | 标题下方的一行说明。 | `string` |  |
| `id` | 记录 ID。填写时先按 ID 读取记录，保存时更新它；不填时是新建。 | `string \| number` |  |
| `valuesPath`（必填） | 卡片表单值存放在页面状态里的路径，子字段绑定到它下面。 | `string` |  |
| `initialValues` | 表单的初始值。编辑已有记录时会被接口返回的数据覆盖。 | `object` |  |
| `fields` | 从记录里取出的字段；只给 `id` 时按这些字段初始化表单。 | `string[]` |  |
| `rules` | 业务校验规则，按字段名组织，保存前执行。 | `unknown` |  |
| `saveMode` | `auto` 每次修改自动保存：开关、选择即时提交，文本和数字在失去焦点或回车时提交，校验不通过的值不提交；`manual` 显示“放弃 / 保存”，适合需要确认的修改（如密码、个人资料）。 | `"auto" \| "manual"` | `"auto"` |
| `columns` | 字段排成 1 列或 2 列。 | `1 \| 2` | `1` |
| `saveLabel` | `manual` 模式保存按钮文字。 | `string` |  |

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`saved`
- 插槽：`default`

---
title: "SkuEditor"
description: "规格（如颜色、尺码）用标签输入填写，下方为每种组合生成一行矩阵。"
---

规格（如颜色、尺码）用标签输入填写，下方为每种组合生成一行矩阵。`columns` 设置每行编辑什么（number、currency、text 或 select；默认价格、库存和编码），`labels` 修改界面文字，如改成型号或套装。修改规格时，仍然存在的组合保留原有值；列标题旁的按钮把第一行的值复制到所有行（默认数字和选择列有，可按列用 `fill` 设置）。

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `{ attributes: [{ name, values }], variants: [{ key, options, ...每列的值 }] }`，每列的值存在该列的 `key` 下（默认列为 `price`、`stock`、`sku`）。修改规格时按组合重新生成 variants，匹配的组合保留已填的值。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 字段：`attributes`、`variants` | `object` |  |
| `errors` | 字段错误，键为 `<name>.variants.<行>.<列 key>` 或 `<name>.attributes.<行>.name`，如 `sku.variants.1.stock`，通常绑定 submitForm 的 `fieldErrors`。规格变化导致行重排时，组合表的错误会被清除。 | `object` |  |
| `name` | 错误路径的前缀，与提交值里的字段名一致。 | `string` |  |
| `columns` | 组合表的列：`[{ key, kind, label?, required?, width?, prefix?, suffix?, precision?, min?, max?, placeholder?, options?, defaultValue?, fill? }]`。`kind` 为 `number`、`currency`、`text` 或 `select`（`options` 为 `[{ value, label }]`）；`currency` 列默认使用 `pricePrefix` 和 `precision`。`defaultValue` 用于新生成且未继承到值的组合。`fill` 控制列标题旁的“应用第一行到全部”按钮：数值、金额和下拉列默认显示，文本列（如条码、编码）默认隐藏，可用 `fill: true` / `false` 改写；少于两行或第一行为空时按钮不可用。`price`、`stock`、`sku` 不写 `label` 时用内置文案。 字段：`key`、`label?`、`kind`、`required?`、`width?`、`prefix?`、`suffix?`、`precision?`、`min?`、`max?`、`placeholder?`、`options?`、`defaultValue?`、`fill?` | `object[]` | `价格（金额，必填）、库存（数字，必填）、编码（文本）` |
| `labels` | 本实例的文案，组合表可以叫型号、套餐等：`title`、`count`（含 `{count}`）、`empty`、`fill`（列标题按钮的提示）、`filled`（填充后的读屏播报，含 `{count}`）、`attributes`（规格区标题）、`attributeName`、`attributeNamePlaceholder`、`valuesPlaceholder`、`attributeValues`（含 `{name}`）、`addAttribute`、`removeAttribute`（含 `{name}`）。未写的项使用内置文案；列名通过 `columns[].label` 修改。 字段：`title?`、`count?`、`empty?`、`fill?`、`filled?`、`attributes?`、`attributeName?`、`attributeNamePlaceholder?`、`valuesPlaceholder?`、`attributeValues?`、`addAttribute?`、`removeAttribute?` | `object` |  |
| `errorDisplay` | 错误的显示方式。默认 `tooltip`，组合表的行高保持一致；`inline` 把错误写在控件下方。 | `"inline" \| "tooltip"` | `"tooltip"` |
| `maxAttributes` | 最多几个规格维度。 | `integer` | `3` |
| `pricePrefix` | 金额列的前缀，如 `¥`。 | `string` |  |
| `precision` | 金额列保留的小数位数。 | `integer` | `2` |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`change`
- 插槽：无

title: "StatStrip"

---
title: "TreeFilter"
description: "侧栏树，把列表缩小到一个分支，放在 ListPage 的 aside 插槽中。"
---

侧栏树，把列表缩小到一个分支，放在 ListPage 的 `aside` 插槽中。把 `value` 绑定到 ListPage 筛选读取的状态路径（`eq`），或绑定 `subtree` 得到所选节点及其已加载的后代（`in`）。`null` 表示全部记录。节点来自静态 `items` 或 `source` 资源。

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | 要显示的条目列表。 | `object[]` |  |
| `source` | 从远程资源读取节点，如 `{ "resource": "categories", "labelField": "name", "lazy": true }`：默认按 `parentId` 组装成树，`lazy` 时逐级请求；已选值会按 ID 回显。设置后忽略静态节点。 字段：`resource`、`dataProviderName?`、`meta?`、`filters?`、`labelField?`、`valueField?`、`parentField?`、`childrenField?`、`leafField?`、`lazy?`、`rootValue?`、`searchField?`、`pageSize?` | `object` |  |
| `value` | 当前值。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `string \| number \| null` |  |
| `subtree` | 选中节点及其已加载的所有下级节点值，适合列表的 `in` 筛选；选“全部”时为 `null`。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `(string \| number)[] \| null` |  |
| `title` | 标题。 | `string` |  |
| `allLabel` | 清除筛选那一行的文字。 | `string` | `"全部"` |
| `showAll` | 在树上方显示“全部”行。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `searchable` | 树上方显示搜索框。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `defaultExpandAll` | 初始展开所有节点。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `loading` | 为 true 时显示加载状态，并暂停交互。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`change`
- 插槽：无


---
title: "组件总览"
description: "Lumi 的 138 个组件，按用途分组，每个组件一页：说明、JSON 示例和参数表。"
---

页面 JSON 里的 `type` 只能是下面这些组件。每个组件页有实时预览、可复制的 JSON 示例和完整参数表。

## 通用

| 组件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [`Button`](/components/ui/button/) | 触发一个动作。 |
| [`Badge`](/components/ui/badge/) | 语义色的简短状态或数量标签。 |
| [`Icon`](/components/ui/icon/) | 按名称显示图标：Lumi 名称如 `search`，或任意 HugeIcons 免费图标如 `delivery-truck-01`（或 `DeliveryTruck01Icon`）；不在内置集合里的名称首次使用时加载。 |
| [`Heading`](/components/ui/heading/) | 标题文字（h1-h4）。 |
| [`Text`](/components/ui/text/) | 段落文字，行宽适合阅读，与 json-render shadcn 的 Text 兼容。 |
| [`Avatar`](/components/ui/avatar/) | 一个人或账号：图片或首字母，底色按名字选取，没有描边。 |
| [`AvatarGroup`](/components/ui/avatar-group/) | 一组重叠的头像，表示一条记录涉及的人。 |
| [`CodeBlock`](/components/ui/code-block/) | 只读源码，支持 JSON、JavaScript/TypeScript（JSX/TSX）、CSS、HTML、Bash、Go、YAML、SQL 和 Markdown 的语法高亮；其他语言按纯文本显示。 |

## 布局

| 组件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [`Fragment`](/components/ui/fragment/) | 把子元素编成一组，不带外框。 |
| [`Card`](/components/ui/card/) | 卡片面板，可带标题、说明和头部图标。 |
| [`Stack`](/components/ui/stack/) | 弹性布局容器，与 json-render shadcn 的 Stack 兼容。 |
| [`Grid`](/components/ui/grid/) | 网格布局（1-6 列），与 json-render shadcn 的 Grid 兼容；自身宽度变窄时减少列数（每列至少 12rem），因此在抽屉、卡片和嵌入预览里也能用。 |
| [`Separator`](/components/ui/separator/) | 视觉分隔线。 |
| [`Frame`](/components/ui/frame/) | 通用盒子，提供内边距、底色和边框，在没有其他合适布局时使用。 |
| [`Page`](/components/connected/page/) | Admin 页面容器。 |
| [`PageHeader`](/components/connected/page-header/) | Admin 页面标题和操作插槽。 |
| [`PageFrame`](/components/connected/page-frame/) | 带组合插槽的 Admin 页面框架。 |

## 数据录入

| 组件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |

| [`Select`](/components/ui/select/) | 从列表中选一项，可搜索、可清除。 |
| [`MultiSelect`](/components/ui/multi-select/) | 从列表中选多项。 |
| [`Checkbox`](/components/ui/checkbox/) | 带文字的单个开/关选项。 |
| [`CheckboxGroup`](/components/ui/checkbox-group/) | 多选，所有选项同时可见。 |
| [`RadioGroup`](/components/ui/radio-group/) | 单选，所有选项同时可见。 |
| [`Switch`](/components/ui/switch/) | 开关一个设置，切换后立即生效。 |
| [`DatePicker`](/components/ui/date-picker/) | 日期，格式 `yyyy-MM-dd`。 |
| [`Cascader`](/components/ui/cascader/) | 分级选择，每级一列（地区 → 城市，分类 → 子分类）。 |
| [`TimePicker`](/components/ui/time-picker/) | 一天中的时间，格式 `HH:mm`（`seconds` 时为 `HH:mm:ss`）。 |
| [`DateTimePicker`](/components/ui/date-time-picker/) | 日期和时间，值为本地时间字符串 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm`，即 `datetime-local` 格式。 |
| [`DateRangePicker`](/components/ui/date-range-picker/) | 日期范围，值为 `[start, end]`（`yyyy-MM-dd`），与 dateRange 筛选的格式相同。 |
| [`Form`](/components/ui/form/) | 把字段编成一组，跟踪校验状态并触发提交事件。 |
| [`FormField`](/components/ui/form-field/) | 一个带标签的字段：根据 `fieldType` 或 `widget` 选择控件，并显示帮助文字和错误。 |
| [`Upload`](/components/ui/upload/) | 上传文件，显示进度，可取消和重试。 |
| [`CodeEditor`](/components/ui/code-editor/) | 编辑源码，高亮与 CodeBlock 相同，带行号、括号匹配、自动缩进和撤销。 |
| [`TagsInput`](/components/ui/tags-input/) | 以可移除标签块表示的文字标签。 |
| [`ImageGrid`](/components/ui/image-grid/) | 基于绑定的 `{ url, thumbnail?, alt? }[]` 值显示图片格子，第一张是封面。 |
| [`Segmented`](/components/connected/segmented/) | 同一份数据的少量互斥视图；用 $bindState 绑定 value。 |

| [`ChangeDiff`](/components/ui/change-diff/) | 展示一次改动的内容。 |

| [`AgentMentionPicker`](/components/ui/agent-mention-picker/) | @ 引用选择器：搜索框、按种类分的页签（`types`，如订单、文章、客户）和高亮匹配部分的结果，用方向键和 Enter 选取。 |
| [`AgentSessionList`](/components/ui/agent-session-list/) | 会话列表。 |

| [`Tooltip`](/components/ui/tooltip/) | 在唯一子元素（如图标按钮）上悬停或键盘聚焦时显示的简短提示。 |
