```json
  "elements": {
    "radiocards-1": {
      "type": "RadioCards",
      "props": {
        "options": [
          {
            "value": "starter",
            "label": "Starter",
            "description": "For one person.",
            "icon": "user",
            "extra": "$0"
          },
          {
            "value": "team",
            "label": "Team",
            "description": "Shared projects.",
            "icon": "user-group",
            "badge": "Popular",
            "extra": "$12"
          }
        ],
        "ariaLabel": "Plan",
        "value": { "$bindState": "/radiocards-1/value" }
      },
      "children": []
    }
  },
  "state": { "radiocards-1": { "value": "team" } }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | 当前值。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `string \| number \| boolean` |  |
| `defaultValue` | 初始值，只在没有绑定 `value` 时生效。 | `string \| number \| boolean` |  |
| `options`（必填） | 可选项列表，每项 `{ label, value, disabled? }`。 字段：`value`、`label`、`description?`、`icon?`、`badge?`、`extra?`、`disabled?` | `object[]` |  |
| `columns` | 每行最多几张卡片；卡片会窄于最小宽度时自动减少。不填时按最小宽度排满。 | `integer` |  |
| `size` | 尺寸：`sm` 紧凑，`md` 标准，`lg` 宽松。 | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` |
| `indicator` | 在卡片角落显示单选圆点。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `name` | 字段名，表单提交时作为这个值的键。 | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `invalid` | 标记为校验未通过，显示错误样式。通常由 FormField 自动设置。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `error` | 错误提示文字，显示在控件下方。 | `string` |  |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |

通用参数：

- `checks`：json-render 原生校验规则，如 `{ "type": "required", "message": "请填写" }`，提交或失焦时执行。
- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`change`
- 插槽：无

---
title: "RepeaterRow"
description: "Repeater 的 repeat 里的行模板。"
---

Repeater 的 `repeat` 里的行模板。子元素是可编辑的单元格，每个非计算列一个，按列的顺序排列。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "repeater-line",
  "elements": {
    "repeater-line": {
      "type": "RepeaterRow",
      "props": {},
      "children": [
        "repeater-line-product",
        "repeater-line-qty",
        "repeater-line-price"
      ]
    },
    "repeater-line-product": {
      "type": "Input",
      "props": { "ariaLabel": "Product", "value": { "$bindItem": "product" } }
    },
    "repeater-line-qty": {
      "type": "NumberInput",
      "props": { "ariaLabel": "Qty", "min": 1, "value": { "$bindItem": "qty" } }
    },
    "repeater-line-price": {
      "type": "NumberInput",
      "props": {
        "ariaLabel": "Price",
        "min": 0,
        "value": { "$bindItem": "price" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## 参数

没有专属参数，通过 children 使用。

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：无
- 插槽：`default`


---
title: "Repeater"
description: "基于绑定数组的可重复行（订单明细、联系人），以可编辑表格或卡片显示，支持添加、复制、删除、拖动手柄（或其方向键）排序、最少/最多行数、计算列、底部合计和单元格错误。"
---

基于绑定数组的可重复行（订单明细、联系人），以可编辑表格或卡片显示，支持添加、复制、删除、拖动手柄（或其方向键）排序、最少/最多行数、计算列、底部合计和单元格错误。在 Repeater 上写原生的 `repeat: { statePath, key }`，放一个 `RepeaterRow` 子元素，其子元素用 `$bindItem` 绑定单元格。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "repeater-lines",
  "elements": {
    "repeater-lines": {
      "type": "Repeater",
      "props": {
        "value": { "$bindState": "/lines/items" },
        "rowKey": "id",
        "min": 1,
        "max": 6,
        "ariaLabel": "Order lines",
        "columns": [
          { "key": "product", "label": "Product", "required": true },
          { "key": "qty", "label": "Qty", "width": 110 },
          {
            "key": "price",
            "label": "Unit price",
            "width": 140,
            "prefix": "$",
            "precision": 2
          },
          {
            "key": "total",
            "label": "Line total",
            "width": 130,
            "align": "end",
            "prefix": "$",
            "precision": 2,
            "compute": { "op": "product", "fields": ["qty", "price"] }
          }
        ],
        "summary": [
          { "key": "qty", "op": "sum" },
          { "key": "total", "op": "sum" }
        ],
        "newRow": { "product": "", "qty": 1, "price": 0 },
        "addLabel": "Add line"
      },
      "repeat": { "statePath": "/lines/items", "key": "id" },
      "children": ["repeater-line"]
    },
    "repeater-line": {
      "type": "RepeaterRow",
      "props": {},
      "children": [
        "repeater-line-product",
        "repeater-line-qty",
        "repeater-line-price"
      ]
    },
    "repeater-line-product": {
      "type": "Input",
      "props": { "ariaLabel": "Product", "value": { "$bindItem": "product" } }
    },
    "repeater-line-qty": {
      "type": "NumberInput",
      "props": { "ariaLabel": "Qty", "min": 1, "value": { "$bindItem": "qty" } }
    },
    "repeater-line-price": {
      "type": "NumberInput",
      "props": {
        "ariaLabel": "Price",
        "min": 0,
        "value": { "$bindItem": "price" }
      }
    }
  },
  "state": {
    "lines": {
      "items": [
        { "id": "l1", "product": "Wireless mouse", "qty": 2, "price": 39 },
        { "id": "l2", "product": "USB-C hub", "qty": 1, "price": 59 }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | 行数组，每行一个对象。配合元素级 `repeat` 渲染行，单元格用 `$bindItem` 绑定。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `object[]` | `[]` |
| `layout` | `table` 表格内联单元格，`card` 每行一张卡片。 | `"table" \| "card"` | `"table"` |
| `columns`（必填） | 列定义，每项 `{ key, label, width?, align?, required?, span?, compute?, precision?, prefix?, suffix?, errorDisplay? }`。`RepeaterRow` 的子元素按顺序对应没有 `compute` 的列；`compute: { op: "product" \| "sum", fields }` 由其他字段计算。 字段：`key`、`label`、`width?`、`align?`、`required?`、`span?`、`compute?`、`precision?`、`prefix?`、`suffix?`、`errorDisplay?` | `object[]` |  |
| `summary` | 合计行，每项 `{ key, op }`，`op` 为 `sum`、`avg`、`min`、`max` 或 `count`。 字段：`key`、`op` | `object[]` |  |
| `summaryLabel` | 合计行第一格的文字。 | `string` | `"合计"` |
| `min` | 最少保留几行，到达时不能再删除。 | `integer` | `0` |
| `max` | 最多几行，到达时不能再添加或复制。 | `integer` |  |
| `newRow` | 新增行的初始值，如 `{ "qty": 1 }`。数字单元格应给初值以保持受控。 | `object` |  |
| `rowKey` | 行身份字段名。新增或复制的行会自动生成值；与 `repeat.key` 一致才能在排序时保留焦点。 | `string` | `"id"` |
| `sortable` | 显示拖动手柄；手柄聚焦时可用 ↑/↓ 移动一行，Home/End 移到首行/末行。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `addable` | 显示“添加一行”按钮。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `removable` | 每行显示删除按钮。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `duplicable` | 每行显示复制按钮。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `addLabel` | 添加按钮的文字。 | `string` |  |
| `rowLabel` | 卡片布局的行标题，`{index}` 替换为从 1 开始的行号。 | `string` |  |
| `emptyText` | 没有行时显示的文字。 | `string` |  |
| `errors` | 字段错误，键是 `name.行号.字段`（如 `items.2.qty`），通常绑定 submitForm 的 `fieldErrors`。排序、删除时错误随行移动，编辑单元格后对应错误清除。 | `object` |  |
| `name` | 错误路径的前缀，与提交值里的数组字段名一致。 | `string` |  |
| `errorDisplay` | 单元格错误的显示方式。表格布局默认 `tooltip`：行高不变，消息浮在出错单元格上方；卡片布局默认 `inline`：写在控件下方。列上的 `errorDisplay` 可单独覆盖。 | `"inline" \| "tooltip"` | `表格 "tooltip"，卡片 "inline"` |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`change`
- 插槽：`default`

title: "Select"

```json
  "elements": {
    "select-7": {
      "type": "Select",
      "props": {
        "value": { "$bindState": "/select-7/value" },
        "options": [
          { "label": "Alpha", "value": "alpha" },
          { "label": "Beta", "value": "beta" }
        ],
        "ariaLabel": "alpha"
      },
      "children": []
    }
  },
  "state": { "select-7": { "value": "alpha" } }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | 当前值。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `null \| string \| number \| boolean` |  |
| `defaultValue` | 初始值，只在没有绑定 `value` 时生效。 | `null \| string \| number \| boolean` |  |
| `options` | 可选项列表，每项 `{ label, value, disabled? }`。 字段：`label`、`value`、`disabled?`、`description?`、`avatar?`、`image?` | `object[]` |  |
| `selectedOptions` | 已选值对应的选项，用于回显不在当前 `options` 里的值。使用 `source` 时自动提供。 字段：`label`、`value`、`disabled?`、`description?`、`avatar?`、`image?` | `object[]` |  |
| `clearable` | 有值时显示清除按钮。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `filterable` | 在下拉面板里显示搜索框，按标签过滤选项。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `loading` | 为 true 时显示加载状态，并暂停交互。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `loadingMore` | 正在加载下一页，列表底部显示加载行。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `hasMore` | 还有下一页；滚动到列表底部时触发加载。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `placeholder` | 没有值时显示的提示文字。 | `string` |  |
| `labelPrefix` | 选中值前显示的固定文字，如 `状态：`，适合放在工具栏里。 | `string` |  |
| `size` | 尺寸：`sm` 紧凑，`md` 标准，`lg` 宽松。 | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` |
| `appearance` | 外观：`outline` 描边，`filled` 浅色填充。 | `"outline" \| "filled"` | `"outline"` |
| `name` | 字段名，表单提交时作为这个值的键。 | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `invalid` | 标记为校验未通过，显示错误样式。通常由 FormField 自动设置。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |
| `source` | 从远程资源读取选项（Lumi Admin），如 `{ "resource": "members", "labelField": "name", "searchField": "name", "dependsOn": { "parentId": "/form/province" } }`：支持远程搜索、滚动加载、按 ID 回显已选值和联动。设置后忽略静态 `options`。 字段：`resource`、`dataProviderName?`、`meta?`、`filters?`、`labelField?`、`valueField?`、`descriptionField?`、`avatarField?`、`imageField?`、`searchField?`、`pageSize?`、`dependsOn?`、`clearOnDependencyChange?` | `object` |  |

通用参数：

- `checks`：json-render 原生校验规则，如 `{ "type": "required", "message": "请填写" }`，提交或失焦时执行。
- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`change`、`loadMore`
- 插槽：无

---
title: "Table"
description: "行列表格，支持排序、勾选、行操作，以及 badge、tags、currency 等单元格类型。"
---

行列表格，支持排序、勾选、行操作，以及 badge、tags、currency 等单元格类型。`highlightField` 为该字段为真值的行着色，如需要关注的记录。`rowActions` 插槽里的元素会画在 `kind: "actions"` 列的每一行，各自绑定自己的动作；属性里用 `$item` 读这一行，动作执行前这一行会写入绑定的 `activeRow`，参数里用 `{ "$state": "/table/row/id" }` 读取。不放插槽时，列的 `actions` 收进菜单，点击后写入 `activeAction` 并触发 `rowAction`。有 `bulkActions` 时，勾选行期间表头区域换成勾选操作栏；`bulkAction` 把点击的值写入 `activeAction`。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "table-16",
  "elements": {
    "table-16": {
      "type": "Table",
      "props": {
        "columns": [{ "field": "name", "label": "Name" }],
        "rows": [{ "name": "Lumi" }],
        "totals": [{ "label": "Total", "value": "$12.00", "emphasis": true }]
      },
      "children": []
    }
  }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rows`（必填） | 表格数据，每行一个对象。 | `object[]` |  |
| `columns`（必填） | 列定义，每项 `{ field, label, kind?, width?, sortable? }`。`kind` 决定单元格样式：`badge`、`tags`、`currency`、`date`、`entity`、`actions` 等。 字段：`field`、`label?`、`width?`、`sortable?`、`align?`、`kind?`、`valueMap?`、`toneMap?`、`descriptionField?`、`imageField?`、`labelField?`、`initials?`、`truncate?`、`wrap?`、`currency?`、`actions?` | `object[]` |  |
| `bulkActions` | 勾选行后出现的批量操作按钮，每项 `{ action, label, tone? }`。 字段：`value`、`label`、`icon?`、`tone?`、`disabled?` | `object[]` |  |
| `visibleColumns` | 只显示这些字段对应的列，不填显示全部。 | `string[]` |  |
| `columnOrder` | 列的显示顺序，按字段名排列。 | `string[]` |  |
| `sorters` | 当前排序，每项 `{ field, order: "asc" \| "desc" }`。 字段：`field`、`order` | `object[]` |  |
| `rowKey` | 每行数据里用作唯一键的字段名。 | `string` | `"id"` |
| `highlightField` | 该字段为真值的行会高亮，如标记异常的订单。 | `string` |  |
| `loading` | 显示加载遮罩，并保留上一页数据避免闪烁。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `empty` | 没有行时在表格里显示的空状态（同 Empty 的 `sm`）。写字符串即标题；写 `{ title, description?, icon? }` 可补充下一步提示和图标。`""` 表示不显示空行，由宿主在表格外自行绘制。 字段：`title`、`description?`、`icon?` | `string \| object` | `"暂无数据"` |
| `showHeader` | 设为 `false` 时隐藏表头，适合卡片里的紧凑列表；表头仍保留给读屏器。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `selectable` | 显示勾选列，可以多选行。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `selectedKeys` | 已勾选行的键。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `(string \| number)[]` | `[]` |
| `total` | 记录总数，显示在表格底部，如“共 128 条”。只在表格显示的是其中一部分时出现；与 `rows` 行数相同时不显示，免得重复眼前已有的信息。 | `number` |  |
| `summary` | 表格上方的简短摘要，如“共 3 条”。 | `string` |  |
| `totals` | 表格底部的合计行，每项 `{ field, value }`。 字段：`label`、`value`、`emphasis?` | `object[]` |  |
| `activeRow` | 最近一次点击的行数据，供行操作读取。通常绑定到状态。 | `object` |  |
| `activeAction` | 最近一次点击的行操作名。通常绑定到状态。 | `string` |  |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`sort`、`rowClick`、`rowAction`、`selectionChange`、`bulkAction`
- 插槽：`rowActions`

---
title: "TagGroup"
description: "绑定到数组的一行标签。"
---

绑定到数组的一行标签。没有 `options` 时每个值是一个可关闭的标签，移除即更新 `value`。有 `options` 时标签是可选的块，点击在 `value` 中加入或移除对应值（`multiple: false` 时最多选一个）。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "taggroup-37",
  "elements": {
    "taggroup-37": {
      "type": "TagGroup",
      "props": {
        "value": { "$bindState": "/taggroup-37/value" },
        "labels": {
          "design": "Design",
          "backend": "Backend",
          "ops": "Operations"
        },
        "ariaLabel": "Teams"
      },
      "children": []
    }
  },
  "state": { "taggroup-37": { "value": ["design", "backend", "ops"] } }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | 当前值。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `(string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `defaultValue` | 初始值，只在没有绑定 `value` 时生效。 | `(string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `options` | 可选项列表，每项 `{ label, value, disabled? }`。 字段：`label`、`value`、`tone?`、`icon?`、`disabled?` | `object[] \| null` |  |
| `multiple` | 允许选择多个。 | `boolean \| null` | `false` |
| `labels` | 没有 `options` 时各值的显示文字，如 `{ "vip": "VIP 客户" }`。不填时直接显示值。 | `object \| null` |  |
| `tone` | 语义色：`success` 成功，`warning` 警告，`danger` 危险，`info` 提示，`neutral` 中性。 | `"neutral" \| "primary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "brand" \| null` | `"neutral"` |
| `appearance` | 外观：`outline` 描边，`filled` 浅色填充。 | `"soft" \| "solid" \| "outline" \| null` | `"outline"` |
| `size` | 尺寸：`sm` 紧凑，`md` 标准，`lg` 宽松。 | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| null` | `"md"` |
| `closable` | 没有 `options` 时每个标签显示删除按钮，删除即从 `value` 移除。 | `boolean \| null` | `true` |
| `empty` | 没有数据时显示的文字。 | `string \| null` |  |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean \| null` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string \| null` |  |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`change`
- 插槽：无

title: "TagSelect"

```json
    }

}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | 当前值。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `null \| string \| number \| boolean \| (string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `defaultValue` | 初始值，只在没有绑定 `value` 时生效。 | `null \| string \| number \| boolean \| (string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `options`（必填） | 可选项列表，每项 `{ label, value, disabled? }`。 字段：`value`、`label`、`icon?`、`count?`、`disabled?` | `object[]` |  |
| `multiple` | 允许选择多个。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `clearable` | 有值时显示清除按钮。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `size` | 尺寸：`sm` 紧凑，`md` 标准，`lg` 宽松。 | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` |
| `name` | 字段名，表单提交时作为这个值的键。 | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `invalid` | 标记为校验未通过，显示错误样式。通常由 FormField 自动设置。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `error` | 错误提示文字，显示在控件下方。 | `string` |  |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |

通用参数：

---
title: "Tag"
description: "紧凑的标签，标注分类、人员或筛选条件，色调和外观与 Badge 相同。"

紧凑的标签，标注分类、人员或筛选条件，色调和外观与 Badge 相同。`closable` 加一个移除按钮，点击时触发 `close`。`checkable` 把它变成可切换的标签：绑定 `checked`（`{ "$bindState": "/path" }`），点击切换并触发 `change`。

```json
    }
  }
```

| `label`（必填） | 显示的文字。 | `string` |  |
| `tone` | 语义色：`success` 成功，`warning` 警告，`danger` 危险，`info` 提示，`neutral` 中性。 | `"neutral" \| "primary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "brand" \| null` | `"neutral"` |
| `appearance` | 外观：`outline` 描边，`filled` 浅色填充。 | `"soft" \| "solid" \| "outline" \| null` | `"outline"` |
| `size` | 尺寸：`sm` 紧凑，`md` 标准，`lg` 宽松。 | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| null` | `"md"` |
| `icon` | 图标名，来自内置 HugeIcons 图标集，如 `download`、`receipt`。 | `string \| null` |  |
| `avatar` | 标签前的头像 `{ name, src? }`，`name` 用于首字母和读屏名称。 字段：`name`、`src?` | `object \| null` |  |
| `dot` | 标签前显示语义色小圆点。 | `boolean \| null` | `false` |
| `closable` | 显示删除按钮，点击触发 `close` 事件。 | `boolean \| null` | `false` |
| `checkable` | 可切换的标签：点击翻转 `checked` 并触发 `change`。 | `boolean \| null` | `false` |
| `checked` | `checkable` 时是否选中。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `boolean \| null` | `false` |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean \| null` | `false` |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。

---
title: "Thinking"
description: "紧凑的工作状态条——旋转图标、阶段名称和已用时间——state 为 done 时变成对勾和总耗时。"
---

紧凑的工作状态条——旋转图标、阶段名称和已用时间——`state` 为 `done` 时变成对勾和总耗时。步骤和推理文字在下方展开：工作中展开，完成后折叠。除旋转图标外没有其他动效，读者偏好减少动效时旋转也停止。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "thinking",
  "elements": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "Thinking",
      "props": {
        "state": "done",
        "duration": 3800,
        "steps": [
          { "label": "Read order stats", "detail": "1,284 orders" },
          { "label": "Compared with last week", "status": "done" }
        ],
        "text": "Payments look like the cause, the order count held steady."
      },
      "children": []
    }
  }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `streaming` 处理中（转圈、计时、展开步骤），`done` 完成（对勾和用时，默认收起）。 | `"streaming" \| "done"` | `"streaming"` |
| `label` | 处理中显示的阶段名，如 `正在搜索订单`。 | `string` |  |
| `text` | 自由的推理文字（Markdown），展开后显示在步骤下方。 | `string` |  |
| `steps` | 步骤列表，每项 `{ label, detail?, icon?, status? }`，`status` 为 `running`、`done` 或 `error`；数据到达时逐步追加。 字段：`id?`、`label`、`detail?`、`icon?`、`status?` | `object[]` |  |
| `duration` | 用时（毫秒），完成后显示为“思考了 12 秒”；不填时使用组件看到的处理时长。 | `number` |  |
| `open` | 是否展开步骤；不填时处理中展开、完成后收起。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `boolean` |  |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

- 事件：`openChange`
- 插槽：无


---
title: "TimePicker"
description: "一天中的时间，格式 HH:mm（seconds 时为 HH:mm:ss）。"
---

一天中的时间，格式 `HH:mm`（`seconds` 时为 `HH:mm:ss`）。小时和分钟各一列；`step` 设置分钟间隔，`min`/`max` 限定范围。

```json
      },

    }
  },

}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | 选中的时间，格式 `HH:mm`。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `string \| null` |  |
| `defaultValue` | 初始值，只在没有绑定 `value` 时生效。 | `string` |  |
| `min` | 最早可选时间，`HH:mm`。 | `string` |  |
| `max` | 最晚可选时间，`HH:mm`。 | `string` |  |
| `step` | 分钟列的间隔，如 15 只显示 00、15、30、45。 | `integer` | `5` |
| `seconds` | 同时选择秒，值变成 `HH:mm:ss`。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `placeholder` | 没有值时显示的提示文字。 | `string` |  |
| `size` | 尺寸：`sm` 紧凑，`md` 标准，`lg` 宽松。 | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` |
| `appearance` | 外观：`outline` 描边，`filled` 浅色填充。 | `"outline" \| "filled"` | `"outline"` |
| `name` | 字段名，表单提交时作为这个值的键。 | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `invalid` | 标记为校验未通过，显示错误样式。通常由 FormField 自动设置。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |

通用参数：

---
title: "Timeline"
description: "按顺序排在一条连续竖线上的事件，每项有时间、状态和标题下方的可选详情。"
---

按顺序排在一条连续竖线上的事件，每项有时间、状态和标题下方的可选详情。时间放在标题那一行的末尾（`datePlacement: "below"` 时放在标题下方）。状态标记：complete 是成功色圆点，current 是品牌色圆环，upcoming 是空心圆环。`marker: "dot"` 画成动态流：每项一个对应色调的圆点。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "timeline-30",
  "elements": {
    "timeline-30": {
      "type": "Timeline",
      "props": {
        "items": [
          {
            "key": "created",
            "title": "Created",
            "description": "The record was created.",
            "status": "complete"
          },
          { "key": "review", "title": "Review", "status": "current" }
        ]
      },
      "children": []
    }
  }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items`（必填） | 事件列表，每项 `{ key, title, timestamp?, description?, status?, tone? }`。`status`：`complete` 成功色实心点，`current` 品牌色圆环加光晕，`upcoming` 空心灰环。 字段：`key`、`title`、`description?`、`timestamp?`、`tone?`、`status?` | `object[]` |  |
| `loading` | 为 true 时显示加载状态，并暂停交互。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `empty` | 没有数据时显示的文字。 | `string` |  |
| `marker` | `status` 用状态图标标记每项；`dot` 用小圆点，适合动态流。 | `"status" \| "dot"` | `"status"` |
| `datePlacement` | 时间的位置：`end` 放在标题同一行的最右侧（长标题在自己的列里换行，时间不会掉行）；`below` 放在标题下一行，适合详情页侧栏等窄列。 | `"end" \| "below"` | `"end"` |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：无
- 插槽：无


---
title: "ToolCall"
description: "智能体调用的一个工具或操作，显示为一行安静的时间线：图标（运行中为旋转图标）、名称、一行 summary 说明找到了什么，以及耗时。"
---

智能体调用的一个工具或操作，显示为一行安静的时间线：图标（运行中为旋转图标）、名称、一行 `summary` 说明找到了什么，以及耗时。有输入、输出或错误时可展开，以高亮 JSON 或错误文字显示。在 ChatMessage 内，连续的思考和工具调用收在一行活动记录下。

```json

    "tool-call": {
      "type": "ToolCall",
      "props": {
        "toolName": "customers.get",
        "title": "Read customer",
        "summary": "Avery Chen, 12 orders",
        "status": "success",
        "duration": 412,
        "input": { "id": 7 },
        "output": { "name": "Avery Chen", "orders": 12 }
      },
      "children": []
    }
  }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toolName`（必填） | 工具或已注册动作的名称，如 `orders.search`。 | `string` |  |
| `title` | 易读的名称，代替工具名显示在行首。 | `string` |  |
| `icon` | 图标名，来自内置 HugeIcons 图标集，如 `download`、`receipt`。 | `string` |  |
| `status`（必填） | `pending` 排队、`running` 运行中、`success` 完成、`error` 失败。 | `"pending" \| "running" \| "success" \| "error"` |  |
| `input` | 调用参数，保留在消息里供宿主和 Agent 使用，界面不显示。 | `unknown` |  |
| `output` | 返回结果，`success` 时展开可见，以高亮 JSON 显示；字符串原样显示（JSON 字符串会格式化）。 | `unknown` |  |
| `errorText` | 失败原因，展开后以危险色显示。 | `string` |  |
| `summary` | 名称后的一句简短结果，如 `找到 41 条失败回调`。 | `string` |  |
| `duration` | 耗时（毫秒），计入所在轮次顶部的总用时，行内不显示。 | `number` |  |
| `defaultOpen` | 初始是否打开，只在没有绑定 `open` 时生效。 | `boolean` | `false` |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

- 事件：无
- 插槽：无

---
title: "TreeSelect"
description: "下拉面板是 Tree 的选择框。"
---

下拉面板是 Tree 的选择框。默认单选；`multiple` 或 `checkable` 时绑定数组，并把前几个选中项显示为标签。`showPath` 在触发框里显示完整路径；`searchable` 在面板内过滤树。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "treeselect-1",
  "elements": {
    "treeselect-1": {
      "type": "TreeSelect",
      "props": {
        "items": [
          {
            "label": "Design",
            "value": "design",
            "children": [
              { "label": "Brand", "value": "brand" },
              { "label": "Icons", "value": "icons" }
            ]
          },
          {
            "label": "Engineering",
            "value": "eng",
            "children": [
              { "label": "Frontend", "value": "web" },
              { "label": "API", "value": "api" }
            ]
          }
        ],
        "searchable": true,
        "clearable": true,
        "showPath": true,
        "value": { "$bindState": "/treeselect-1/value" },
        "ariaLabel": "Team",
        "placeholder": "Choose a team"
      },
      "children": []
    }
  },
  "state": { "treeselect-1": { "value": "api" } }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | 要显示的条目列表。 | `object[]` |  |
| `value` | 当前值。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `null \| string \| number \| boolean \| (string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `defaultValue` | 初始值，只在没有绑定 `value` 时生效。 | `null \| string \| number \| boolean \| (string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `multiple` | 允许选择多个。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `checkable` | 面板里的树显示复选框，值为节点值数组。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `checkStrategy` | 勾选时上报哪些值：`all`、`parent` 或 `leaf`，同 Tree。 | `"all" \| "leaf" \| "parent"` | `"all"` |
| `searchable` | 面板顶部显示搜索框，按名称过滤并高亮。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `clearable` | 有值时显示清除按钮。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `loading` | 为 true 时显示加载状态，并暂停交互。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `showPath` | 输入框显示从根到选中节点的完整路径，而不只是节点名。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `separator` | `showPath` 时各级名称之间的分隔符。 | `string` | `" / "` |
| `defaultExpandAll` | 打开面板时展开所有节点。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `placeholder` | 没有值时显示的提示文字。 | `string` |  |
| `size` | 尺寸：`sm` 紧凑，`md` 标准，`lg` 宽松。 | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` |
| `appearance` | 外观：`outline` 描边，`filled` 浅色填充。 | `"outline" \| "filled"` | `"outline"` |
| `name` | 字段名，表单提交时作为这个值的键。 | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `invalid` | 标记为校验未通过，显示错误样式。通常由 FormField 自动设置。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |
| `source` | 从远程资源读取节点，如 `{ "resource": "categories", "labelField": "name", "lazy": true }`：默认按 `parentId` 组装成树，`lazy` 时逐级请求；已选值会按 ID 回显。设置后忽略静态节点。 字段：`resource`、`dataProviderName?`、`meta?`、`filters?`、`labelField?`、`valueField?`、`parentField?`、`childrenField?`、`leafField?`、`lazy?`、`rootValue?`、`searchField?`、`pageSize?` | `object` |  |

通用参数：

- `checks`：json-render 原生校验规则，如 `{ "type": "required", "message": "请填写" }`，提交或失焦时执行。
- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

- 事件：`change`
- 插槽：无


---
title: "Tree"
description: "可展开、折叠的层级列表。"
---

可展开、折叠的层级列表。`selectionMode` 选一个或多个节点；`checkable` 加三态复选框并绑定勾选的值（`checkStrategy`：所有节点、仅叶子或最上层父节点）。`searchable` 按文字过滤、高亮匹配并展开其祖先节点。宿主连接了数据来源时，没有 `children` 的节点按需加载。绑定 `expandedValue` 把展开的节点保存在状态中。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "tree-1",
  "elements": {
    "tree-1": {
      "type": "Tree",
      "props": {
        "items": [
          {
            "label": "Design",
            "value": "design",
            "children": [
              { "label": "Brand", "value": "brand" },
              { "label": "Icons", "value": "icons" }
            ]
          },
          {
            "label": "Engineering",
            "value": "eng",
            "children": [
              { "label": "Frontend", "value": "web" },
              { "label": "API", "value": "api" }
            ]
          }
        ],
        "checkable": true,
        "checkStrategy": "leaf",
        "defaultExpandAll": true,
        "value": { "$bindState": "/tree-1/value" },
        "ariaLabel": "Teams"
      },
      "children": []
    }
  },
  "state": { "tree-1": { "value": ["brand"] } }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | 要显示的条目列表。 | `object[]` |  |
| `value` | 当前值。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `null \| string \| number \| boolean \| (string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `defaultValue` | 初始值，只在没有绑定 `value` 时生效。 | `null \| string \| number \| boolean \| (string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `selectionMode` | `single` 单选、`multiple` 多选、`none` 只展开不选中。勾选模式下默认 `none`。 | `"none" \| "single" \| "multiple"` | `"single"` |
| `checkable` | 每行显示复选框；父节点随子节点呈全选或半选。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `checkStrategy` | 勾选时上报哪些值：`all` 所有勾选节点，`parent` 只报最上层的全选节点，`leaf` 只报叶子。 | `"all" \| "leaf" \| "parent"` | `"all"` |
| `expandedValue` | 展开中的节点值列表。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `(string \| number \| boolean)[]` |  |
| `defaultExpandedValue` | 初始展开的节点值。 | `(string \| number \| boolean)[]` | `[]` |
| `defaultExpandAll` | 初始展开所有有子节点的节点；节点稍后从远程到达时同样生效。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `searchable` | 顶部显示搜索框，高亮匹配并展开其祖先节点。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `searchPlaceholder` | 搜索框的提示文字。 | `string` |  |
| `showLine` | 显示层级引导线。 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `loading` | 为 true 时显示加载状态，并暂停交互。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `empty` | 没有数据时显示的文字。 | `string` |  |
| `size` | 尺寸：`sm` 紧凑，`md` 标准，`lg` 宽松。 | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` |
| `name` | 字段名，表单提交时作为这个值的键。 | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `invalid` | 标记为校验未通过，显示错误样式。通常由 FormField 自动设置。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |
| `source` | 从远程资源读取节点，如 `{ "resource": "categories", "labelField": "name", "lazy": true }`：默认按 `parentId` 组装成树，`lazy` 时逐级请求；已选值会按 ID 回显。设置后忽略静态节点。 字段：`resource`、`dataProviderName?`、`meta?`、`filters?`、`labelField?`、`valueField?`、`parentField?`、`childrenField?`、`leafField?`、`lazy?`、`rootValue?`、`searchField?`、`pageSize?` | `object` |  |

通用参数：

- `checks`：json-render 原生校验规则，如 `{ "type": "required", "message": "请填写" }`，提交或失焦时执行。
- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`change`、`expandedChange`
- 插槽：无


---
title: "Upload"
description: "上传文件，显示进度，可取消和重试。"
---

上传文件，显示进度，可取消和重试。上传本身由宿主服务完成。

## 示例

```json
{
  "root": "upload-23",
  "elements": {
    "upload-23": {
      "type": "Upload",
      "props": {
        "value": { "$bindState": "/upload-23/value" },
        "multiple": true,
        "ariaLabel": "Upload example"
      },
      "children": []
    }
  },
  "state": { "upload-23": { "value": [] } }
}
```

## 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | 已上传文件的地址列表。写成 `{ "$bindState": "/路径" }` 即与页面状态双向绑定。 | `string[]` | `[]` |
| `defaultValue` | 初始值，只在没有绑定 `value` 时生效。 | `string[]` |  |
| `variant` | `dropzone` 虚线拖放区加文件列表，`button` 紧凑按钮，`image` 单张头像/封面图块。 | `"dropzone" \| "button" \| "image"` | `"dropzone"` |
| `shape` | `image` 样式的图块形状：`square` 方形，`circle` 圆形（头像）。 | `"square" \| "circle"` | `"square"` |
| `accept` | 允许的文件类型，同原生 `accept`，如 `image/*,.pdf`。 | `string` |  |
| `multiple` | 允许选择多个。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `maxFiles` | `multiple` 时最多保存几个文件，超出的文件直接拒绝。 | `integer` |  |
| `maxSize` | 单个文件的最大字节数，超出会提示并拒绝。 | `number` |  |
| `hint` | 替换自动生成的“类型 · 大小上限”说明文字。 | `string` |  |
| `preview` | 显示已上传图片的缩略图。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `loading` | 为 true 时显示加载状态，并暂停交互。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `progress` | 当前上传进度（0–100），通常由上传服务写入。 | `number` |  |
| `error` | 错误提示文字，显示在控件下方。 | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | 禁用，不可操作。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `readonly` | 只读：可以查看和复制，不能修改。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `invalid` | 标记为校验未通过，显示错误样式。通常由 FormField 自动设置。 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ariaLabel` | 给读屏软件的名称。没有可见标签时必须填写。 | `string` |  |
| `upload` | 上传参数，如 `{ url, fieldName }`，交给 Lumi 上传服务；`sign` 用于直传对象存储，见 [直传对象存储](/guide/backend-files/#直传对象存储)。 字段：`sign?`、`url?`、`method?`、`fieldName?`、`data?`、`dataProviderName?` | `object` |  |

通用参数：

- `className`：附加的 CSS 类名，只在宿主自定义样式时使用。
- `data-testid`：测试定位用的标识，不影响显示。
- `aria-label`：原生 aria-label，等同于 `ariaLabel`。

## 事件与插槽

- 事件：`change`
- 插槽：无


---
title: "useAgentApprovalMode"
description: "useAgentApprovalMode React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

The approval mode every agent conversation shares: `ask` waits for the
reader before changes, `auto` acts at once. It is sent with each request so
the server applies the same rule to its own approvals, and kept between visits.

```typescript
useAgentApprovalMode(): [AgentApprovalMode, (mode: AgentApprovalMode) => void]
```

返回 `[AgentApprovalMode, (mode: AgentApprovalMode) => void]`。


---
title: "useAgentChat"
description: "useAgentChat React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

A conversation with an agent endpoint. The reply streams in as an AI SDK UI
message stream; requests are signed by the auth provider through the data
provider's HttpClient, carry the configured agent headers and go through
the auth provider's error handling like any other Lumi request. One session
serves the hook and the JSON AgentSession component.

```typescript
useAgentChat(options?: UseAgentChatOptions): AgentChat
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `UseAgentChatOptions` | 否 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Extra fields sent with every request, e.g. the model. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The data provider whose API root and request client the chat uses. |
| `endpoint` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the configured `agent.endpoint`, then `/agent/chat`. |
| `headers` | `AgentHeaders \| undefined` | 否 | Extra request headers; the reader's credentials are added by the request client. |
| `onData` | `((chunk: AgentChunk) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called for each `data-*` chunk of the stream. |
| `onError` | `((error: Error) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called when a reply fails. |
| `onFinish` | `((event: AgentFinishEvent) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called when a reply ends, however it ended. |
| `prepareBody` | `((request: AgentRequest, body: Record<string, unknown>) => Record<string, unknown>) \| undefined` | 否 | Last change to the request body before it is sent. |
| `resource` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A DataProvider resource whose `getOne` returns a conversation's messages; refreshed after each reply. |
| `sessionId` | `string \| null \| undefined` | 否 | The conversation to open; a change switches to it, empty starts a new one. |
| `transport` | `AgentTransport \| undefined` | 否 | Replaces the HTTP transport, e.g. for a WebSocket or an in-page agent. |
| `ui` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Lets the agent see and act on the front end through the Lumi agent bridge: each request carries the UI snapshot (`ui`), the client tools (`clientTools`) and the approval mode (`approvalMode`), and calls to those tools run here. Defaults to true. |

返回 `AgentChat`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `answer` | `(questionId: string, answer: string \| string[]) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Answers a question the agent asked. |
| `approve` | `(approvalId: string, approved: boolean, reason?: string) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Answers an approval request, accepting or refusing it. |
| `edit` | `(messageId: string, text: string) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Rewrites a user message and answers from there. |
| `error` | `string \| null` | 是 | Why the last reply failed. |
| `id` | `string` | 是 | The conversation's id. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | 是 | True while the conversation's earlier messages load. |
| `messages` | `AgentChatMessage[]` | 是 | The conversation so far. |
| `reset` | `(next?: { id?: string \| null; messages?: AgentChatMessage[]; }) => void` | 是 | Starts a new, empty conversation. |
| `retry` | `() => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Asks again for an answer to the last user message. |
| `send` | `(input: AgentSendInput) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Sends a message; ignored while a reply is under way or when it is empty. |
| `session` | `AgentChatSession` | 是 | The session behind the chat, for calls the hook does not surface. |
| `skip` | `(questionId: string) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Skips a question the agent asked. |
| `status` | `AgentChatStatus` | 是 | `ready`, `submitted` while a reply is requested, `streaming` while it arrives, or `error`. |
| `stop` | `() => void` | 是 | Stops the reply under way, keeping what arrived. |
| `streaming` | `boolean` | 是 | True while a reply is requested or streaming. |

title: "useCreateMany"
description: "useCreateMany React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"

Creates several records: one `createMany` call when the provider has it, else one `create` per record.

```typescript
useCreateMany<T = any, V = any>(options: MutationOptions<ManyResult<T>, V[]>): UseMutationResult<ManyResult<T>, Error, V[]>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `MutationOptions<ManyResult<T>, V[]>` | 是 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `mutationMode` | `MutationMode \| undefined` | 否 | Updates and deletes only: `optimistic` shows the change at once and rolls it back on failure; `undoable` also waits `undoableTimeout` with an Undo notice before sending (Undo rejects with MutationUndoneError, unreported). Defaults to the context's `mutationMode`, else `pessimistic`. |
| `onError` | `((error: Error, variables: V[]) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Replaces the default report: without it a failure is shown as a danger toast. |
| `onSuccess` | `((data: ManyResult<T>, variables: V[]) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Called with the saved data once the write succeeded. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource written to; its lists, records and aggregates refetch after a success. |
| `undoableTimeout` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Milliseconds an `undoable` write waits for Undo before it is sent; 5000 by default. |

返回 `UseMutationResult<ManyResult<T>, Error, V[]>`。

| `options` | `MutationOptions<SingleResult<T>, DeleteVariables<V>>` | 是 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `mutationMode` | `MutationMode \| undefined` | 否 | Updates and deletes only: `optimistic` shows the change at once and rolls it back on failure; `undoable` also waits `undoableTimeout` with an Undo notice before sending (Undo rejects with MutationUndoneError, unreported). Defaults to the context's `mutationMode`, else `pessimistic`. |
| `onError` | `((error: Error, variables: DeleteVariables<V>) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Replaces the default report: without it a failure is shown as a danger toast. |
| `onSuccess` | `((data: SingleResult<T>, variables: DeleteVariables<V>) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Called with the saved data once the write succeeded. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource written to; its lists, records and aggregates refetch after a success. |
| `undoableTimeout` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Milliseconds an `undoable` write waits for Undo before it is sent; 5000 by default. |

返回 `UseMutationResult<SingleResult<T>, Error, DeleteVariables<V>>`。

---
title: "useExport"
description: "useExport React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

Exports a resource's matching records as CSV or JSON, or saves the file the backend builds at `url`, the same way as the `exportList` action.

```typescript
useExport(input: UseExportOptions): UseExportReturn
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseExportOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `readonly TransferColumn[] \| undefined` | 否 | The columns of the file, in order; every field of the records when left out. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filename` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Name of the saved file without its extension; the resource name by default. |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 筛选条件数组。 |
| `format` | `(string & {}) \| TransferFormat \| undefined` | 否 | `csv` or `json` for a file written here; with `url`, any name the backend knows (`xlsx`…). |
| `maxItems` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Stops after this many records, so an export cannot run away. |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `method` | `"GET" \| "POST" \| undefined` | 否 | `POST` (default) sends the values as JSON; `GET` as the query, `filters`, `sorters` and `columns` as JSON text. |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records asked for per request. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `save` | `((file: TransferFile \| TransferDownload) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Where the file goes; the browser download by default. |
| `sorters` | `Sorter[] \| undefined` | 否 | 排序条件数组。 |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The backend builds the file: this endpoint (relative to the API root) is sent `{ filters, sorters, columns, format, ...meta }` and answers the file as a stream, in any format. Without it the records are loaded page by page and the file is written in the browser. |

返回 `UseExportReturn`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | `Error \| undefined` | 否 | Why the last export failed. |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` | 是 | True while the export runs. |
| `progress` | `{ loaded: number; total?: number; } \| undefined` | 否 | Records loaded so far and their total; with `url`, bytes received and the file's size when the backend sends `Content-Length`. |
| `trigger` | `() => Promise<TransferFile \| TransferDownload \| undefined>` | 是 | Loads the records and saves the file; the newest call wins over an earlier one still loading. |

---
title: "useForm"
description: "useForm React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

A form over one record: loads it when `id` is given, keeps the edited values in page state, validates, and saves once through the same path as the `submitForm` action.

```typescript
useForm<T extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>>(input: UseFormOptions<T>): UseFormReturn<T>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseFormOptions<T>` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `draft` | `FormDraftOptions<T> \| undefined` | 否 | Keeps unsaved values in the browser so they can be restored later. |
| `groups` | `Record<string, FormGroupDefinition> \| undefined` | 否 | Named groups of fields, such as the steps of a wizard; `groupErrors` reports each group's errors. |
| `id` | `ID \| undefined` | 否 | With an id the record is loaded and the form updates it; without one it creates. |
| `initialValues` | `Partial<T> \| undefined` | 否 | Values of a new record. An edited record initializes once it has loaded, and later refetches leave the edits alone. |
| `meta` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource the form saves to. |
| `rules` | `unknown` | 否 | Business rules for the context's Validator, e.g. a JSON Schema. Leave it out when no validator is configured. |
| `valuesPath` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where the values live in page state; generated when left out. JSON elements bound to the same path edit the same form. |

返回 `UseFormReturn<T>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `draft` | `FormDraftControl \| undefined` | 否 | Draft controls, present when the `draft` option is set. |
| `errors` | `FormValidationIssue[]` | 是 | Every current error, the server's field errors included. |
| `firstError` | `(fields?: readonly string[]) => string \| undefined` | 是 | The path of the first field in error, among `fields` when given. |
| `groupErrors` | `Record<string, FormErrorGroup>` | 是 | The errors of each group in `groups`, with their count and first field. |
| `isDirty` | `boolean` | 是 | Whether the values differ from those loaded or last saved. |
| `isSubmitting` | `boolean` | 是 | True while a save is under way; another `submit` then sends nothing. |
| `reset` | `(next?: Partial<T> \| undefined) => void` | 是 | Returns to the initial values, or to `next`. |
| `setValue` | `(name: string \| keyof T, value: unknown) => void` | 是 | Sets one field; `name` may be a dotted path such as `items.0.sku`. |
| `setValues` | `(next: T \| ((current: T) => T)) => void` | 是 | Replaces every value, or derives them from the current ones. |
| `submit` | `() => Promise<SingleResult<T>>` | 是 | Validates, then saves; rejects when validation fails or the server refuses, with the errors already in `errors`. |
| `validate` | `(options?: FormValidateOptions) => Promise<FormValidationIssue[]>` | 是 | Validates all fields, or only `fields`, without saving; a wizard calls it on "Next". |
| `values` | `T` | 是 | The current values. |
| `valuesPath` | `string` | 是 | The page state path the values live at. |

---
title: "useImport"
description: "useImport React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

Creates the records of a CSV or JSON file with progress, or uploads the file for the backend to import at `url`, the same way as the `importList` action.

```typescript
useImport(input: UseImportOptions): UseImportReturn
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseImportOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accept` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | File types the picker offers, e.g. `.csv,.json`. |
| `batchSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Records sent per `createMany` call, for backends whose bulk create takes or refuses a batch as a whole. Without it each record goes through `create`, so every refused row is reported on its own. |
| `columns` | `readonly TransferColumn[] \| undefined` | 否 | Maps the file's headings to record fields; headings are taken as field names when left out. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onFinish` | `((result: ImportResult) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called with the result once the import ended. |
| `pick` | `((accept?: string) => Promise<Pick<TransferFile, "name" \| "content"> \| undefined>) \| undefined` | 否 | Chooses and reads the file of a browser import; the browser's picker by default. |
| `pickFile` | `((accept?: string) => Promise<File \| undefined>) \| undefined` | 否 | Chooses the file of a backend import (`url`); the browser's picker by default. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The backend performs the import: the chosen file is uploaded to this endpoint (relative to the API root) as the form field `file`, with `meta` beside it, and the answer `{ data: { total, succeeded, failed, errors } }` is the result. Without it the file is read here and each record created. |

返回 `UseImportReturn`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cancel` | `() => void` | 是 | Stops after the batch under way. |
| `error` | `Error \| undefined` | 否 | Why the last import failed as a whole. |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` | 是 | True while the import runs. |
| `progress` | `ImportProgress \| undefined` | 否 | Records processed, accepted and refused so far; with `url`, the percent of the file uploaded. |
| `result` | `ImportResult \| undefined` | 否 | How the last import went: totals and the refused rows. |
| `trigger` | `(file?: Pick<TransferFile, "name" \| "content"> \| File) => Promise<ImportResult \| undefined>` | 是 | Opens the file picker, or imports the given file; resolves undefined when the reader cancels. |

---

Reads one record through `getOne`; sends nothing while `id` is undefined.

```typescript
useOne<T = any>(input: UseOneOptions): UseQueryResult<SingleResult<T>, Error>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseOneOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `enabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | 是否允许自动执行查询。 |
| `id` | `ID \| undefined` | 是 | The record to read; nothing is sent while it is undefined. |
| `liveMode` | `LiveMode \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the context's `liveMode`, which is `auto` with a liveProvider. |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onLiveEvent` | `((event: LiveEvent) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called for each event of the resource, in `auto` and `manual` mode. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |

返回 `UseQueryResult<SingleResult<T>, Error>`。

title: "useOverlay"

```typescript

```

返回 `OverlayController`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `registerCloseGuard` | `(id: number, guard: OverlayCloseGuard) => () => void` | 是 | Adds a check that may refuse a close; returns the function removing it. |
| `requestClose` | `(id: number, request?: { reason?: OverlayCloseReason; value?: unknown; }) => Promise<boolean>` | 是 | Closes an overlay once its close guards agree; resolves whether it closed. |
| `subscribe` | `(listener: () => void) => () => void` | 是 | Notifies when the open overlays change. |

---
title: "useResourceLive"
description: "useResourceLive React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

Keeps a resource's queries live (spread the returned meta into the query): in `auto` mode an event on
`resources/{resource}` refetches them (lists, records and aggregates
together, so a list and its stats stay one snapshot). With `ids`, events
naming other records are ignored.

```typescript
useResourceLive(resource: string, dataProviderName: string | undefined, options?: LiveOptions & { ids?: readonly ID[]; enabled?: boolean; }): LiveQueryMeta
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | 交给 DataProvider 解释的数据目标，如 `orders`。 |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 是 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `options` | `LiveOptions & { ids?: readonly ID[]; enabled?: boolean; }` | 否 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | 是否允许自动执行查询。 |
| `ids` | `readonly ID[] \| undefined` | 否 | 记录主键数组。 |
| `liveMode` | `LiveMode \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the context's `liveMode`, which is `auto` with a liveProvider. |
| `onLiveEvent` | `((event: LiveEvent) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called for each event of the resource, in `auto` and `manual` mode. |

返回 `LiveQueryMeta`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lumiLive` | `LiveMode` | 是 |  |


---
title: "useSelect"
description: "useSelect React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

Options of a remote select: loaded page by page from a resource, searched on the server, narrowed by other fields, with the selected rows fetched by id when they are not on a loaded page.

```typescript
useSelect(input: UseSelectOptions): UseSelectResult
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseSelectOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `avatarField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A field holding the option's avatar image. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `debounce` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Milliseconds a typed keyword waits before it is searched; 300 by default. |
| `dependsOn` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Fields of `deps` whose values filter the options with `eq`, e.g. the city list by `province`. |
| `deps` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Current values of the fields in `dependsOn`. |
| `descriptionField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A field shown as the option's second line. |
| `enabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | `false` loads nothing, e.g. until the select opens. |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | Conditions every request carries. |
| `imageField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A field holding the option's picture. |
| `labelField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field shown; the first of `label`, `name`, `title`, `id` with a value when left out. |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Options loaded per request. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource the options come from. |
| `search` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A keyword kept by the caller; the options follow it when it changes. |
| `searchField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field a search filters with `like`; without it there is no server search. |
| `selected` | `ID \| ID[] \| null \| undefined` | 否 | The chosen value or values; rows not on a loaded page are fetched by id so their labels show. |
| `valueField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field used as the value; `id` by default. |

返回 `UseSelectResult`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hasMore` | `boolean` | 是 | Whether more options remain on the server. |
| `keyword` | `string` | 是 | The keyword being searched. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | 是 | The first page of the current search is pending or loading. |
| `loadingMore` | `boolean` | 是 | A further page is loading. |
| `loadMore` | `() => void` | 是 | Loads the next page. |
| `options` | `Option[]` | 是 | Rows of every loaded page, in server order. |
| `search` | `(keyword: string) => void` | 是 | Searches for a keyword, from the first page. |
| `selectedOptions` | `Option[]` | 是 | The rows behind `selected`, fetched by id when they are not among the loaded pages. |
| `setDeps` | `(values: Record<string, unknown>) => void` | 是 | Replaces the dependency values, reloading the options. |
| `total` | `number \| undefined` | 是 | How many options match the search, when the server says. |

---
title: "useTable"
description: "useTable React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

The state of a list page: page, page size, sorters, the rows of the current page and an optional aggregate. The JSON `ListPage` is built on it.

```typescript
useTable<T = any>(input: UseTableOptions): UseTableReturn<T>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseTableOptions` | 是 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aggregate` | `UseTableAggregateOptions \| undefined` | 否 | An endpoint answering totals for the same filters: `{ url, method?, totalKey? }`. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filters` | `Filter[] \| undefined` | 否 | Conditions of the list; a change returns to the first page. |
| `liveMode` | `LiveMode \| undefined` | 否 | Defaults to the context's `liveMode`, which is `auto` with a liveProvider. |
| `meta` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `onLiveEvent` | `((event: LiveEvent) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Called for each event of the resource, in `auto` and `manual` mode. |
| `pagination` | `{ pageSize?: number; } \| undefined` | 否 | The first page size, 10 by default; the table keeps page and size in its state from there. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource listed. |
| `statePath` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where page, page size and sorters live in page state, so JSON elements can read them; a private path when left out. |
| `syncWithLocation` | `string \| boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Keeps page, page size and sort in the address's query (`page`, `pageSize`, `sort=field:asc,field2:desc`), so a reload, a shared link and back/forward restore them. A string prefixes the parameter names, for several synced tables on one page. Needs the context's routerProvider. |

返回 `UseTableReturn<T>`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aggregate` | `TableAggregate \| undefined` | 否 | The aggregate's values, once they have loaded for the rows on screen. |
| `aggregateQuery` | `UseQueryResult<{ data: TableAggregate; }, Error> \| undefined` | 否 | The aggregate request, when `aggregate` is set. |
| `page` | `number` | 是 | The current page, counted from 1. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | 是 | Records per page. |
| `query` | `UseQueryResult<GetListResult<T>, Error>` | 是 | The `useList` result behind the rows, for loading and error states. |
| `rows` | `T[]` | 是 | The records of the current page. |
| `setPage` | `Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>` | 是 | Moves to another page. |
| `setPageSize` | `Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>` | 是 | Changes the page size. |
| `setSorters` | `Dispatch<SetStateAction<Sorter[]>>` | 是 | Changes the sort. |
| `sorters` | `Sorter[]` | 是 | The current sort, one entry per column. |
| `total` | `number` | 是 | How many records match, across all pages. |

---
title: "useTreeSource"
description: "useTreeSource React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

Remote nodes for a hierarchical control. A full source reads the whole
resource once; a lazy one reads the root level, then each level as its
parent opens. Chosen values are echoed: their rows are read by ID and the
branches leading to them are loaded, so labels and paths resolve.

```typescript
useTreeSource(input: TreeSource, options?: { value?: unknown; }): TreeSourceState
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `{ resource: string; dataProviderName?: string \| undefined; meta?: Record<string, unknown> \| undefined; filters?: { field: string; operator: "null" \| "in" \| "eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| ... 6 more ... \| "nnull"; value: unknown; }[] \| undefined; ... 8 more ...; pageSize?: number \| undefined; }` | 是 |  |
| `options` | `{ value?: unknown; }` | 否 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `childrenField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field holding a row's nested children, for a backend that answers a tree. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `filters` | `{ field: string; operator: "null" \| "in" \| "eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte" \| "like" \| "nlike" \| "nin" \| "between" \| "nnull"; value: unknown; }[] \| undefined` | 否 | Conditions every request carries. |
| `labelField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field shown; the first of `label`, `name`, `title` with a value, else the id, when left out. |
| `lazy` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Requests each level when its parent opens, instead of the whole resource once. |
| `leafField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | A field telling whether a row has no children, so a lazy node shows no expander. |
| `meta` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Rows per request; 1000 by default. |
| `parentField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field linking a flat row to its parent; `parentId` by default. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource the nodes come from. |
| `rootValue` | `string \| number \| undefined` | 否 | The parent value of root rows; rows with an empty parent when left out. |
| `searchField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field a search filters with `like` on the server; a lazy source needs it to search. |
| `valueField` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The field used as a node's value; `id` by default. |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `unknown` | 否 |  |

返回 `TreeSourceState`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `TreeSourceNode[]` | 是 | The nodes loaded so far, as a tree. |
| `loadChildren` | `((node: { value: unknown; }) => Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Loads one node's children; only present for a `lazy` source. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | 是 | The first level (or the whole resource) is loading. |
| `search` | `((query: string) => void) \| undefined` | 否 | Server search; only present for a `lazy` source with a `searchField`. |
| `searching` | `boolean` | 是 | A server search is under way. |
| `selectedNodes` | `TreeSourceNode[]` | 是 | The chosen nodes, also when their branch has not been loaded yet. |


---
title: "useUpdateMany"
description: "useUpdateMany React hook 的签名、参数和返回值。"
---

Applies the same values to several records: `updateMany` when the provider has it, else one `update` per id.

```typescript
useUpdateMany<T = any, V = any>(options: MutationOptions<ManyResult<T>, UpdateManyVariables<V>>): UseMutationResult<ManyResult<T>, Error, UpdateManyVariables<V>>
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `MutationOptions<ManyResult<T>, UpdateManyVariables<V>>` | 是 |  |

`options` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | 多数据源名称；省略时使用 default。 |
| `meta` | `Meta \| undefined` | 否 | 原样传给 DataProvider 的扩展数据。 |
| `mutationMode` | `MutationMode \| undefined` | 否 | Updates and deletes only: `optimistic` shows the change at once and rolls it back on failure; `undoable` also waits `undoableTimeout` with an Undo notice before sending (Undo rejects with MutationUndoneError, unreported). Defaults to the context's `mutationMode`, else `pessimistic`. |
| `onError` | `((error: Error, variables: UpdateManyVariables<V>) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Replaces the default report: without it a failure is shown as a danger toast. |
| `onSuccess` | `((data: ManyResult<T>, variables: UpdateManyVariables<V>) => void \| Promise<void>) \| undefined` | 否 | Called with the saved data once the write succeeded. |
| `resource` | `string` | 是 | The resource written to; its lists, records and aggregates refetch after a success. |
| `undoableTimeout` | `number \| undefined` | 否 | Milliseconds an `undoable` write waits for Undo before it is sent; 5000 by default. |

返回 `UseMutationResult<ManyResult<T>, Error, UpdateManyVariables<V>>`。

Uploads files with progress and cancellation, through the data provider's client or straight to object storage with `sign`; defaults come from the context's `upload` option.

```typescript
useUpload(input?: UseUploadOptions): UseUploadReturn
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `UseUploadOptions` | 否 |  |

`input` 的字段：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `LumiContext \| undefined` | 否 | The Lumi context to use outside a Lumi provider. |
| `data` | `Record<string, unknown> \| undefined` | 否 | Other form fields sent beside the file. |
| `dataProviderName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | The data provider whose API root and request client are used. |
| `fieldName` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Form field of the file; `file` by default. |
| `headers` | `UploadHeaders \| undefined` | 否 | Extra headers, or a function answering them; the reader's credentials are added by the request client. |
| `method` | `"POST" \| "PUT" \| "PATCH" \| undefined` | 否 | `POST` by default. |
| `sign` | `UploadSignOptions \| undefined` | 否 | Uploads straight to object storage with a ticket from the backend, instead of through `url`. |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal \| undefined` | 否 | Aborts the upload. |
| `trustedOrigins` | `string[] \| undefined` | 否 | Other sites an upload `url` may point at and be signed for; the API root and this site always are. |
| `url` | `string \| undefined` | 否 | Where the file is sent, relative to the API root; `/upload` by default. |
| `withCredentials` | `boolean \| undefined` | 否 | Sends cookies; follows the auth provider's credentials when left out. |

返回 `UseUploadReturn`。

返回结构：

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cancel` | `() => void` | 是 | Aborts the upload under way. |
| `error` | `Error \| null` | 是 | Why the last `upload` failed. |
| `progress` | `number` | 是 | Percent of the files `upload` is sending, 0 to 100. |
| `reset` | `() => void` | 是 | Clears the progress and the error. |
| `upload` | `(input: File \| File[] \| FileList, options?: UploadOptions) => Promise<UploadResult[]>` | 是 | Sends the files one after another and answers their results in order. |
| `uploadFile` | `(file: File, options?: UploadOptions & { onProgress?: (percent: number) => void; }) => Promise<UploadResult>` | 是 | Sends one file on its own: several may run at once, each with its own progress and `signal`. It leaves the shared progress/uploading/error alone. |
| `uploading` | `boolean` | 是 | True while `upload` runs; another call is refused until it ends. |

---
title: "AuthProvider"
description: "AuthProvider 接口的方法、参数和返回值。"
---

Authentication provider: the one sign-in session of the app. It runs the
session requests itself (sign in and out, register, password reset, the
current user), decides how every other request carries the credentials
(`authorizeRequest`) and what a failure means (`onError`). Data providers
never handle credentials: they send through the HttpClient that asks it.

```typescript
interface AuthProvider
```

| 名称 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authorizeRequest` | `((request: { url: string; method: string; }) => RequestAuthorization \| undefined \| Promise<RequestAuthorization \| undefined>) \| undefined` | 否 | Headers and fetch credentials for one request; called before each one an HttpClient sends. |
| `check` | `() => Promise<CheckResponse>` | 是 | Whether a session exists; asked before a protected route or manifest loads. |
| `forgotPassword` | `((params: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>) \| undefined` | 否 | Starts a password reset, e.g. by mailing a link to the account's address. |
| `getIdentity` | `(<T = any>() => Promise<T \| null>) \| undefined` | 否 | The current user, for the account menu and `useIdentity`; `null` when signed out. |
| `getPermissions` | `((params?: any) => Promise<unknown>) \| undefined` | 否 | The raw permission data, for `usePermissions`. Lumi's own checks ask the AccessProvider. |
| `login` | `(params: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>` | 是 | Signs in with the sign-in form's values, e.g. `{ username, password, remember }`. |
| `logout` | `(params?: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>` | 是 | Signs out and forgets the session. |
| `onError` | `((error: any) => Promise<AuthErrorResponse>) \| undefined` | 否 | What a failed data request means for the session, once `refresh` could not save it; `{ logout: true }` signs the reader out. |
| `refresh` | `(() => Promise<boolean>) \| undefined` | 否 | Renews expired credentials after a 401; `true` sends the request again. Concurrent 401s share one call. |
| `register` | `((params: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>) \| undefined` | 否 | Creates an account; a provider that also signs the new account in answers like `login`. Leave it out where accounts are assigned. |
| `updatePassword` | `((params: any) => Promise<AuthActionResponse>) \| undefined` | 否 | Sets a new password, with the reset link's token or the signed-in session. |

---
title: "权限"
description: "AccessProvider 是什么、Lumi 在哪里问它、默认规则怎么把 resource 和 action 拼成权限串，以及怎么接自己的权限接口或角色规则。"
---

## 干什么

`AccessProvider` 只回答一个问题：当前用户能不能对某个资源做某个动作。

```ts
import type { CanParams, CanResponse } from '@duxweb/lumi'

export interface MyAccessProvider {
  // 例如 { resource: 'system/users', action: 'delete' } → { can: false, reason: '没有删除权限' }
  can: (params: CanParams) => Promise<CanResponse>
}
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `resource` | 资源名，如 `orders`、`system/users`。首尾的 `/` 会先去掉。 |
| `action` | 动作，如 `list`、`show`、`create`、`edit`、`delete`，也可以是任意自定义的名字。 |
| `params` | 可选，额外的条件，如 `{ id: 12 }`，按记录判断时用。 |

返回 `{ can, reason? }`。`reason` 是不允许的原因，`CanAccess` 会把它写进状态，页面可以显示出来。

登录归 [AuthProvider](/guide/advanced/auth/)，权限归 `AccessProvider`，两者是同级的 provider。同类框架里，refine 也把权限放在单独的 `accessControlProvider`；react-admin 则把 `canAccess` 放在 `authProvider` 里。Lumi 选择分开：换登录方式不必重写权限规则，权限规则也可以单独接一个权限服务。

隐藏菜单和按钮只是体验。用户仍然可以直接调用接口，后端必须自己检查权限。

## Lumi 在哪里问它

| 位置 | 怎么用 |
| --- | --- |
| 菜单 | manifest 路由的 `access`（如 `{ "resource": "orders", "action": "list" }`）不通过时，菜单项隐藏。`action` 不写时是 `list`。 |
| 路由 | 同一个 `access` 不通过时，直接打开地址显示 403 页面。 |
| JSON 的 `CanAccess` 元素 | 通过时显示子元素，否则显示 `fallback` 插槽；写了 `resultPath` 还会把 `{ can, reason, loading }` 写进状态。 |
| React | `useCan({ resource, action })` 和 `<LumiCanAccess>`。 |

没有配置 `AccessProvider` 时，所有检查都通过。结果会缓存，登录、退出、切换账号时一起清空。

## 在页面里用

把删除按钮包在 `CanAccess` 里，没有权限就不显示：

```jsonc
{
  "root": "can-delete",
  "elements": {
    "can-delete": {
      "type": "CanAccess",
      // 能删除 orders 时才显示里面的按钮
      "props": { "resource": "orders", "action": "delete" },
      "slots": { "fallback": ["no-access"] },
      "children": ["delete"]
    },
    "delete": {
      "type": "Button",
      "props": { "label": "删除", "appearance": "danger" },
      "children": []
    },
    // 没有权限时显示这一句
    "no-access": {
      "type": "Text",
      "props": { "text": "没有删除权限", "variant": "muted" },
      "children": []
    }
  }
}
```

想让按钮显示但不可点击时，写 `resultPath`，再让按钮读它：

```jsonc
{
  "root": "page",
  // 检查结果的初始值：还没查到时按没有权限处理
  "state": { "access": { "edit": { "can": false } } },
  "elements": {
    "page": {
      "type": "Stack",
      "props": {},
      "children": ["check", "edit"]
    },
    // 只检查、不包内容：结果写到 /access/edit
    "check": {
      "type": "CanAccess",
      "props": {
        "resource": "orders",
        "action": "edit",
        "resultPath": "/access/edit"
      },
      "children": []
    },
    // 编辑按钮：读检查结果
    "edit": {
      "type": "Button",
      "props": {
        "label": "编辑",
        // 没有权限时禁用
        "disabled": {
          "$cond": { "$state": "/access/edit/can" },
          "$then": false,
          "$else": true
        }
      },
      "children": []
    }
  }
}
```

React 里：

```tsx
import { LumiCanAccess, useCan } from '@duxweb/lumi'

export function OrderActions(): React.ReactNode {
  // 问一次：能不能编辑 orders
  const edit = useCan({ resource: 'orders', action: 'edit' })
  return (
    <>
      {/* 没有权限时按钮禁用 */}
      <button type="button" disabled={!edit.data?.can}>
        编辑
      </button>
      {/* 有权限才显示里面的按钮，否则显示 fallback */}
      <LumiCanAccess
        resource="orders"
        action="delete"
        fallback={<span>没有删除权限</span>}
      >
        <button type="button">删除</button>
      </LumiCanAccess>
    </>
  )
}
```

## 默认规则

默认的 `AccessProvider` 由 [createSimpleAuthProvider](/guide/advanced/auth/#默认实现createsimpleauthprovider) 提供。它读登录或 `me` 接口返回的 `permissions` 字符串数组，把 `{ resource, action }` 拼成一个权限串去匹配：

1. 资源名里的 `/` 换成分隔符，再按 `format`（默认 `{resource}{separator}{action}`）拼起来。
2. 用分隔符把双方切成几段，逐段比较。
3. 后端给的权限里，任何一段写 `*` 匹配这一段的任意值；最后一段是 `*` 时，匹配它下面的所有层级。

分隔符是 `:`（默认）时：

| 检查 | 拼成 | 能通过的权限 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `orders` + `list` | `orders:list` | `orders:list`、`orders:*`、`*:list`、`*`、`*:*` |
| `system/users` + `delete` | `system:users:delete` | `system:users:delete`、`system:users:*`、`system:*`、`*:users:delete`、`*` |
| `system/users` + `delete` | `system:users:delete` | 不能通过：`system`、`system:users`（没有 `*` 不会覆盖下层）、`system:roles:*` |

`action` 以 `field:` 开头（如 `field:price`）时，只要对这个资源有任何一项权限就算通过。

### 配置

CDN 版写在 `config.json` 顶层的 `access`，和登录的 `auth` 分开，多个后台可以各用一个：

```jsonc
{
  "data": { "url": "/api" },
  "panels": { "manifest": "/manifest.json" },
  // 后端用 system.users.delete 这样的点号格式
  "access": { "separator": "." }
}
```

npm 里传给 `createSimpleAuthProvider` 的 `permission`：

```ts
import { createSimpleAuthProvider } from '@duxweb/lumi'

// 后端的权限串是 delete:system:users，动作在前面
export const auth = createSimpleAuthProvider({
  apiUrl: '/api',
  permission: { separator: ':', format: '{action}{separator}{resource}' },
})
```

| 选项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `separator` | `:`（默认）或 `.`。 |
| `format` | 拼法模板，可用 `{resource}`、`{action}`、`{separator}`，必须包含前两个。 |

后端返回格式见 [对接后端](/guide/backend-auth/#权限标识)，全部配置见 [项目配置](/guide/config/)。

## 自定义

### 从单独的接口读权限列表

登录接口不返回权限、而是另有一个权限接口时，自己请求，再用 `createPermissionMatcher` 复用默认的匹配规则：

```ts
import type { AccessProvider, HttpClient } from '@duxweb/lumi'
import { createPermissionMatcher } from '@duxweb/lumi'

// 应用的请求客户端
declare const http: HttpClient

// 复用默认的匹配规则，分隔符用点号
const matches = createPermissionMatcher({ separator: '.' })
// 缓存这次会话的权限列表
let loading: Promise<string[]> | undefined

// 一次会话只请求一次；登录、退出后调用 reset
const permissions = (): Promise<string[]> => {
  loading ??= http
    .request<{ data: string[] }>('/rbac/permissions')
    .then((body) => body.data)
    // 失败时不缓存，下次再试
    .catch((error: unknown) => {
      loading = undefined
      throw error
    })
  return loading
}

export const accessProvider: AccessProvider = {
  // 用取回的列表判断
  can: async ({ resource, action }) => ({
    can: matches(await permissions(), { resource, action }),
  }),
}
// 清掉缓存
export const reset = (): void => {
  loading = undefined
}
```

`createPermissionMatcher(options)` 返回 `(permissions, { resource, action }) => boolean`，选项和上面的 `permission` 相同。缓存要在登录、退出后清掉，比如在自己的 `AuthProvider` 的 `login`、`logout` 里调用 `reset()`。

### 按角色和条件判断

后端返回角色，前端按规则表判断，类似 CASL、Casbin 的写法；`params` 可以带上记录，按记录判断：

```ts
import type { AccessProvider, AuthProvider } from '@duxweb/lumi'

// 应用的 AuthProvider，用来读当前用户
declare const authProvider: AuthProvider

// 一条规则：哪个资源、哪些动作
interface Rule {
  resource: string
  actions: string[]
  // 可选的条件：只对一部分记录生效，比如自己的订单
  when?: (params: Record<string, unknown>, user: { id: number }) => boolean
}

// 每个角色的规则
const rules: Record<string, Rule[]> = {
  // 管理员：全部允许
  admin: [{ resource: '*', actions: ['*'] }],
  sales: [
    // 销售：能看和新建订单
    { resource: 'orders', actions: ['list', 'show', 'create'] },
    // 只能编辑自己负责的订单
    {
      resource: 'orders',
      actions: ['edit'],
      when: (params, user) => params.ownerId === user.id,
    },
  ],
}

export const roleAccessProvider: AccessProvider = {
  can: async ({ resource, action, params = {} }) => {
    // 当前用户和他的角色
    const user = await authProvider.getIdentity?.<{ id: number; role: string }>()
    // 有一条规则同时匹配资源、动作和条件就允许
    const allowed = (rules[user?.role ?? ''] ?? []).some(
      (rule) =>
        (rule.resource === '*' || rule.resource === resource) &&
        (rule.actions.includes('*') || rule.actions.includes(action)) &&
        (!rule.when || rule.when(params, user!)),
    )
    return allowed ? { can: true } : { can: false, reason: '当前角色不能执行这个操作' }
  },
}
```

### 注册到应用

- **npm**：交给 `createLumi({ accessProvider })`。
- **Admin 的 `mountAdmin`**：扩展选项里写 `accessProviders: { default: provider }`（键是 `access` 配置的名字），见 [Admin 应用](/guide/advanced/admin/)。
- **CDN 扩展模块**：模块返回 `{ accessProviders: { 名称: provider } }`，按 `access` 的名字替换，和 `authProviders` 一样，见 [换成自己的登录](/guide/extend-backend/#换成自己的登录)。

在 Admin 里，只要换了 `authProvider`，默认的 `accessProvider` 就不再使用，因为它读的是默认登录的权限列表。这时不另给 `accessProvider`，菜单和路由不再按权限过滤，所有检查都通过。

## 相关

- `useCan(params)`：返回 TanStack Query 的结果，`data` 是 `{ can, reason }`。见 [数据 hooks](/guide/advanced/hooks/)。
- [CanAccess](/components/connected/can-access/) 元素。
- 接口的完整类型见 [AccessProvider](/core/providers/access-provider/)，各 provider 的分工见 [架构](/guide/advanced/architecture/)。

title: "Admin 应用"
description: "createAdmin 和 mountAdmin 的全部选项、返回的实例、扩展对象、CDN 版的 LumiAdminSetup 与 LumiAdmin.use、路由抽屉，以及 JSON 页面和 React 页面混用。"
